en: These systems provide enhanced firepower to light and medium CA-BDEs, typically operating as one company within a battalion.

zh: 驅逐戰車與突擊砲在能力與外觀上通常相似。
en: Tank destroyers and assault guns are generally similar in capability and appearance.

zh: 幾乎全部採用裝甲運兵車或步兵戰車底盤，乘員艙由機械裝置與彈藥取代，以支援105毫米主砲與砲塔。
en: Nearly all employ an APC or IFV chassis, with the crew compartment occupied by the machinery and ammunition to support a 105-mm main gun and turret.

zh: 解放軍陸軍幾乎所有的105毫米砲，都源自1960年代廣泛擴散的英國L7砲。
en: Nearly all of the PLAA's 105-mm guns are derived from the widely proliferated British L7 gun of the 1960s.

zh: 除了機動反裝甲角色外，這些火砲也具有有用的反人員與反障礙能力，並在需要增強火力時，由營或群指揮官運用。
en: In addition to their mobile antitank role, these guns also have useful antipersonnel and anti-obstacle capabilities, and they are employed by battalion or group commanders whenever enhanced firepower is required.

zh: 最常見的突擊砲類型包括ZTL-11（改良的08式裝甲運兵車）與以ZSL-92裝甲運兵車為基礎的PTL-02。
en: Among the most common assault-gun types are the ZTL-11 (a modified Type 08 APC) and the PTL-02, based on the ZSL-92 APC.

zh: 反裝甲飛彈車輛廣泛存在於各類型的解放軍陸軍編隊中。
en: ATGM vehicles are widespread in PLAA formations of all types.

zh: 幾乎每個營級組織至少運用一個排的反裝甲飛彈車輛。
en: Virtually every battalion-level organization employs at least a platoon of ATGM vehicles.

zh: 由於其裝甲薄，反裝甲飛彈車輛最適合用於伏擊或防區外攻擊，使其無法被敵方坦克或步兵戰車鎖定。
en: Due to their thin armor, ATGM vehicles are best employed in ambushes or standoff attacks where they cannot be targeted by enemy tanks or IFVs.

zh: 它們幾乎完全是防禦性武器，不過必要時也可用其飛彈攻擊碉堡或其他防禦工事。
en: They are almost exclusively a defensive weapon, though they can employ their missiles to target bunkers or other fortifications if required.

zh: 幾乎每一款解放軍陸軍的裝甲運兵車型號，都已被改裝為反裝甲飛彈車輛。
en: Virtually every PLAA APC model has been modified to be an ATGM vehicle.

zh: 解放軍陸軍大部分輕型戰術車輛屬於猛士系列，這是一群源自美國H1悍馬的車輛，而H1悍馬是美國M998高機動多用途輪型車輛的民用版本。
en: Most of the PLAA's light tactical vehicles are in the Mengshi family, a group of vehicles derived from the U.S. H1 Hummer, which is the civilian version of the U.S. M998 high mobility multipurpose wheeled vehicle.

zh: 與M998一樣，猛士系列車輛已定期升級，最初主要是軟頂多用途車輛，現在則具備大量裝甲、防地雷底盤與遙控武器站。
en: Like the M998, the Mengshi family of vehicles has been periodically upgraded, starting primarily as soft-sided utility vehicles and now featuring extensive armor, mine-resistant chassis, and remote weapons stations.

zh: 最新的猛士車輛比其悍馬前身大得多，在尺寸與能力上都極為類似美國聯合輕型戰術車輛。
en: The latest Mengshi vehicles are significantly larger than their Hummer predecessors, strongly resembling U.S. joint light tactical vehicles in both size and capability.

zh: 這些車輛遍及整個解放軍陸軍與武警，提供地面部隊大部分的機動化支援，並具備日益增強的防護與火力套件。
en: These vehicles are ubiquitous throughout the PLAA and the PAP, providing much of the motorization support for ground forces along with a growing protection and firepower suite.

zh: 解放軍運用各種重型輪型車輛，尺寸與酬載差異很大。
en: The PLA employs a variety of heavy wheeled vehicles, varying widely in size and payload.

zh: MV3是通用的中型卡車，通常以6 x 6配置運作。
en: The MV3 is the generic medium truck, usually operated in a 6 x 6 configuration.

zh: 它大致可與美國M939或輕中型戰術車輛相比，不過它是比兩者都更新的設計。
en: It is largely comparable to the U.S. M939 or light medium tactical vehicle, though it is a newer design than either.

zh: 眾多不同型號的較大型卡車，提供逐步增加的酬載。
en: Numerous different models of larger trucks provide progressively greater payload.

zh: 最大的種類配置高達10 x 10，並作為洲際彈道飛彈（ICBM）與長程地對空飛彈（SAM）系統的運輸起豎發射車。
en: The largest varieties are up to 10 x 10 in configuration and serve as transporter-erector-launchers for intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs) and long-range surface-to-air missile (SAM) systems.

zh: 中共對蘇聯的軍事獨立，可由其輕兵器工業的成長來追溯。
en: China's military independence from the Soviet Union can be tracked with the growth of its small arms industry.

zh: 這項發展與解放軍陸軍制式步槍的進步同步：在過去50年間，它從蘇聯SKS的簡單仿製品，轉變為基於AK 47、AKM與AK-74的衍生型，再到完全本土的當代設計。
en: This development was paralleled by the advancement of the PLAA's service rifle: over the last 50 years it transitioned from a simple copy of the Soviet SKS, to the development of variants based on the AK 47, AKM, and AK-74, to completely indigenous contemporary designs.

zh: QBZ-95是解放軍陸軍當今的主要制式步槍。
en: The QBZ-95 is the PLAA's primary service rifle today.

zh: QBZ-95採無托式設計，針對易用性與射速進行最佳化。
en: A bullpup design, the QBZ-95 is optimized for ease of use and volume of fire.

zh: 它被認為是簡單、堅固且舒適的武器。
en: It is well regarded as a simple, sturdy, and comfortable weapon.

zh: 它比大多數西方競爭對手準確度較低，且缺乏大多數現代突擊步槍所享有的模組化升級能力——例如導軌系統。
en: It is less accurate than most of its Western competitors, and it lacks the modular upgrade capabilities—such as rail systems—enjoyed by most modern assault rifles.

zh: 據信QBZ-95的下一代將包含平頂導軌系統，而非簡單的機械瞄具。
en: The next generation of the QBZ-95 is thought to include a flat-top rail system instead of simple iron sights.

zh: QBZ-95已被改造為榴彈發射器、卡賓槍與輕型支援武器衍生型。
en: The QBZ-95 has been modified into grenade launcher, carbine, and light support-weapon variants.

zh: 較舊的制式步槍——大多是AKM與AK-74衍生型——仍廣泛用於民兵與預備役編隊。
en: Older service rifles—mostly AKM and AK-74 variants—are still in wide use across militia and reserve formations.

zh: 此外，14.5毫米重機槍在整個戰術編隊中用作防空武器。
en: In addition, 14.5-mm heavy machine guns are employed as antiaircraft weapons throughout tactical formations.

zh: 通用機槍由機槍小組操作，並安裝在各類車輛上；重機槍通常安裝在裝甲車輛上。
en: General-purpose machine guns are operated by machine-gun teams and mounted on vehicles of all types; heavy machine guns are typically mounted on armored vehicles.

zh: 重型防空機槍配備於每個合成營（CA-BN）的重武器連。
en: Heavy antiaircraft machine guns are fielded in each combined arms battalion (CA-BN) heavy-weapon company.

zh: 一般而言，解放軍陸軍的機槍可被視為與西方對應型號相當——且在許多情況下幾乎完全相同。
en: Generally speaking, PLAA machine guns can be considered comparable—and in many cases practically identical—to their Western equivalents.

zh: 解放軍陸軍在其編隊中運用非常高密度的單兵攜帶式反裝甲武器，呼應整個組織中可見的對反裝甲能力的普遍強調。
en: The PLAA employs a very high density of man-portable antitank weapons throughout its formations, echoing a general emphasis on antitank capability that is visible throughout the organization.

zh: 解放軍陸軍過去的單兵攜帶式反裝甲作戰方法很簡單：以量取勝，為各類編隊配備大量無導引火箭——大多基於無處不在的蘇聯RPG-7——與簡易反裝甲飛彈，主要是HJ-73，這是蘇聯AT-3「賽格」的仿製品。
en: The PLAA's historical approach to man-portable antitank warfare was simple mass, equipping formations of all types with huge numbers of unguided rockets—mostly based on the ubiquitous Soviet RPG-7—and simple ATGMs, predominantly the HJ-73, a copy of the Soviet AT-3 Sagger.

zh: 這些系統仍在使用，且由於定期升級與部署的密度，仍對許多裝甲車輛構成威脅。
en: These systems are still in use and still pose a threat to many armored vehicles due to periodic upgrades and the density of their deployment.

zh: 然而，解放軍陸軍開始對其反裝甲飛彈採取品質重於數量的做法，這在HJ-12的研製與配備中最容易看出。
en: The PLAA, however, is beginning to take a quality-over-quantity approach with regard to its ATGMs, seen most easily in the development and fielding of the HJ-12.

zh: 為了與美國FGM-148標槍飛彈競爭而專門研製，HJ-12採用大部分最新的反裝甲飛彈發展成果，包括頂攻剖面、串聯彈頭、軟發射與射後不理的目標指定能力。
en: Developed specifically to compete with the U.S. FGM-148 Javelin, the HJ-12 employs most of the latest ATGM developments, including a top-down attack profile, tandem warheads, soft launch, and a fire-and-forget targeting capability.

zh: 然而，這些系統昂貴而複雜，其密度受限於成本。
en: These systems are expensive and complex, however, and their density is limited by their cost.

zh: 解放軍陸軍在其編隊中仍運用高密度的無導引單兵攜帶式火箭，特別是在輕步兵單位。
en: The PLAA still employs a high density of unguided man-portable rockets throughout its formations, particularly in light infantry units.

zh: 這些武器採用簡易高爆、反裝甲、燃料空氣炸藥、燃燒與爆破彈頭，發揮各種不同角色，並大幅增強步兵班的火力。
en: These weapons employ simple HE, antitank, fuel and air explosive, incendiary, and demolition warheads, filling a variety of different roles and providing significant enhancement to the firepower of the infantry squad.

zh: PF-89是最廣泛擴散的肩射式反裝甲火箭系統，在尺寸與能力上與北約AT-4非常相似。
en: The PF-89 is the most widely proliferated shoulder-fired antitank rocket system, and it is very similar to the NATO AT-4 in both size and capability.

zh: FHJ84是發射燃燒彈頭、用於殺傷人員或爆破的輕型雙管火箭系統，而PF-97是重型燃料空氣炸藥火箭系統。
en: The FHJ84 is a lightweight twin-rocket system that fires an incendiary warhead for antipersonnel or demolition use, and the PF-97 is a heavy fuel and air explosive rocket system.

zh: PF-98沒有西方的對應型號。
en: The PF-98 does not have a Western equivalent.

zh: 它是強大的120毫米反裝甲與反人員火箭系統，通常從兩腳架發射。
en: It is a powerful 120-mm antitank and antipersonnel rocket system, usually fired from a bipod.

zh: 在僅僅20多年間，解放軍陸軍的機動能力從輕步兵徵兵與過時坦克的混合兵力，演進為近乎完全摩托化與機械化的兵力，運用各種尖端裝甲車輛與先進導引彈藥。
en: In just over 20 years, the PLAA's maneuver capabilities evolved from a force mixture of light infantry conscripts and obsolete tanks to a nearly fully motorized and mechanized force that employs a variety of cutting-edge armored vehicles and advanced guided munitions.

zh: 相當數量的合成旅仍配備較舊的系統，並且在可預見的未來很可能維持如此。
en: A significant number of CA-BDEs are still equipped with older systems, and they are likely to remain so for the foreseeable future.

zh: 機動部隊內部朝向專業化的發展，同樣產生了好壞參半的結果。
en: So too has the movement towards professionalization within the maneuver force produced mixed results.

zh: 雖然新兵與士官（NCO）的品質都已大幅提升，解放軍陸軍在較低戰術梯隊的分散規劃與作業方面仍有困難。
en: While the quality of both recruits and noncommissioned officers (NCOs) has increased significantly, the PLAA still struggles with decentralizing planning and operations at lower tactical echelons.

zh: 機動部隊也一直為資訊化戰場與現代機械化兵力的複雜性所苦。
en: The maneuver force has also struggled with the complexities of the informationized battlefield and modern mechanized forces.

zh: 資訊化士兵的技術要求遠高於過去世代的徵兵，而機械化兵力的維修與後勤要求遠高於輕步兵兵力。
en: The technical demands of the informationized soldier are far greater than for conscripts of past generations, and the maintenance and logistics demands of mechanized forces are much greater than those of light infantry forces.

zh: 解放軍最顯著的能力增強，是發展出可行的遠征能力。
en: The most significant capability enhancement in the PLA is the development of a viable expeditionary capability.

zh: 然而，為了確立自身的大國地位，中共認為需要強大的地面遠征能力。
en: In order to establish itself as a great power, however, China believes that a powerful ground expeditionary capability is required.

zh: 這是解放軍海軍陸戰隊擴編的主要驅動力。
en: This is the primary driver behind the expansion of the PLANMC.

zh: 這很可能是解放軍中為滿足新遠征需求所做的最重要努力。
en: It is likely the most significant effort in the PLA to meet the new expeditionary requirements.

zh: 解放軍陸軍戰術梯隊的領導者在技術與戰術上都稱職，並定期接受參謀與指揮職能的訓練。
en: PLAA leaders at tactical echelons are technically and tactically competent, with fairly regular training in both staff and command functions.

zh: 軍官團已專業化且受過良好教育，許多軍官完成了高等學位與進階軍事教育。
en: The officer corps is professionalized and well educated, with many officers completing both advanced degrees and advanced military educations.

zh: 專業化的士官團是相對較新的發展。
en: A professionalized NCO corps is a relatively new development.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的士官在歷史上只是有幾年經驗的徵兵，但從1990年代後期開始，解放軍陸軍開始探索職業士官的構想。
en: PLAA NCOs were historically just conscripts with a few years' experience, but starting in the late 1990s the PLAA began exploring the idea of career NCOs.

zh: 與美國陸軍相比，這個群體仍發展不足，參謀經驗極少且沒有指揮經驗，但解放軍陸軍對這個新制度的信心，反映在軍官招募的減少與士官團的持續擴大上。
en: This cohort is still underdeveloped compared to the U.S. Army, with minimal staff experience and no command experience, but the PLAA's belief in this new system is reflected in decreasing officer recruitment and the continued expansion of the NCO corps.

zh: 小單位領導者因零容忍文化而害怕做決定，軍官也仍然猶豫是否授權下屬，唯恐他們表現不佳而連帶使該軍官形象不佳。
en: Small unit leaders are afraid to make decisions due to a zero-tolerance culture, and officers remain hesitant to empower subordinates lest they underperform and thus reflect poorly on the officer.

zh: 然而，正投入大量資源來彌補這些缺口，例如建立仿效美國陸軍戰鬥訓練中心的訓練設施，並發展專業化、專責的對抗兵力。
en: Significant resources are being devoted to mitigating these gaps, however, such as the establishment of training facilities that mimic U.S. Army Combat Training Centers and the development of a professionalized, dedicated opposing force.

zh: 中國士兵堅韌、體能良好，並對國家與中共深具忠誠。
en: The Chinese soldier is tough, physically fit, and deeply loyal to the country and the Communist Party of China (CPC).

zh: 中國日益增長的都市化與不斷改善的社會基礎設施，正全面提升其徵兵的健康、教育與整體素質。
en: China's growing urbanization and improving social infrastructure are increasing the health, education, and general quality of its conscripts across the board.

zh: 部分單位獲得大量訓練資源，例如對抗專業對抗兵力的機動演習，而其他單位甚至可能無法獲得足夠的彈藥進行例行射擊訓練。
en: Some units receive substantial training resources, such as maneuver exercises against a professional opposing force, while others may not even receive adequate ammunition for regular marksmanship practice.

zh: 由於旅與旅之間差異很大，即使在同一個集團軍內，外界也很難有效評估一個單位的訓練戰備程度。
en: It is challenging for outsiders to effectively assess a unit's training readiness level due to the wide variations between brigades, even within the same group armies.

zh: 預備役人員幾乎全都來自前現役士兵，因此享有基本的訓練水準，但預備役或民兵單位若被啟用，需要相當長的時間才能達到可用的訓練戰備程度。
en: Reservists are nearly all taken from former active-duty soldiers and, as such, enjoy a baseline level of training, but a reserve or militia unit, if activated, will take an extended period to reach a useful training readiness level.

zh: 相反地，解放軍的精銳部隊——特種作戰部隊、享有聲望的合成旅、空降與海軍陸戰部隊等——享有大量訓練資源，能力很可能可與訓練精良的西方編隊相比。
en: Conversely, the elite elements of the PLA—SOF, prestigious CA-BDEs, airborne, and marine forces, among others—enjoy substantial training resources and are likely comparable in competence to well-trained Western formations.

zh: 在近期改革期間，中國人民解放軍陸軍（PLAA）內沒有任何其他能力領域，獲得比火力支援更大的重視。
en: No other capability area within the People's Liberation Army Army (PLAA) has received greater emphasis during the recent period of reform than fire support.

zh: 解放軍陸軍運用迫擊砲、榴彈砲與火箭的混合，作為其火力支援的骨幹，包括密度特別高的現代化火箭系統，能夠運用精準與近精準導引彈藥。
en: The PLAA employs a mixture of mortars, howitzers, and rockets as the backbone of its fire support, including a notably high density of modernized rocket systems capable of employing precision and near-precision guided munitions.

zh: 經驗與觀察使解放軍陸軍領導者得出結論，其機動單位在與美軍及俄軍的大致對應單位交手時，面臨重大挑戰，因此決定追求增強火力，作為抵銷該能力差距的手段。
en: Experiences and observation led PLAA leaders to conclude that their maneuver units faced significant challenges when matching up against their approximate equivalents in the U.S. and Russian armies, so the decision was made to pursue enhanced firepower as a means of offsetting that capability gap.

zh: 聯合火力支援——來自固定翼或旋翼飛機，或來自艦艇或潛艦——發展得遠不成熟。
en: Joint fire support—from fixed-wing or rotary-wing aircraft, or from ships or submarines—is much less well developed.

zh: 密接空中支援作為一項能力幾乎不存在，解放軍陸軍運用的攻擊直升機密度非常低，不過這個數字預計將增加。
en: Close air support is virtually nonexistent as a capability, and the PLAA employs a very low density of attack helicopters, though this number is set to increase.

zh: 海軍火力同樣大體上不在解放軍的組合之中，不過兩棲部隊可透過水陸兩用坦克、突擊砲與迫擊砲，提供大部分自己的火力支援。
en: Naval firepower is similarly largely absent from the People's Liberation Army's (PLA's) portfolio, though amphibious forces can provide much of their own firepower support through amphibious tanks, assault guns, and mortars.

zh: 各類營都操作建制的中型迫擊砲，而合成旅（CA-BDE）則在其建制的火力支援營中，運用重型迫擊砲、榴彈砲與火箭砲兵（多管火箭發射器——MRL）。
en: Battalions of all types operate organic medium mortars, while combined arms brigades (CA-BDEs) employ heavy mortars, howitzers, and rocket artillery (multiple rocket launchers—MRLs) in their organic fire support battalions.

zh: 這些單位可由集團軍保留，以對關鍵目標集中火力，也可任務編組下放到合成旅，以增強合成旅的火力。
en: These units may be retained by the group army to mass fires on a critical target, or they may be task-organized down to the CA-BDE in order to enhance the CA-BDE's firepower.

zh: 合成旅的建制火力大致相當於美國旅戰鬥隊（BCT）：27門火砲，加上一個輕型火箭連。
en: The CA-BDE's organic firepower is roughly equivalent to that of a U.S. brigade combat team (BCT): 27 guns, along with a light rocket battery.

zh: 合成旅的火砲大多是122毫米（mm），而旅戰鬥隊的火砲則以155毫米為主，但旅戰鬥隊缺乏建制的火箭能力。
en: Most of the CA-BDE's guns are 122 millimeter (mm) versus the predominantly 155-mm guns of the BCTs, but the BCT lacks an organic rocket capability.

zh: 增援火力的密度與破壞性火力，強烈有利於解放軍陸軍。
en: The density and destructive firepower of reinforcing fires is strongly in the PLAA's favor.

zh: 砲兵旅最多包含72門火砲，另外最多40具各種口徑的多管火箭發射器。
en: The artillery brigade includes up to 72 guns, plus up to 40 MRLs of various caliber.

zh: 射擊指揮、目標指定與前進觀測，也是解放軍陸軍的主要投資領域。
en: Fire direction, targeting, and forward observation have also been major areas of investment for the PLAA.

zh: 中國是全球無人飛行載具系統生產與發展的領導者，解放軍陸軍是將無人飛行載具作為情報、監視與偵察平台以支援其砲兵——特別是其長程火箭砲兵——的早期採用者。
en: China is the world leader in unmanned aircraft system production and development, and the PLAA was an early adopter of unmanned aircraft as intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance platforms in support of its artillery—particularly its long-range rocket artillery.

zh: 合成旅砲兵營包括火源定位雷達、戰場監視雷達、長程光電與紅外線感測器，以及聲測設備，此外還有裝備精良的前進觀測員，包括乘車與徒步的。
en: CA-BDE artillery battalions include fire-finding radars, battlefield surveillance radars, long-range electro-optical and infrared sensors, and sound-ranging equipment, in addition to well-equipped forward observers, both mounted and dismounted.

zh: 各類觀察員很可能受過良好訓練，感測器與射擊單位之間的整合很可能靈活、備援且可靠。
en: Observers of all types are likely well trained, and integration between sensors and shooters is likely agile, redundant, and reliable.

zh: 解放軍陸軍運用種類繁多的火砲、迫擊砲與火箭。
en: The PLAA employs a huge variety of guns, mortars, and rockets.

zh: 與裝甲車輛的情況非常類似，同類型的單位可能擁有能力差異極大的系統。
en: Much like with armored vehicles, units of the same type may possess systems with very different capabilities.

zh: 自走砲（SPG）與多管火箭發射器獲得大量投資，系統已大部分完全現代化，而許多牽引式與迫擊砲系統可追溯至至少1960年代。
en: Self-propelled guns (SPGs) and MRLs received enormous investments and have largely completely modernized systems, while many towed and mortar systems can be dated back to at least the 1960s.

zh: 87式迫擊砲是整個解放軍陸軍、預備役與民兵單位所運用的標準輕型迫擊砲。
en: The Type 87 mortar is the standard light mortar employed throughout the PLAA, reserves, and militia units.

zh: 這些迫擊砲是輕型合成營（CA-BN）的基本間接火力，每個營在火力連中運用相當於一個砲兵連數量的迫擊砲（12至16門）。
en: These mortars are the basic indirect firepower of the light combined arms battalion (CA-BN), with each battalion employing a battery's worth of mortars (12 to 16 tubes) in the firepower company.

zh: 87式為單兵攜帶式，不過以81或82毫米的標準而言相當重。
en: The Type 87 is man-portable, though it is rather heavy by 81 or 82-mm standards.

zh: 它是牽引式系統，被解放軍陸軍稱為速射迫擊砲，具有令人印象深刻的射速，遠超過人力搬運的81或82毫米迫擊砲型號。
en: A towed system, it is referred to by the PLAA as a rapid-fire mortar, and it is capable of an impressive rate of fire, far surpassing that of man-packed 81 or 82-mm mortar types.

zh: 然而，它確實需要明顯更多的支援，包括牽引車與更多彈藥。
en: It does, however, require significantly more support, including a prime mover and more ammunition.

zh: 它不是單兵攜帶式，但代表步兵營可用火力的大幅增加。
en: It is not man-portable, but it represents a significant increase in the firepower available to the infantry battalion.

zh: 美軍編隊並不具備這項能力。
en: This capability is not replicated in U.S. formations.

zh: 54式榴彈砲是源自第二次世界大戰時期蘇聯M-30的簡易122毫米山砲。
en: The Type 54 howitzer is a simple 122-mm pack gun derived from the World War II-era Soviet M-30.

zh: 儘管年代久遠，M-30／54式仍廣泛配備，幾乎肯定是當今世界上數量最多的輕型榴彈砲設計。
en: Despite its advanced age, the M-30/Type 54 is still widely fielded and is almost certainly the most numerous light howitzer design in the world today.

zh: 中國的設計多年來定期升級，變得更輕、可靠性與射速提高，並簡化行軍序列與砲陣地開設程序。
en: Chinese designs were periodically upgraded over the years, becoming lighter, increasing reliability and rate of fire, and simplifying march-order and emplacement procedures.

zh: 雖然老舊，54式的性能大致與現代105毫米砲相當，不過比大多數當代輕型榴彈砲稍重。
en: While old, the Type 54's performance is roughly in line with modern 105-mm guns, though it is somewhat heavier than most contemporary light howitzers.

zh: 它提供輕型合成旅砲兵火力的主體，且仍裝備許多砲兵旅的牽引式榴彈砲營。
en: It provides the bulk of the artillery firepower for the light CA-BDE, and it still equips many of the towed howitzer battalions of the artillery brigades.

zh: 54式最常見的演進版本是83式與86式，兩者都是1980年代的再開發型，具有更優越的底盤技術與更高的射速。
en: The most common evolved versions of the Type 54 are the Type 83 and Type 86, both redevelopments from the 1980s that feature superior chassis technology and increased rates of fire.

zh: 54式家族是用途廣泛的系統。
en: The Type 54 family is a versatile system.

zh: 它既可提供間接火力也可提供直射火力，解放軍陸軍部隊並訓練將這些系統作為直射反裝甲砲運用，除了其砲兵角色之外。
en: It can provide both indirect or direct fire, and PLAA forces train to employ these systems as direct-fire antitank guns in addition to their role as artillery.

zh: 66式榴彈砲是另一款蘇聯設計，以D-20 152毫米榴彈砲為基礎。
en: The Type 66 howitzer is another Soviet design, based around the D-20 152-mm howitzer.

zh: 66式是一款大而重的火砲，以現代標準而言性能中等偏差，但若能稱職地集中運用，仍可發揮決定性的火力。
en: The Type 66 is a large and heavy gun with middling-to-poor performance by modern standards, but when employed competently and in mass, it can still deliver decisive firepower.

zh: 該系統簡單而堅固，能在簡陋環境中以最低限度的維修支援作業。
en: The system is simple and robust, able to operate in austere environments with minimal maintenance support.

zh: 其射速與較現代的火砲相似，但發射一般彈藥時，射程與精準度明顯較差。
en: Its rate of fire is similar to that of more modern guns, but its range and accuracy are significantly worse when firing conventional ammunition.

zh: 火箭輔助彈藥與精準導引砲彈在一定程度上彌補了這些限制，但其可用性有限。
en: Rocket-assisted ammunition and precision-guided rounds offset these limitations somewhat, but their availability is limited.

zh: 66式裝備解放軍陸軍砲兵旅的重型牽引砲兵連，用於為機動作戰提供重型火力支援。
en: The Type 66 equips the heavy towed batteries of PLAA artillery brigades, and it is used to provide heavy fire support for maneuver operations.

zh: PLZ-89是解放軍陸軍最廣泛使用的自走砲（SPG）。
en: The PLZ-89 is the PLAA's most widely used SPG.

zh: PLZ-89的性能與防護都不突出，但該系統堅固且易於運用。
en: The performance and protection of the PLZ-89 are both unremarkable, but the system is robust and easy to employ.

zh: 解放軍陸軍在其編隊中運用約700輛PLZ-89；幾乎全部都在中型或重型合成旅的砲兵營中。
en: The PLAA employs around 700 PLZ-89s throughout its formations; nearly all are in the artillery battalions of medium or heavy CA-BDEs.

zh: SH-3是最近的現代化衍生型，提供改良的射控與機動性。
en: The SH-3 is a recent modernized variant, offering improved fire control and mobility.

zh: PLZ-07是解放軍陸軍最新的122毫米自走砲。
en: The PLZ-07 is the PLAA's newest 122-mm SPG.

zh: 它採用PLZ-89砲的現代化版本，該砲本身源自過時的蘇聯D-30，不過其性能因現代化射控與先進彈藥而改善。
en: It employs a modernized version of the PLZ-89's gun, itself derived from the obsolete Soviet D-30, though its performance is improved with modernized fire control and advanced ammunition.

zh: PLZ-07的主要進步，是使用現代化的ZBD-04裝甲運兵車（APC）作為其底盤，使其越野與水陸兩用性能、射程與可靠性優於較舊的自走砲。
en: The primary advance of the PLZ-07 is the use of the modern ZBD-04 armored personnel carrier (APC) as its chassis, giving it improved cross-country and amphibious performance, greater range, and improved reliability versus older SPGs.

zh: PLZ-07很可能會大量生產，最終取代整個解放軍陸軍所有較舊的PLZ-89子型。
en: The PLZ-07 will likely be produced in large numbers, eventually replacing all of the older PLZ-89 subtypes throughout the PLAA.

zh: 與較舊的系統一樣，PLZ-07在火砲口徑上不及155毫米系統，但其機動性與簡易性，使其非常適合近距離支援機動編隊。
en: Like the older system, the PLZ-07 is outgunned by 155-mm systems, but its mobility and simplicity make it very well adapted for closely supporting maneuver formations.

zh: PLZ-83是解放軍陸軍第一款重型履帶式自走砲，將66式榴彈砲的火砲與蘇聯通用重型裝甲戰鬥車輛（AFV）底盤結合。
en: The PLZ-83 was the PLAA's first heavy tracked SPG, mating the gun from the Type 66 howitzer with a generic Soviet heavy armored fighting vehicle (AFV) chassis.

zh: 雖然152毫米砲相比廣泛配備的122毫米型號提供了增強的火力，但解放軍陸軍對PLZ-83的機動性與可靠性並不滿意。
en: Though the 152-mm gun provided enhanced firepower compared to the widely fielded 122-mm models, the PLAA was dissatisfied with the PLZ-83's mobility and reliability.

zh: 該砲的彈道性能也很差。
en: The ballistic performance of the gun was also poor.

zh: 配備數量相對較少，解放軍陸軍起初以它們裝備師砲兵單位，如今則以它們裝備砲兵旅內的個別砲兵連。
en: Relatively small numbers were fielded, with the PLAA initially equipping division artillery units with them, and today equipping individual batteries within artillery brigades with them.

zh: 這些系統仍在服役，不過預定由更現代的系統取代。
en: These systems are still in service, though they are set to be replaced by more-modern systems.

zh: PLZ-05是解放軍陸軍新的重型自走砲，將新的155毫米砲與專門研製的輕型裝甲戰鬥車輛底盤結合。
en: The PLZ-05 is the PLAA's new heavy SPG, mating a new 155-mm gun with a specially developed light AFV chassis.

zh: PLZ-05能運用多種彈藥，並享有完全現代化155毫米火砲系統令人印象深刻的射程與精準度。
en: The PLZ-05 can employ a wide variety of munitions and enjoys the impressive range and accuracy of a fully modernized 155-mm gun system.

zh: 此外，PLZ-05採用自動裝填機，將其持續射速提升至每分鐘10發，並具備15秒內3發的爆發射擊能力。
en: In addition, the PLZ-05 employs an autoloader, increasing its sustained rate of fire to 10 rounds per minute, with a 3-rounds-in-15-seconds burst capability.

zh: PLZ-05在大多數方面可與其他先進自走砲相比，並代表解放軍陸軍間接火力能力的重大提升。
en: The PLZ-05 is comparable to other advanced SPGs in most respects, and it represents a major increase in indirect-fire capability for the PLAA.

zh: 隨著較舊的PLZ-83逐步淘汰，所有砲兵旅最終很可能都會運用一個營數量的PLZ-05。
en: It is likely that all artillery brigades will eventually employ a battalion's worth of PLZ-05s as the older PLZ-83s are phased out.

zh: PLZ-05是非常大型且重的系統，有大量的支援需求，但其越野機動性仍然優異。
en: The PLZ-05 is a very large and heavy system with substantial support requirements, but its cross-country mobility remains excellent.

zh: PHL-81是解放軍陸軍分布最廣的122毫米多管火箭發射器。
en: The PHL-81 is the PLAA's most widely distributed 122-mm MRL.

zh: PHL-81是源自蘇聯BM-21的簡易卡車載式設計，為合成旅砲兵營與砲兵旅提供長程破壞性火力。
en: A simple truck-mounted design derived from the Soviet BM-21, the PHL-81 provides both CA-BDE artillery battalions and artillery brigades with long-range destructive firepower.

zh: 儘管PHL-81源自1960年代的設計，但已定期升級為數位射控與各種彈藥，包括高爆彈、反裝甲子彈藥、燃料空氣彈、煙霧彈與布雷彈。
en: Though the PHL-81 is derived from a 1960s-era design, it has been periodically upgraded with digital fire control and a wide variety of munitions, including HE, antitank submunitions, fuel-air, smoke, and mine scattering.

zh: 更專門的彈藥類型，包括射頻干擾、燃燒與化學彈，過去或在其他國家曾生產，解放軍陸軍部隊也可能可以取得。
en: More-specialized types of ammunition, including radio-frequency jamming, incendiary, and chemical, have been produced in the past or in other nations, and they may be available to PLAA forces.

zh: 精準導引的122毫米砲彈也可能可用，不過其成本與複雜性限制了它們的擴散。
en: Precision-guided 122-mm rounds may also be available, though their cost and complexity limit their proliferation.

zh: 現代化的122毫米砲彈標稱射程約為50公里（km）。
en: Nominal range for the modernized 122-mm rounds is around 50 kilometers (kms).

zh: PHZ-89基本上是PHL-81的履帶式版本，研製目的是支援解放軍陸軍機械化與裝甲兵力的作業。
en: The PHZ-89 is essentially a tracked version of the PHL-81, developed to operate in support of PLAA mechanized and armored forces.

zh: 這些系統具備快速重新裝填能力，使第二個火箭莢能在幾分鐘內發射，基本上使一個砲兵連對時效性目標的火力加倍。
en: These systems feature a rapid-reload capability, enabling a second rocket pod to be fired within minutes and essentially doubling a battery's firepower against a time-sensitive target.

zh: PHL-81與PHZ-89預計在相對近期內，都將由國產系統取代。
en: Both the PHL-81 and the PHZ-89 are set to be replaced with domestically produced systems in the relatively near future.

zh: PHL-11是新的輪型衍生型，而PHZ-11則是履帶式。
en: The PHL-11 is the new wheeled variant, and the PHZ-11 as the tracked.

zh: PHL-03是解放軍陸軍版的蘇聯或俄羅斯BM-30龍捲風，一款廣泛擴散的重型（300毫米）多管火箭發射器。
en: The PHL-03 is the PLAA's version of the Soviet or Russian BM-30 Smerch, a widely proliferated heavy (300-mm) MRL.

zh: PHL-03連為解放軍陸軍砲兵旅提供長程打擊火力。
en: PHL-03 batteries provide long-range striking power for the PLAA's artillery brigades.

zh: 每一根發射管都必須單獨重新裝填，而不是更換火箭莢。
en: Each tube must be reloaded separately, rather than exchanging a pod.

zh: 東風-11是中國人民解放軍火箭軍（PLARF）運用最廣泛的短程彈道飛彈（SRBM）。
en: The DF-11 is the People's Liberation Army Rocket Force's (PLARF's) most widely employed short-range ballistic missile (SRBM).

zh: 最初設計是向戰區指揮官提供射程達300公里的作戰層級面積火力，後續版本已將射程擴大到超過700公里。
en: Originally designed to provide operational-level area fires out to 300 kms to theater commanders, subsequent versions have expanded the range out past 700 kms.

zh: 準確度也已提升，將圓周誤差機率降低至僅30公尺，使戰區指揮官具備長程精準打擊能力。
en: Accuracy has also increased, reducing circular error probable to only 30 meters, giving theater commanders a long-range precision strike capability.

zh: 東風-11可運用傳統與核彈頭；傳統彈頭可為高爆子彈藥或燃料空氣炸藥。
en: The DF-11 can employ both conventional and nuclear warheads; conventional warheads may be either HE submunition or fuel-air explosive.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍能以其東風-11車隊執行結構化攻擊，固體燃料火箭與機動運輸起豎發射車使快速發射與重新裝填作業成為可能。
en: The PLARF is capable of structured attacks with its DF-11 fleet, and the solid-fuel rocket and mobile transporter-erector-launchers enable rapid launch and reload operations.

zh: 東風-15／16是較新的系統家族，提供解放軍火箭軍作戰層級火力支援能力的主體。
en: The DF-15/16 is a newer family of systems that provides the bulk of the PLARF's operational-level fire support capability.

zh: 這些系統的射程介於600公里與1,000公里之間，並運用用於對抗反彈道飛彈的先進對抗措施，例如終端機動與誘餌。
en: These systems range between 600 kms and 1,000 kms, and they employ advanced antiballistic missile countermeasures such as terminal maneuvers and decoys.

zh: 早期衍生型的準確度不足以進行精準打擊，但現代化衍生型的圓周誤差機率為30公尺或更低。
en: Early variants were not accurate enough for precision strikes, but modernized variants enjoy a circular error probable of 30 meters or less.

zh: 這些飛彈可運用核或傳統彈頭，且酬載（超過600公斤）明顯大於大多數短程彈道飛彈。B-611是新的短程彈道飛彈系統，很可能力求複製蘇聯SS-26伊斯坎德爾的能力。
en: These missiles can employ nuclear or conventional warheads, and have a significantly larger payload (over 600 kilograms) than do most SRBMs. The B-611 is a new SRBM system that likely seeks to replicate the capabilities of the Soviet SS-26 Iskander.

zh: 其能力包括500公里射程、先進突防輔助裝置、良好機動性、快速重新裝填與精準目標指定。
en: Its capabilities include a 500-km range, advanced penetration aids, good mobility, rapid reload, and precision targeting.

zh: B-611很可能旨在以增強的突防武器補足300毫米火箭級，使得在更一般的打擊之前，就能鎖定並摧毀反彈道飛彈系統。
en: The B-611 is likely intended to complement the 300-mm rocket class with an enhanced penetration weapon, enabling the targeting and destruction of antiballistic missile systems prior to more general targeting.

zh: 本節只討論可能用於支援戰術編隊的解放軍火箭軍彈道飛彈；不包括長程或洲際彈道飛彈（ICBM）。
en: This section only discusses PLARF ballistic missiles that may be employed in support of tactical formations; it does not include long-range or intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs).

zh: 各類砲兵——迫擊砲、管式砲與火箭——以相當高的密度部署於解放軍陸軍的每種類型編隊。
en: Artillery of all types—mortars, tubes, and rockets—is deployed in significant density across every type of PLAA formation.

zh: 火力支援與機動作業有效整合。
en: Fire support is integrated effectively with maneuver operations.

zh: 目標指定可以分散，由較低梯隊指揮官整合砲兵觀測員、無人飛行載具（UA）與其他監視資產。
en: Targeting can be decentralized, with lower echelon commanders integrating artillery spotters, unmanned aircraft (UA), and other surveillance assets.

zh: 集中火力仍被視為砲兵部隊的主要目標，砲兵指揮官通常會力求將火力集中於其系統射程內最有價值的目標。
en: Massed fires are still considered the primary objective of artillery forces, and artillery commanders will generally seek to mass fires on the most valuable targets within range of their systems.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的牽引式系統比西方對應型號更老舊也更重，但仍具備足夠的戰術機動性，以完成其火力支援任務。
en: PLAA towed systems are much older and heavier than their Western counterparts, but they still have adequate tactical mobility to accomplish their fire support tasks.

zh: 解放軍陸軍依靠密度與集中來完成這些任務，砲兵的後勤支援很可能是其主要限制之一。
en: The PLAA relies on density and mass to accomplish these tasks, and logistics support for artillery is likely one of its primary limitations.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的後勤支援密度低於西方軍隊——特別是美國陸軍——因此維持作戰砲兵單位的彈藥需求，可能是重大挑戰。
en: The PLAA has a lower density of logistics support than do Western militaries—particularly the U.S. Army—and so sustaining ammunition requirements for operational artillery units may prove a significant challenge.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的自走砲比西方對應型號輕得多，射程與火力都不及，但具有絕佳的越野機動性，且持續支援需求較容易滿足。
en: PLAA SPGs are considerably lighter than their Western counterparts, and they are both outranged and outgunned, but they have fantastic cross-country mobility and easier sustainment requirements.

zh: 它透過運用不同彈藥，混合多種不同效果，整合於簡易、堅固、機動的底盤上。
en: It mixes a wide variety of different effects through the use of different munitions, integrated on simple, robust, mobile chassis.

zh: 這些系統與前進觀測員及其他監視資產審慎整合，以充分發揮其破壞潛力。
en: These systems are carefully integrated with forward observers and other surveillance assets to make the most of their destructive potential.

zh: 精準彈藥使用各種導引方法，包括雷射標定、慣性、衛星、影像與雷達。
en: Precision munitions use a variety of guidance methods, including laser targeting, inertial, satellite, imagery, and radar.

zh: 高階彈道飛彈採用多種方法，在極遠射程提升準確度。
en: High-end ballistic missiles employ multiple methods to enhance accuracy at extreme ranges.

zh: 解放軍陸軍測定目標座標的程序並不為人所知，但很可能不如美軍的程序精準。
en: The PLAA process for mensurating a target is not well known, but is likely less precise than U.S. processes.

zh: 然而，支援目標指定的決策過程，很可能經過充分預演且縝密——部分原因是1999年美國飛機轟炸中國駐貝爾格勒大使館所引發的反應。
en: The decision-making process supporting targeting, however, is likely well-rehearsed and meticulous—in part due to reactions from the bombing of the Chinese embassy in Belgrade by American aircraft in 1999.

zh: 與其俄羅斯對應單位一樣，解放軍陸軍的火力支援單位非常擔心反砲兵火力的威脅，並投入大量資源於反砲兵作業。
en: Like their Russian counterparts, PLAA fire support elements are very concerned with the counterfire threat, and significant resources are given over to counterfire operations.

zh: 解放軍陸軍砲兵單位通常具有良好的戰術機動性，並實行簡單的「射後即走」方法來避免反砲兵火力，同時審慎隱蔽其陣地，以免遭受空中攻擊與觀測。
en: PLAA artillery units generally have good tactical mobility and practice the simple "shoot-and-scoot" methodology to avoid counterfire, while carefully concealing their positions from aerial attack and observation.

zh: 解放軍陸軍運用多種反砲兵系統，包括聲測、雷達與目視手段，且反砲兵任務被高度優先考量。
en: The PLAA employs a variety of counterfire systems including sounding, radars, and visual means, and counterfire missions are highly prioritized.

zh: 地面防空在整個中國人民解放軍陸軍（PLAA）中無所不在，試圖彌補聯合空中力量的不足。
en: Ground-based air defenses are ubiquitous throughout the People's Liberation Army Army (PLAA), attempting to offset shortfalls in joint airpower.

zh: 每個大於連的機動編隊都配備建制的防空能力，較大的組織則運用多種防空系統的組合，以創造合成兵種效果。
en: Every maneuver formation larger than a company fields an organic air defense capability, and larger organizations employ a mixture of air defense systems to create a combined arms effect.

zh: 數量與縱深是解放軍陸軍防空的關鍵字。
en: Mass and depth are the operative words for PLAA air defense.

zh: 其大多數短程系統相對原始，缺乏對抗現代空中威脅的能力。
en: Most of its short-range systems are relatively primitive and lack capability against modern air threats.

zh: 然而，它們非常密集而廣泛地部署於戰場，對低空空中威脅形成嚇阻效果。
en: They are, however, deployed very densely and broadly across the battlefield, creating a deterrent effect against low-altitude air threats.

zh: 中程與長程系統的殺傷力顯著更強，能夠在任何高度對抗先進空中威脅。
en: Medium- and long-range systems are significantly more lethal, capable of standing off against advanced air threats at any altitude.

zh: 防空旅另外增加一個電子防空營，運用多種電子戰系統，著重於擊敗或癱瘓敵方空中威脅。
en: Air defense brigades also add an electronic air defense battalion that employs a variety of electronic warfare systems focused on defeating or neutralizing the enemy air threat.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的系統可能完全數位整合進更廣泛的整合防空系統（IADS），也可能沒有。
en: PLAA systems may or may not be fully digitally integrated into a wider integrated air defense system (IADS).

zh: 陸軍單位具備一路向下數位整合到個別火砲或飛彈小組的能力，但不清楚這項能力是否已配備。
en: Army units have the capability for digital integration all the way down to individual gun or missile teams, but it is not clear if this capability is fielded.

zh: 程序性管制，例如空域管制措施與武器管制狀態，很可能是大多數解放軍陸軍防空單位的主要射擊管制方法，中程地對空飛彈單位除外。
en: Procedural controls such as airspace control measures and weapon control statuses are likely the dominant methods of fire control for most PLAA air defense units, excepting the medium-range SAM units.

zh: 較長程的地對空飛彈系統由中國人民解放軍空軍（PLAAF）操作，作為全國性整合防空系統的一部分。
en: Longer-range SAM systems are operated by the People's Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) as part of a nationwide IADS.

zh: 解放軍空軍的長程地對空飛彈營完全數位整合，並很可能由戰區集中管制，與固定翼防禦性反制空中作戰相配合。
en: PLAAF long-range SAM battalions are fully digitally integrated and likely centrally controlled by theater commands in cooperation with fixed-wing defensive counterair operations.

zh: 中程地對空飛彈單位也由解放軍空軍操作，用於保衛長程系統免受側面或突然出現的攻擊，或彌補地對空飛彈涵蓋的缺口。
en: Medium-range SAM units are also operated by the PLAAF, used either to defend long-range systems from oblique or pop-up attacks or to bridge gaps in SAM coverage.

zh: 解放軍空軍將其長程地對空飛彈系統設想為廣域拒止武器，能夠拒止敵機使用空域，並從地面創造空中優勢，或至少是空中均勢。
en: The PLAAF envisions its long-range SAM systems as wide area denial weapons, able to deny the use of airspace to enemy aircraft and create air superiority, or at least air parity, from the ground.

zh: 這些系統運用先進的反精準導引彈藥與電子反反制措施，以及各種攔截彈類型與先進的網路化感測器。
en: These systems employ advanced counter-precision-guided munitions and electronic counter-countermeasures along with a variety of interceptor types and advanced, networked sensors.

zh: PG-87是解放軍陸軍庫存中最普遍的牽引式防空砲，有數千門裝備輕型合成旅（CA-BDE）、預備役單位與民兵單位。
en: The PG-87 is the most widespread towed antiaircraft gun in the PLAA's inventory, with several thousand units equipping light combined arms brigades (CA-BDEs), reserve units, and militia units.

zh: PG-87是廣泛擴散的蘇聯ZU-23的加大火砲口徑衍生型，於1960年首次配備。
en: The PG-87 is an up-gunned variant of the widely proliferated Soviet ZU-23, first fielded in 1960.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的衍生型採用兩根發射25毫米彈藥的砲管——與蘇聯的23毫米相對——使中國武器射程與殺傷力增加。
en: PLAA variants employ two barrels firing 25-millimeter (mm) ammunition—in contrast to the Soviet 23 mm—giving Chinese weapons increased range and lethality.

zh: PG-87進一步升級為增強的目標指定（包括紅外線瞄準具與射控雷達）、改良的訓練與指向機構，以及較大的彈匣。
en: The PG-87 was further upgraded with enhanced targeting (including an infrared sight and fire control radar), improved training and direction mechanisms, and larger ammunition magazines.

zh: PG-87可發射多種彈藥類型，包括高爆彈、穿甲彈與曳光彈。
en: The PG-87 can fire a variety of ammunition types, including high explosive, armor piercing, and tracer.

zh: PG-87的射程限於兩公里（km），但對進入其交戰包線的各類空中目標都具有殺傷力。
en: The PG-87's range is limited to two kilometers (kms), but it is lethal against aerial targets of all types that enter its engagement envelope.

zh: 解放軍陸軍也以直射模式運用其PG-87火砲對付地面目標。
en: The PLAA also employs its PG-87 guns in direct-fire mode against ground targets.

zh: 在此角色中，其25毫米彈藥的性能與步兵戰車（IFV）自動砲相似。
en: Its 25-mm ammunition has similar performance to infantry fighting vehicle (IFV) autocannons in this role.

zh: PG-99是較新的牽引式雙管35毫米系統，很可能源自厄利空GDF系列火砲。
en: The PG-99 is a newer towed twin 35-mm system likely derived from the Oerlikon GDF family of guns.

zh: PG-99運用多種不同的搜索與追蹤感測器，包括光電目視感測器、雷射測距儀，以及與支援雷達的數位整合。
en: The PG-99 makes use of a variety of different search and tracking sensors, including an electro-optical visual sensor, a laser range finder, and digital integration with supporting radars.

zh: 旋轉與俯仰迅速且有機械輔助，該火砲具有絕佳的機動性。
en: Traverse and elevation are rapid and mechanically assisted, and the gun has excellent mobility.

zh: 其開設時間不到兩分鐘。
en: Its emplacement time is less than two minutes.

zh: PG-99可發射高爆彈、燃燒彈與穿甲彈，射程超過四公里，也可對包括輕型裝甲車在內的地面目標交戰。
en: The PG-99 can fire high explosive, incendiary, and armor piercing rounds past four kms, and it can also engage ground targets, including light armored vehicles.

zh: PG-99的火砲系統也是許多解放軍陸軍自走防空砲與混合系統的主要武器，簡化持續支援與乘員訓練需求。
en: The PG-99's gun system is also the primary weapon for many of the PLAA's SPAAGs and hybrid systems, simplifying sustainment and crew training requirements.

zh: PGZ-04享有與其裝甲運兵車及步兵戰車對應型號相同的防護，且很可能具有相當的機動性。
en: The PGZ-04 enjoys the same protection as its APC and IFV counterparts, and it likely has comparable mobility.

zh: 其感測器組包括與解放軍陸軍牽引式火砲相同的光電、紅外線與雷射測距儀，並增加一具短程低空搜索雷達。
en: Its sensor suite includes the same electro-optical, infrared, and laser rangefinder as the PLAA's towed guns and it adds a short-range, low-altitude search radar.

zh: 25毫米砲的射程約兩公里，而QW-2飛彈可達六公里。
en: The 25-mm guns have a range of around two kms, while the QW-2 missiles can reach out to six kms.

zh: 射擊準則很可能指示乘員運用火砲對付低速低空目標，例如無人飛行載具，將飛彈保留用於防區外對付更危險的高性能威脅，例如直升機。
en: Firing doctrine likely instructs crews to employ guns against low and slow targets such as unmanned aircraft, reserving the missiles for standing off more-dangerous high-performance threats such as helicopters.

zh: 乘員也訓練以25毫米砲對付地面目標。
en: Crews train to employ the 25-mm guns against ground targets as well.

zh: PGZ-07／09是建造在PLZ-05底盤上的重型自走防空砲。
en: The PGZ-07/09 is a heavy SPAAG built on the PLZ-05 chassis.

zh: PGZ-09也可能運用短程紅外線飛彈（很可能與PGZ-04相同的QW-2），不過尚未獲得證實。
en: The PGZ-09 may also employ short-range infrared missiles (likely the same QW-2 as the PGZ-04), though this is unconfirmed.

zh: 35毫米砲可發射多種彈藥類型，射程超過四公里，也可對地面目標交戰：PGZ-09的火砲在直射角色中的火力，超越幾乎所有現有的步兵戰車。
en: The 35-mm guns employ a variety of ammunition types out past four kms, and they can also engage ground targets: the firepower of the PGZ-09's guns in a direct-fire role surpasses nearly every existing IFV.

zh: PGZ-07補足重型合成旅防空營中的PGZ-04，並也配備於防空旅。
en: The PGZ-07s complement the PGZ-04s in the heavy CA-BDE's air defense battalion, and they are also fielded in the air defense brigade.

zh: HN-5是中國第一款攜帶型防空飛彈（MANPADS），由蘇聯9K32 Strela-2的早期衍生型發展而來。
en: The HN-5 is China's first MANPADS, developed from the early variants of the Soviet 9K32 Strela-2.

zh: 與美國及蘇聯相比，中國發展攜帶型防空飛彈較晚，當HN-5達到作戰可用狀態時，它已經過時。
en: China was late in developing MANPADS as compared to the U.S. and the Soviets, and by the time the HN-5 reached operational status it was already obsolete.

zh: 升級衍生型在1980年代與1990年代期間陸續生產，包括全方位版本，不過這些如今對現代對抗措施也大多無效。
en: Upgraded variants were produced throughout the 1980s and 1990s, including an all-aspect version, though these too are now largely ineffective against modern countermeasures.

zh: HN-5宣稱射程為四公里，但此距離受到相位角的顯著限制。
en: The HN-5 claims a range of four kms, but this distance is significantly limited by aspect angle.

zh: HN-5衍生型作為背負式武器使用，並安裝在各類戰術車輛上——特別是輕型輪型車輛——搭配數位光電射控感測器。
en: HN-5 variants are employed as man-pack weapons and mounted on tactical vehicles of all types—particularly light wheeled vehicles—mated with a digital electro-optical fire control sensors.

zh: 其餘的HN-5／5A／5B飛彈由預備役與民兵單位使用，它們可能仍能有效對付缺乏現代化攜帶型防空飛彈對抗措施的較大型無人平台或較舊的軍用飛機。
en: The remaining HN-5/5A/5B rounds are employed by reserve and militia units, and they may still effectively engage larger unmanned platforms or older military aircraft that lack modernized MANPADS countermeasures.

zh: FN-6是歐洲西北風系統的逆向工程仿製品。
en: The FN-6 is a reverse-engineered copy of the European Mistral system.

zh: 雖然技術上仍是攜帶型防空飛彈，FN-6是比大多數攜帶型防空飛彈更重也更強大的飛彈，最適合用於車載平台或穩定的地面陣地。
en: Though technically still a MANPADS, the FN-6 is a heavier and more-powerful missile than most MANPADS, and it is best suited for use on vehicle-mounted platforms or from stabilized ground positions.

zh: 解放軍陸軍在各種車輛上運用FN-6衍生型，最著名的是FN-6A。
en: The PLAA employs FN-6 variants on a wide variety of vehicles, most notably the FN-6A.

zh: 未來大多數短程防空車輛很可能會採用FN-6及其演進衍生型——例如FN-16——作為專用的短程防空系統，或依需要作為附加選項。
en: It is likely that most future SHORAD vehicles will employ the FN-6 and evolved variants—such as the FN-16—as either a dedicated SHORAD system or a bolt-on option, as required.

zh: FN-6是全方位武器，射程超過六公里。
en: The FN-6 is an all-aspect weapon with a range of more than six kms.

zh: QW-1／2是解放軍陸軍最新且最先進的攜帶型防空飛彈。
en: The QW-1/2 are the PLAA's newest and most advanced MANPADS.

zh: 它們很可能是俄羅斯9K310伊格拉-1系統的逆向工程或粗略仿製品。
en: They are likely reverse-engineered or rough copies of the Russian 9K310 Igla-1 system.

zh: 每一種都是輕型肩射式系統，具有先進的紅外線尋標器與持續升級的反反制措施。
en: Each is a lightweight, shoulder-fired system with an advanced infrared seeker and continuously upgraded counter-countermeasures.

zh: 較新的QW-2已升級，以提升其對非常低空與高速移動目標的性能，並可能使其具備反巡弋飛彈能力。
en: The newer QW-2 has been upgraded to increase its performance against very low and fast-moving targets, potentially giving it a counter-cruise missile capability.

zh: QW系列也安裝在種類繁多的車輛上，從輕型輪型系統到重型裝甲系統。
en: The QW series is also mounted on a vast array of vehicles, ranging from light wheeled systems to heavy armored systems.

zh: 這些系統大多僅採用目視與紅外線感測器，不過部分整合短程雷達。
en: Most of these systems employ only visual and infrared sensors, though some integrate short-range radars.

zh: QW系列飛彈的射程約為六公里。
en: QW-series missiles have a range of roughly six kms.

zh: 中國的攜帶型防空飛彈系統由稱為SmartHunter的先進指揮管制系統提供賦能。
en: Chinese MANPADS systems are enabled by an advanced command and control system called SmartHunter.

zh: 該系統包括先進的短程雷達、敵我識別能力，以及支援攜帶型防空飛彈小組分散作業的網路骨幹。
en: This system includes an advanced short-range radar, identification of friend and foe capability, and network backbone to support decentralized operations by MANPADS teams.

zh: SmartHunter為車載且具戰術機動性，能在先進或簡陋地區提供高品質的防空感測器與射控支援。
en: SmartHunter is vehicle-mounted and tactically mobile, able to provide a high-quality air defense sensor and fire control support in advanced or austere areas.

zh: 紅旗-6D是短程系統，結合源自美國AIM-7麻雀飛彈的半主動雷達導引攔截彈，以及卡車載式運輸起豎發射車（TEL）。
en: The HQ-6D is a short-range system that combines a semi-active radar-homing interceptor—derived from the U.S. AIM-7 Sparrow—and a truck-mounted transporter-erector-launcher (TEL).

zh: 一個紅旗-6D連包括一部中程監視雷達、追蹤雷達，以及最多八具運輸起豎發射車，每具有四枚待發飛彈。
en: An HQ-6D battery includes a medium-range surveillance radar, tracking radars, and up to eight TELs, each with four ready missiles.

zh: 紅旗-6D的殺傷力與存活力都不如較現代的主動雷達導引系統，但仍用於對付低飛飛機與巡弋飛彈的定點防禦任務。
en: The HQ-6D is less lethal and less survivable than more-modern active radar-homing systems, but it is still used for point defense missions against low-flying aircraft and cruise missiles.

zh: 演進版本可在營級梯隊集中管制，並可整合進戰區整合防空系統。
en: Evolved versions can be centrally controlled at the battalion echelon, and they can be integrated into a theater IADS.

zh: 紅旗-6D攔截彈的斜距射程約為18公里。
en: The HQ-6D's interceptor has a slant range of roughly 18 kms.

zh: 紅旗-6D是解放軍空軍運用的主要短程系統。
en: The HQ-6D is the primary short-range system employed by the PLAAF.

zh: 紅旗-7是以法國響尾蛇為基礎的廣泛擴散的短程紅外線系統。
en: The HQ-7 is a widely proliferated short-range infrared system based on the French Crotale.

zh: 儘管以地對空飛彈標準而言相對老舊——於1980年代初期首次配備——紅旗-7的簡易性、機動性與殺傷力，使其在解放軍陸軍中享有長久且持續的服役壽命。
en: Though relatively old by SAM standards—it was first fielded in the early 1980s—the HQ-7's simplicity, mobility, and lethality have contributed to a long and ongoing service life in the PLAA.

zh: 紅旗-7攔截彈部署在機動卡車、固定場址與艦艇上。
en: HQ-7 interceptors are deployed on mobile trucks, at fixed sites, and on ships.

zh: 一個連由一部短程搜索雷達與三具發射器組成，每具有四枚或八枚待發飛彈。
en: A battery consists of a short-range search radar and three launchers, each with either four or eight ready missiles.

zh: 發射器可由雷達引導，也可目視交戰目標。
en: Launchers can be cued by the radar or engage targets visually.

zh: 攔截彈的斜距射程對高速移動目標約為八公里，對較慢的目標最多可達15公里。
en: The interceptor's slant range is roughly eight kms against a fast-moving target and up to 15 kms against a slower target.

zh: 紅旗-7通常是中型合成旅的主要飛彈系統，該單位建制擁有一個或兩個連的裝備。
en: The HQ-7 is typically the primary missile system of the medium CA-BDE, with one or two battery's worth of equipment organic to that organization.

zh: 其他連則用於關鍵資產的靜態防禦角色。
en: Other batteries are employed in static defense roles of critical assets.

zh: 紅旗-7同時由解放軍陸軍作為機動地對空飛彈平台運用，也由解放軍空軍作為較低層級系統運用。
en: The HQ-7 is employed by both the PLAA as a mobile SAM platform and by the PLAAF as a lower-tier system.

zh: 紅旗-16／16A是俄羅斯9K37山毛櫸的高度改良衍生型。
en: The HQ-16/16A is a highly modified variant of the Russian 9K37 Buk.

zh: 其攔截彈最初是作為海軍系統採購，後來在認識到其潛力後，改為適應陸地作業。
en: Its interceptor was originally procured as a naval system, then adapted to land operations once its potential was recognized.

zh: 一個連由一個指揮所、兩部多模式（監視／追蹤／照射）雷達，以及四至六具運輸起豎發射車組成，每具有六枚待發飛彈。
en: A battery consists of a command post, two multi-mode (surveillance/tracking/illumination) radars, and four to six TELs, each with six ready missiles.

zh: 紅旗-16主要用作關鍵資產的定點防禦系統，特別是那些易受巡弋飛彈攻擊的資產。
en: The HQ-16 is used primarily as a point defense system for critical assets, especially those vulnerable to attack by cruise missiles.

zh: 其攔截彈相對簡單且價格低廉，使其成為廣泛擴散的有吸引力選項。
en: Its interceptors are relatively simple and inexpensive, making it an attractive option for wide proliferation.

zh: 原始攔截彈的斜距射程約為40公里。
en: The original interceptor's slant range was around 40 kms.

zh: 紅旗-17是俄羅斯9K331道爾-M1地對空飛彈系統的逆向工程仿製品。
en: The HQ-17 is a reverse-engineered copy of the Russian 9K331 Tor-M1 SAM system.

zh: 紅旗-17主要配置於重型合成旅內，在合成旅的防空營內提供獨特的高殺傷力、長程防空能力。
en: HQ-17s are primarily housed within heavy CA-BDEs, providing a uniquely lethal and long-range air defense capability within the CA-BDE's air defense battalion.

zh: 紅旗-17連由一部中程雷達與四具發射器組成，每具有八枚待發飛彈。
en: HQ-17 batteries consist of a medium-range radar and four launchers, each with eight ready missiles.

zh: 儘管它使用較舊的指令導引系統，紅旗-17的準確度與殺傷力被認為極為優異。
en: Though it uses an older command guidance system, the HQ-17's accuracy and lethality are thought to be excellent.

zh: 一些分析人士聲稱，紅旗-17能夠對付巡弋飛彈與精準彈藥等具挑戰性的目標。
en: Some analysists claim that the HQ-17 is capable of challenging targets such as cruise missiles and precision munitions.

zh: 其斜距射程被引述為介於12公里與20公里之間；雷達的偵測距離超過30公里。
en: Its slant range is quoted as anywhere between 12 kms and 20 kms; the detection range of the radar is past 30 kms.

zh: 紅旗-2／A／B是老舊的蘇聯S-75／SA-2的演進版本，是最早有效的地對空飛彈之一。現代化的紅旗-2連採用多任務雷達，取代早期版本的眾多單一用途雷達，但指令導引攔截彈基本上維持不變。
en: The HQ-2/A/B is an evolved version of the aging Soviet S-75/SA-2, one of the earliest effective SAMs. Modernized HQ-2 batteries employ a multi-mission radar instead of the numerous single-purpose radars of earlier versions, but the command-guided interceptor remains largely unchanged.

zh: 解放軍空軍紅旗-2攔截彈的斜距射程約為45公里。
en: The slant range of PLAAF HQ-2 interceptors is roughly 45 kms.

zh: 目前仍在使用的大量紅旗-2系統，很可能被設想為欺騙或誘餌平台，迫使敵人改變計畫，或耗費昂貴而稀少的聯合防空壓制資源，來擊敗或癱瘓過時而廉價的裝備。
en: It is likely that the large numbers of HQ-2 systems still in use are envisioned as deception or decoy platforms, forcing the enemy to alter plans or expend expensive and rare joint suppression of enemy air defense resources to defeat or neutralize obsolete, inexpensive equipment.

zh: 每個紅旗-2連包括一部多任務雷達與最多六具發射器，每具有一枚待發飛彈。
en: Each HQ-2 battery includes a multi-mission radar and up to six launchers, each with one ready missile.

zh: 紅旗-12／22原本旨在作為紅旗-2的漸進式改進，但由於研製時程冗長，它在與下一代地對空飛彈系統大約相同的時間進入服役。
en: The HQ-12/22 was originally intended as an incremental improvement to the HQ-2, but due to a lengthy development timeline it entered service at about the same time as the next generation of SAM systems.

zh: 它採用半主動雷達導引攔截彈與多任務相位陣列感測器。
en: It employs a semi-active radar-homing interceptor and a multi-mission, phased-array sensor.

zh: 它是卡車載式，機動性比紅旗-2顯著更高——不過還不足以支援機動兵力。
en: It is truck mounted and significantly more mobile than the HQ-2—though not sufficiently so to support maneuver forces.

zh: 初始衍生型的斜距射程約為70公里。
en: Initial variants had a slant range of around 70 kms.

zh: 一個紅旗-12／22連由一部多任務雷達與四具發射器組成，每具有兩枚待發飛彈。
en: An HQ 12/22 battery consists of a multi-mission radar and four launchers, each with two ready missiles.

zh: 雖然紅旗-12／22的性能不及紅旗-9與更新的地對空飛彈系統，但它便宜得多，用於以足夠的、較便宜的攔截彈與雷達，加強較先進的地對空飛彈部署。
en: While the HQ 12/22 does not have performance comparable to that of the HQ-9 and newer SAM systems, it is far less expensive, and it is used to reinforce more-advanced SAM deployments with adequate, less-expensive interceptors and radars.

zh: 紅旗-9／紅旗-15／紅旗-18是以俄羅斯S-300為基礎的長程地對空飛彈系統家族。
en: The HQ-9/HQ-15/HQ-18 is a family of long-range SAM systems based around the Russian S-300.

zh: S-300採用系統之系統概念建造，使一個連或營能運用雷達與攔截彈的混合，以滿足作戰需求。
en: The S-300 was built using a system-of-systems concept, enabling a battery or battalion to employ a mixture of radars and interceptors to meet operational needs.

zh: 紅旗-9專為透過先進感測器、大型長程攔截彈與現代化電子反反制措施的結合，拒止第四代西方飛機使用大片空域而設計。
en: The HQ-9 was specifically designed to deny large areas of airspace to fourth-generation Western aircraft through a combination of advanced sensors; large, long-range interceptors; and modernized electronic counter-countermeasures.

zh: 紅旗-15是第一次重大現代化，增加了反彈道飛彈能力，並將偵測與交戰射程都延伸到超過200公里。
en: The HQ-15 was the first major modernization, adding an antiballistic missile capability and extending both detection and engagement ranges past 200 kms.

zh: 紅旗-18是第二次重大升級，增加了一對新的高性能攔截彈，以及一部較大、較強大的雷達。
en: The HQ-18 was the second major upgrade, adding a new pair of high-performance interceptors along with a larger, more-powerful radar.

zh: 紅旗-18的攔截彈射程較短，但其對最具挑戰性目標——彈道飛彈與巡弋飛彈、其他精準導引彈藥，以及機動中的飛機——的性能，很可能優於紅旗-15。
en: The HQ-18's interceptor ranges are shorter, but its performance against the most challenging targets—ballistic and cruise missiles, other precision-guided munitions, and maneuvering aircraft—is likely superior to the HQ-15.

zh: 一個紅旗-9／15／18連通常由一部長程搜索雷達、一部強大的追蹤雷達，以及最多八具運輸起豎發射車組成，每具有四枚待發攔截彈。
en: An HQ-9/15/18 battery typically consists of a long-range search radar, a powerful tracking radar, and up to eight TELs, each with four ready interceptors.

zh: 攔截彈與雷達可在一定程度上混合，無論是在營內，甚至是在連內。
en: Interceptors and radars can be mixed to a certain extent, either within a battalion or even within a battery.

zh: 如果中國遵循其先前的做法，這些系統將被用來發展對現有系統的逆向工程升級。
en: If the country follows its previous practices, these systems will be used to develop reverse-engineered upgrades to existing systems.

zh: 所有紅旗-9／15／18系統都整合進戰區整合防空系統。
en: All HQ-9/15/18 systems are integrated into theater IADS.

zh: 中國的防空能力全面而數量眾多，混合了解放軍陸軍控制下的機動短程系統，以及解放軍空軍操作的強大現代化長程系統。
en: Chinese air defense capabilities are comprehensive and numerous, mixing mobile, short-range systems under the control of the PLAA with powerful, modernized long-range systems operated by the PLAAF.

zh: 機動單位通常不會在沒有至少局部短程防空系統支援的情況下作業。
en: Maneuver units will typically not operate without at least local SHORAD systems in support.

zh: 攜帶型防空飛彈廣泛分布於解放軍陸軍的各類編隊，也由民兵與預備役單位在整個後方地區運用。
en: MANPADS are widely distributed throughout PLAA formations of all types, and they are also employed by militia and reserve units throughout rear areas.

zh: 不清楚中國整合防空系統通信網路的強化程度有多有效，但它很可能是解放軍中優先順序最高的網路系統之一。
en: It is not known how effectively hardened the Chinese IADS communications network is, but it is likely among the highest-priority network systems in the PLA.

zh: 較低梯隊的單位也可能具備參與更廣泛防空網路架構的能力，但它們並不依賴它。
en: Lower echelon units may also have the capability to participate in a wider air defense network construct, but they are not dependent on it.

zh: 解放軍陸軍對以火砲為基礎的系統持續感興趣，在世界先進軍隊中是獨一無二的：沒有其他現代陸軍運用如此高密度的火砲系統。
en: The PLAA's continued interest in gun-based systems is unique among the world's advanced militaries: no other modern army employs such a density of gun systems.

zh: 雖然與飛彈相比，火砲在射程與準確度上有顯著限制，但其簡易性、多功能性與對付低空空中威脅的能力，證明解放軍陸軍持續投資是正當的。
en: While guns have significant limitations in range and accuracy as compared to missiles, their simplicity, versatility, and capability against low-altitude air threats validate the continued PLAA investment.

zh: 事實上，包括美國在內的幾個其他軍隊，在放棄重型防空砲數十年後，正重新審視它們，作為對抗無人飛行載具與攻擊直升機的抵銷手段。
en: Indeed, several other militaries—the U.S. among them—are revisiting heavy antiaircraft guns, decades after abandoning them, as offsets to unmanned aircraft and attack helicopters.

zh: 中國人民解放軍陸軍（PLAA）的航空能力，由攻擊、多用途（中型）與運輸直升機的混合，加上多種不同的無人飛行載具系統（UAS）組成。
en: People's Liberation Army Army (PLAA) aviation capabilities consist of a mixture of attack, multirole (medium), and transport helicopters, plus a number of different unmanned aircraft systems (UASs).

zh: 陸軍航空在解放軍陸軍的大部分歷史中，都是低優先事項。
en: Army aviation was a low priority of the PLAA for most of its history.

zh: 這反映在與其他第一階層軍隊相比，中國旋翼機系統的密度非常低。
en: This is reflected in the very low density of Chinese rotary-wing systems compared to other first-order militaries.

zh: 作為比較基礎，美國陸軍每人平均的直升機密度，是解放軍陸軍的八倍以上。
en: As a basis for comparison, the U.S. Army's density of helicopters per capita is over eight times that of the PLAA.

zh: 隨著解放軍陸軍現代化，陸軍航空旅（AAB）很可能持續擴編。
en: AABs are likely to continue expansion as the PLAA modernizes.

zh: 本附錄提供的裝備概述並不打算詳盡無遺，而是介紹中國人民解放軍（PLA）所使用的主要裝備類型中最廣泛運用的衍生型號。
en: The equipment overview provided in this appendix is not intended to be exhaustive, but rather to introduce the most widely employed variants of major equipment types used by the People's Liberation Army (PLA).

zh: 直-10是中國第一款現代攻擊直升機。
en: The Z-10 is China's first modern attack helicopter.

zh: 在解放軍研究了美國阿帕契直升機在沙漠風暴行動中的效能之後展開研製，直-10是俄羅斯卡莫夫設計局與解放軍合作的成果。
en: Pursued after the PLA studied the effectiveness of the U.S. Apache during Operation Desert Storm, the Z-10 is the result of collaboration between the Russian Kamov design bureau and the PLA.

zh: 它在外形與能力上都極像其他現代攻擊直升機，其規格可與任何當代設計競爭。
en: It strongly resembles other modern attack helicopters both physically and in capabilities, and its specifications are competitive with any contemporary design.

zh: 直-10有兩名機組員，配備機鼻式鏈砲——很可能是美國M242 25毫米（mm）系統的仿製品——以及多功能的飛彈與火箭組合。
en: The Z-10 has a crew of two and employs a chin-mounted chain gun—likely a copy of the U.S. M242 25-millimeter (mm) system—along with a versatile mixture of missiles and rockets.

zh: 直-10飛彈包括精準的空對空與空對地武器。
en: Z-10 missiles include both precision air-to-air and air-to-surface weapons.

zh: 直-10最多可攜帶16枚各類飛彈、四個火箭莢，或依需要攜帶其組合。
en: The Z-10 can carry up to 16 missiles of various types, four rocket pods, or some combination thereof, as required.

zh: 直-10也採用現代感測器組，包括射控雷達、紅外線光學裝置，以及配備光電目標系統的選配目標莢艙。
en: The Z-10 also employs a modern sensor suite, including fire-control radars, infrared optics, and an optional targeting pod with an electro-optical targeting system.

zh: 直-10具有整合的電子戰能力，可由附加莢艙增強。
en: The Z-10 has an integrated electronic warfare capability that can be augmented by an add-on pod.

zh: 直-19是輕型攻擊與偵察直升機，與直-10協同研製，並源自直-9多用途直升機。
en: The Z-19 is a lightweight attack and reconnaissance helicopter that was developed in concert with the Z-10 and is derived from the Z-9 utility helicopter.

zh: 它同樣採用兩人機組，不過比直-10明顯更小更輕。
en: It also employs a two-person crew, though it is substantially smaller and lighter than the Z-10.

zh: 與幾乎所有其他攻擊直升機不同，直-19不使用機槍或機砲；其攻擊能力來自八枚飛彈（空對空或空對地）或兩個火箭莢。
en: Unlike virtually every other attack helicopter, the Z-19 does not use a machine gun or cannon; its offensive capability comes either from eight missiles (air-to-air or air-to-surface) or two rocket pods.

zh: 其感測器組與WZ-10類似，具有雷達系統與紅外線目標指定。
en: Its sensor suite is similar to that of the WZ-10, with a radar system and infrared targeting.

zh: 直-19配備於陸軍航空旅的偵察營；其主要戰術角色是支援較重型攻擊平台的偵察與目標指定。
en: Z-19s are fielded in the reconnaissance battalions of AABs; their primary tactical role is reconnaissance and targeting in support of heavier attack platforms.

zh: 它們也可更廣泛地用於旋翼機空對空角色；其小尺寸、較小的紅外線特徵與更高的敏捷性，使其非常適合低空反制空中任務。
en: They may also be used more extensively in the rotary-wing air-to-air role; their small size, smaller infrared signature, and increased agility makes them well-suited to the low-level counter-air mission.

zh: 米-17是長期服役的俄羅斯中型運輸與通用設計，仍在解放軍陸軍有限使用。
en: The Mi-17 is a long-serving Russian medium-lift and -utility design still in limited use in the PLAA.

zh: 米-17是米-8的演進版本，比美國UH-60黑鷹稍大且更強大。
en: An evolved version of the Mi-8, the Mi-17 is slightly larger and more powerful than the U.S. UH-60 Black Hawk.

zh: 它是簡單的通用設計，能夠載運或吊掛有用的酬載，或最多兩個班的部隊。
en: It is a simple utility design able to carry or sling a useful payload or up to two squads' worth of troops.

zh: 配備翼梢小翼的衍生型可攜帶相當的攻擊酬載，包括火箭與機砲莢艙，不過它們缺乏專用攻擊直升機的精密目標指定能力與防護配置。
en: Winglet-equipped variants can carry a substantial offensive payload, including rocket and gun pods, though they lack the sophisticated targeting capabilities and protection schemes of dedicated attack helicopters.

zh: 解放軍陸軍使用數種不同的米-17衍生型，不過其性能與角色差異很小。
en: The PLAA uses several different Mi-17 variants, though their performance and roles vary little.

zh: 直-9是源自歐洲設計的輕型多用途直升機。
en: The Z-9 is a light multirole helicopter derived from a European design.

zh: 它用途廣泛且輕巧，能夠擔任輕型運輸、攻擊、偵察、搜索與救援，或海上角色。
en: It is versatile and lightweight, able to serve in light transport, attack, reconnaissance, search-and-rescue, or maritime roles.

zh: 在攻擊角色中，它運用輕型機砲與最多四枚飛彈的組合，包括空對空與空對地。
en: In attack roles, it employs a mixture of light cannons and up to four missiles, both air-to-air and air-to-surface.

zh: 直-9可被視為折衷平台。
en: The Z-9 may be considered a compromise platform.

zh: 它是作為中國最早的現代軍用直升機之一而配備的。
en: It was fielded as one of China's first modern military helicopters.

zh: 儘管如此，直-9廣泛配備於整個解放軍陸軍、中國人民解放軍空軍（PLAAF）與中國人民解放軍海軍（PLAN）。
en: Nonetheless, Z-9s are fielded widely throughout the PLAA, the People's Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) and People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN).

zh: 直-9在可預見的未來，將在多種角色中廣泛使用。
en: Z9s will see widespread use in multiple roles for the foreseeable future.

zh: 直-8是1960年代法國重型運輸直升機SA-321的現代化版本。
en: The Z-8 is a modernized version of a 1960s-era French heavy-lift helicopter, the SA-321.

zh: 直-8既快速又航程長，並可攜帶相當的酬載。
en: The Z-8 is both fast and long-ranged, and it can carry a substantial payload.

zh: 基本設計非常老舊，與較現代的設計相比，效率不高且維修負擔沉重。
en: The basic design is very old, and it is both inefficient and maintenance-heavy compared to more modern designs.

zh: 由於其尺寸與敏捷性差，它也極易遭受地面火力攻擊，很可能被限於較深作戰地區的運輸角色。
en: Due to its size and poor agility, it is also very vulnerable to ground fire, and it is likely relegated to transport roles in deeper operational areas.

zh: 直-20是全新設計，與UH-60黑鷹極為相似。
en: The Z-20 is a new design that bears a very strong resemblance to the UH-60 Black Hawk.

zh: 它很可能是由S-70——黑鷹的民用對應型號——的複製品逆向工程而來。
en: It is likely reverse-engineered from copies of the S-70, the Black Hawk's civilian counterpart.

zh: 直-20是新設計，於2018年獲接受服役，目前可作戰的數量很少。
en: The Z-20 is a new design, accepted into service in 2018, and few examples are operational.

zh: 然而，直-20很可能成為解放軍陸軍新的標準中型運輸與多用途平台，在這些角色中同時取代直-8與米-17。
en: It is very likely, however, that the Z-20 will become the PLAA's new standard medium-lift and multirole platform, replacing both the Z-8 and the Mi-17 in these roles.

zh: 不令人意外的是，直-20的規格與UH-60相仿，不過提升功率的引擎與新的五葉螺旋槳，可能會適度增強性能。
en: Unsurprisingly, the Z-20's specifications mirror those of the UH-60, though uprated engines and a new five-bladed propeller may moderately enhance performance.

zh: 解放軍陸軍運用數種輕型直升機系統，幾乎全部是向歐洲製造商購買的商用型，或歐洲設計的授權或逆向工程仿製品。
en: The PLAA operates a number of light helicopter systems, nearly all of which are either commercial purchases from European manufacturers or licensed or reverse-engineered copies of European designs.

zh: 它是簡單而敏捷的設計，執行多項輕型運輸與聯絡任務。
en: It is a simple and agile design that performs a number of light transport and liaison duties.

zh: 這些系統似乎並未用於戰鬥角色。
en: These systems do not appear to be used in combat roles.

zh: 然而，它們很可能由武警（PAP）與民兵單位作為後方地區與安全作業的輕型空中支援使用，且其民用衍生型廣泛配備於中國各類警察機關。
en: They are, however, likely used by both People's Armed Police (PAP) and militia units as light air support for rear area and security operations, and civilian variants are widely fielded by Chinese police organizations of all types.

zh: 中國是無人飛行載具系統發展與生產的世界領導者。
en: China is a world leader in UAS development and production.

zh: 這項工業能力反映在整個解放軍各類編隊中廣泛使用無人飛行載具系統。
en: This industrial capability is reflected in the widespread use of UASs throughout PLA formations of all types.

zh: 解放軍陸軍在戰區與集團軍梯隊運用先進的中空無人飛行載具作為監視平台，並很可能已將其中部分系統武器化。
en: The PLAA employs advanced medium-altitude UA as surveillance platforms at the theater and group army echelons, and they have likely weaponized some of these systems.

zh: 輕型無人飛行載具運用於旅與營級，而單兵攜帶式系統則由小至班或巡邏隊的單位運用。
en: Lightweight UA are employed at brigade and battalion level, and man-portable systems are employed by units as small as squads or patrols.

zh: 解放軍陸軍也在反輻射與電子戰角色中運用武器化無人飛行載具。
en: The PLAA also employs weaponized UA in antiradiation and electronic warfare roles.

zh: 解放軍海軍使用無人飛行載具系統，為水面作戰提供長程監視，並可能運用武器化版本作為反潛平台。
en: The PLAN uses UASs for long-range surveillance in support of surface operations, and it may employ weaponized versions as antisubmarine platforms.

zh: 解放軍空軍運用各種精密的長程無人飛行載具系統，在國家與戰區層級提供監視與情報，並以武器化系統執行精準打擊任務。
en: The PLAAF employs a variety of sophisticated long-range UASs that provide surveillance and intelligence at the national and theater level and weaponized systems that conduct precision strike missions.

zh: 其主要限制是系統密度低，以及維修與持續支援資源有限，特別是在較低戰術梯隊。
en: Its primary limitation is the low density of systems and limited maintenance and sustainment resources, especially at lower tactical echelons.

zh: 解放軍陸軍熱切追求空中突擊能力，儘管仍在發展中，這項投資很可能將持續。
en: The PLAA has enthusiastically pursued an air assault capability and, though it is still developing, this investment will likely continue.

zh: 中國人民解放軍陸軍（PLAA）運用強大的戰鬥工兵能力，遍及其機動編隊，支撐其準則中始終一貫地著重障礙、壕溝、防禦工事與機動。
en: The People's Liberation Army Army (PLAA) employs a robust combat engineer capability throughout its maneuver formations, underpinning the consistent focus on obstacles, entrenchments, fortifications, and mobility seen throughout its doctrine.

zh: 解放軍陸軍戰鬥工兵能力有四個主要組成部分：機動、反機動、防護與搶救。
en: There are four primary components to the PLAA combat engineer capability: mobility, countermobility, protection, and recovery.

zh: 機動系統包括旨在修復與維護道路、建立或修復橋梁，以及掃除敵方雷區的系統。
en: Mobility systems include those designed to repair and maintain roads, establish or repair bridges, and sweep enemy minefields.

zh: 化學防禦能力被視為與工程屬於同一能力組合，並經常設於同一個單位。
en: Chemical defense capabilities are considered part of the same capability set as engineering, and they frequently occupy the same unit.

zh: 化學防禦任務有兩方面：為母單位配備裝備並訓練其在化學環境中作業，以及對遭受化學攻擊的裝備與人員進行除污。
en: The chemical defense mission is twofold: equipping and training the parent unit for operations in a chemical environment and decontaminating equipment and personnel that have suffered chemical attack.

zh: 除了傳統戰鬥工兵外，解放軍陸軍與武警都具備強大的土木工程能力。
en: In addition to traditional combat engineering, the PLAA and People's Armed Police (PAP) both have robust civil engineering capabilities.

zh: 土木工程任務是為支援軍事作戰與民間當局而執行。
en: Civil engineering missions are conducted in support of both military operations and civil authorities.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的工程單位擁有中國境內最先進的重型裝備與工程專長之一。
en: PLAA engineering units have among the most-advanced heavy equipment and engineering expertise available in China.

zh: 其專案包括建築物、公路、橋梁、鐵路、空港與海港，以及管線。
en: Their projects include buildings, highways, bridges, railroads, air and seaports, and pipelines.

zh: 名義上，解放軍陸軍認為其中許多是軍民兩用專案，或具有某些軍事價值。
en: Nominally, the PLAA assumes that many of these are dual-use projects or of some military value.

zh: 工程支援是軍民融合的旗艦範例之一。
en: Engineering support is one of the flagship examples of Military-Civil Fusion.

zh: 雖然這種「自己動手做」的心態在現代編隊中仍然存在，解放軍陸軍現在擁有一系列現代化工程車輛與受過專門訓練的人員。
en: While a lot of this "do-it-yourself" mentality still exists within modern formations, the PLAA now has a portfolio of modernized engineering vehicles and specially trained personnel.

zh: 每個合成旅（CA-BDE）在作戰支援營中運用多種工程系統，該營包括機動連、防護連與地雷戰連。
en: Each combined arms brigade (CA-BDE) employs a variety of engineering systems in the operational support battalion, which includes a mobility company, a protection company, and a mine warfare company.

zh: 較重型的工程能力設於集團軍的工兵與化學防禦旅。
en: Heavier engineering capabilities are housed in the group army's engineer and chemical defense brigade.

zh: GCZ-110是數種履帶式裝甲多用途工兵車輛之一，全部都只是坦克底盤與引擎，拆除砲塔並加裝工程設備。
en: The GCZ-110 is one of several types of tracked and armored multipurpose engineer vehicles, all of which are simply tank chassis and engine with the turret removed and engineering equipment attached.

zh: 這些系統為重型與中型合成旅提供障礙突破、防禦工事與搶救支援。
en: These systems provide the heavy and medium CA-BDEs with obstacle breaching, fortifications, and recovery support.

zh: 輕型合成旅的工兵支援較輕，由類似能力但安裝在卡車載式平台上構成。
en: Light CA-BDEs have lighter engineer support, consisting of similar capabilities but on truck-mounted platforms.

zh: 布雷與掃雷仍是解放軍陸軍的重要能力。
en: Mine laying and clearing remain important capabilities for the PLAA.

zh: 布雷主要透過砲兵可撒布地雷完成，不過大型先進反裝甲地雷也大量運用。
en: Mine laying is accomplished primarily through artillery-scatterable mines, although large, advanced antitank mines are also employed in large numbers.

zh: 解放軍陸軍運用種類繁多且高密度的架橋系統，包括卡車載式與坦克底盤載式。
en: The PLAA employs a wide variety and high density of bridging systems, both truck-mounted and tank chassis-mounted.

zh: 輕型架橋系統可承載輪型或輕型裝甲系統，而重型架橋系統可承載主戰坦克（MBT）。
en: Lightweight bridging systems can handle wheeled or light armored systems, while heavy bridging systems can handle main battle tanks (MBTs).

zh: 許多架橋系統是模組化的，可將多個橋段組合在一起，以跨越更寬的缺口。
en: Many bridging systems are modular, allowing multiple segments of bridge to be combined together in order to cross wider gaps.

zh: 解放軍陸軍機動單位定期與架橋單位訓練，並將渡河視為重要技能。
en: PLAA maneuver units conduct regular training with bridging units and consider river crossing to be an important skillset.

zh: 架橋系統也定期用於支援平民。
en: Bridging systems are also regularly used in support of civilian populations.

zh: 與大多數軍隊一樣，解放軍陸軍的裝甲搶救車輛幾乎全由坦克底盤與引擎、全裝甲乘員艙，以及旨在迅速拖回受損或動彈不得裝甲車輛的簡單而強大的搶救裝備構成。
en: As with most militaries, the PLAA's armored recovery vehicles nearly all consist of tank chassis and engines, a fully armored crew compartment, and simple, powerful recovery gear designed to quickly retrieve damaged or immobilized armored vehicles.

zh: 隨著裝甲車輛——特別是坦克——的重量增加，搶救車輛也需要變得更強大。
en: As the weight of armored vehicles—particularly tanks—has risen, so too have recovery vehicles needed to become more powerful.

zh: 解放軍陸軍傳統上以前一代主戰坦克為基礎發展搶救車輛。
en: The PLAA has traditionally developed a recovery vehicle based on the previous generation's MBT.

zh: 最新的搶救車輛654式，被認為是唯一能夠搶救99式主戰坦克的車輛。
en: The most current recovery vehicle, the Type 654, is thought to be the only vehicle capable of recovering the Type 99 MBT.

zh: 重型合成旅在其作戰支援營中運用搶救車輛。
en: Heavy CA-BDEs employ recovery vehicles in their operational support battalion.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的工兵在現代化時程上，比中國其他幾項能力組合更進一步。
en: The PLAA's engineers are further along in their modernization timeline than several other Chinese capability sets.

zh: 現代化裝備與演進的戰術已就位數年，第一線工兵單位已運用這些更新能力的所有面向進行大量訓練演習。
en: Modernized equipment and evolved tactics have been in place for several years, and frontline engineer units have conducted extensive training exercises using all aspects of these updated capabilities.

zh: 解放軍陸軍整個編隊中高密度的火箭砲兵系統，簡化了在合成旅使用可撒布地雷。
en: The high density of rocket artillery systems throughout the PLAA simplifies the use of scatterable mines at the CA-BDE.

zh: 土木工程支援能力也發展良好，陸軍工兵與民間當局之間的關係被視為非常重要且有意義。
en: Civil engineering support capabilities are also well developed, and the relationship between army engineers and civilian authorities is viewed as very important and meaningful.

zh: 參與民用專案為軍事工兵提供有用的訓練機會，同時改善當地基礎設施。
en: Work on civilian projects provides useful training opportunities to military engineers while improving local infrastructure.

zh: 這些專案通常被賦予高度優先，並獲得大量媒體報導。
en: These projects are typically given high priority and significant media coverage.

zh: 解放軍陸軍工兵面臨的最顯著限制，是戰術機動性與持續支援。
en: The most significant limitations that PLAA engineers face are tactical mobility and sustainment.

zh: 解放軍陸軍新工兵車輛中有很大比例是重型履帶式系統，因此不適合自行長距離移動。
en: A large proportion of new PLAA engineer vehicles are heavy tracked systems, and they are thus ill-suited for movement over long distances by themselves.

zh: 解放軍陸軍能夠運送重型車輛的重型運輸工具相對很少，這些很可能預留給坦克與步兵戰車（IFV），以備裝甲單位需要進行快速陸上移動時使用。
en: The PLAA has relatively few heavy transports capable of moving heavy vehicles, and these will likely be reserved for tanks and infantry fighting vehicles (IFVs) in the event that an armored unit needs to conduct a rapid overland movement.

zh: 這些系統有大量的燃料與維修需求。
en: These systems have significant fuel and maintenance requirements.

zh: 解放軍陸軍後勤與軍械人員相對較低的密度，可能難以在長距離或長時間內維持重型裝甲兵力。
en: The relatively low density of PLAA logistics and armament troops may struggle to sustain heavy armored forces over long distances or for an extended period of time.

zh: 這個問題因機動兵力可能比工兵兵力擁有更高的持續支援資產優先順序而進一步加劇。
en: This issue is further compounded by maneuver forces likely having a higher priority for sustainment assets than engineer forces.

zh: 然而，解放軍陸軍確實享有中國境內強大的戰略運輸網路，主要以中國龐大的鐵路網為基礎。
en: The PLAA does enjoy, however, a robust strategic transportation network within Chinese borders, based mostly around China's enormous rail network.

zh: 這個網路能夠在中國境內及周邊快速而有效率地運送大批部隊與裝備，但在中國領土之外幾乎沒有延伸能力。
en: This network is capable of moving large bodies of troops and equipment in and around China rapidly and efficiently, but it has little reach outside Chinese territory.

zh: 中國人民解放軍陸軍（PLAA）歷來並未尋求將戰術梯隊整合進更廣泛的通信架構；師是第一個具備強大通信能力的梯隊。
en: The People's Liberation Army Army (PLAA) historically did not seek to integrate tactical echelons into a wider communications architecture; the division was the first echelon with a robust communications capability.

zh: 較低梯隊依靠接近司令部與通信兵的組合來滿足其通信需求，營是最低使用現代化無線電的梯隊。
en: Lower echelons relied on a combination of close proximity to headquarters and couriers to meet their communications needs, with battalions as the lowest echelon to employ modernized radios.

zh: 與解放軍陸軍的大多數現代化一樣，各單位很可能處於不同的發展階段。
en: As with most of the PLAA's modernizations, units are likely in various stages of development.

zh: 解放軍陸軍期望的最終狀態，很可能是讓每個班或巡邏隊都配備安全可靠的無線電通信能力，並將安全可靠的網路資料能力延伸至排。
en: The PLAA's desired end state is likely to have every squad or patrol equipped with a secure, reliable radio communications capability and to extend a secure, reliable network data capability down to the platoon.

zh: 防空與砲兵系統將成為全戰區感測器到射擊單位網路的一部分。
en: Air defense and artillery systems are to be part of a theater-wide sensor-to-shooter network.

zh: 電磁攻擊與防禦能力與戰術指揮官相連，並支援戰術層級作業。
en: Electromagnetic attack and defense capabilities are linked to tactical commanders, and they support tactical-level operations.

zh: 這並不令人意外——解放軍陸軍的大多數無線電源自1970年代與1980年代取得的美國設計。
en: This is unsurprising—most PLAA radios are derived from U.S. designs acquired during the 1970s and 1980s.

zh: 連與營的無線電網路圍繞強大的戰術指揮所無線電建構，並有一系列人力搬運或車載無線電連接到加密網路。
en: Company and battalion radio networks are built around a powerful tactical command post radio, with a series of either man-packed or vehicle-mounted radios connecting to an encrypted network.

zh: 排長使用背負式或車載系統，例如TBR-121，其具備許多與最現代的美國單頻道地面與機載無線電系統（亦稱SINCGARS）相同的能力。
en: Platoon leaders employ backpack or vehicle systems such as the TBR-121, which has many of the same capabilities as the most modern U.S. single-channel ground and airborne radio system (also known as SINCGARS).

zh: 加密語音通信與有限的資料傳輸可透過無線電進行。
en: Encrypted voice communications and limited data transfer are possible over the air.

zh: 中國的砲兵與火砲無線電網路，比其他中國通信系統更為成熟。
en: Chinese artillery and gun radio networks are more mature than other Chinese communication systems.

zh: 前進觀測員網路採用強大的雙向系統，透過安全的資料與語音網路整合觀測員與火砲，主要基於TBR-142，這是一種以組件為基礎的無線電系統之系統。
en: Forward-observer networks employ powerful two-way systems that integrate observers and guns over secure data and voice networks, based largely on the TBR-142, a component-based radio system of systems.

zh: 這些網路可以非常有組織，將成對的火砲與個別觀測員連結，也可以集中並透過射擊指揮科管制。
en: These networks can be very organized, linking gun pairs with individual observers, or they can be centralized and controlled through a fire-direction section.

zh: 無人飛行載具系統（UAS）整合進前進觀測員網路，很可能也在射擊指揮科執行，使砲兵營能將多種感測器類型整合進其網路。
en: Unmanned aircraft system (UAS) integration into forward-observer nets is likely performed at fire-direction sections as well, allowing an artillery battalion to integrate multiple sensor types into its network.

zh: 砲兵旅的系統比營的系統更先進且強大，使重型火箭與榴彈砲連的支援具有更大的資料吞吐量與射程。
en: Artillery brigade systems are more advanced and powerful than battalion systems, allowing greater data throughput and range in support of heavy rocket and howitzer batteries.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的通信單位現在同時運用衛星式戰術通信與地面資料網路。
en: PLAA communications units now employ both satellite-based tactical communications and terrestrial data networks.

zh: 衛星通信受到頻寬的嚴重限制，並預留給最高優先的網路。
en: Satellite communications are heavily limited by bandwidth, and they are reserved for the highest-priority networks.

zh: 然而，中國計畫在未來幾年發射大量新的通信衛星，這可能會將衛星網路的可用性擴展到較低梯隊。
en: China plans to launch numerous new communications satellites in the coming years, however, and this may expand the availability of satellite networks to lower echelons.

zh: 解放軍與中國民用電信網路有獨特的關係。
en: The PLA has a unique relationship with Chinese civilian telecommunications networks.

zh: 許多民用網路在建造時就考量了解放軍的需求。
en: Many civilian networks were built with PLA requirements in mind.

zh: 這項能力嚴格限於國內軍事作戰。
en: This capability is limited strictly to domestic military operations.

zh: 任何遠征作戰都必須在獨立的網路上使用安全的戰術通信。
en: Any expeditionary operations must use secure tactical communications on separate networks.

zh: 整合防空系統（IADS）組件採用自己的資料網路，整合來自解放軍陸軍與中國人民解放軍空軍（PLAAF）的感測器與射擊單位。
en: Integrated air defense system (IADS) components employ their own data network that integrates sensors and shooters from both the PLAA and the People's Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF).

zh: 雖然航跡共享與感測器融合很可能尚未配備，但中程與長程平台很可能能夠共享空域圖像與語音網路，且射控中心與固定翼資產整合，作為防禦性反制空中作戰的一部分。
en: While track-sharing and sensor fusion are likely not yet fielded capabilities, medium- and long-range platforms can likely share airspace pictures and voice networks, and fire-control centers are integrated with fixed-wing assets as part of defensive counterair operations.

zh: 大多數長程地對空飛彈系統的靜態性質，使這些網路組件大多能夠強化與隔離，使其不受干擾或入侵影響。
en: The static nature of most long-range surface-to-air missile systems enables most of these network components to be hardened and isolated, making them immune to jamming or intrusion.

zh: 較低層級的防空系統使用語音與有限資料的混合來指揮射擊。
en: Lower-level air defense systems use a mixture of voice and limited data to direct fire.

zh: 較大型系統可能具有自動引導能力。
en: Larger systems may have an automatic cueing capability.

zh: 攜帶型防空飛彈系統（MANPADS）可從射擊指揮科接收射控命令，也可能有小型資料裝置以增強情勢警覺。
en: Man-portable air defense systems (MANPADS) can receive fire-control orders from a fire direction section, and they may also have small data devices to enhance situational awareness.

zh: 將現代通信能力擴展到較低梯隊一直具有挑戰性。
en: The expansion of modern communications capabilities to lower echelons has been challenging.

zh: 解放軍陸軍新兵素質的提升，有助於順利進行這項轉型，提供了一批精通科技的徵兵來操作先進通信裝備。
en: The increased quality of PLAA recruits has helped to smooth this transition, providing a cohort of tech-savvy conscripts to operate advanced communications equipment.

zh: 然而，解放軍陸軍仍在發展現代無線電網路，隨著其兵力現代化，不可避免地將遇到重大障礙。
en: The PLAA is still developing a modern radio network, however, and it will inevitably run into significant roadblocks as its forces are modernized.

zh: 這些障礙很可能包括從在受挑戰的電子環境中處理頻率管理問題，到較低戰術梯隊缺乏電池等一切問題。
en: These roadblocks will likely include everything from dealing with frequency management issues in a contested electronic environment to a lack of batteries at lower tactical echelons.

zh: 雖然地面無線電是邁向資訊化部隊有意義的第一步，但建構遠征兵力的挑戰——以及中國始終具挑戰性的地形——凸顯出解放軍在衛星、長程與非視線通信技術上的不足。
en: While terrestrial radios are a meaningful first step to an informationized force, the challenges of building an expeditionary force—and the consistently challenging terrain of China—highlight the PLA's shortfalls in satellite, long-range, and non-line-of-sight communications technologies.

zh: 雖然解放軍擁有類似Link-16的聯合資料網路，但仍處於初期，很可能還需要許多年才能在戰鬥中發揮作用。
en: While the PLA has a joint data network similar to Link-16, it is still in its infancy, and it is likely many years away from being useful in combat.

zh: 陸、空與海軍資產之間的整合很差，甚至不存在——這是達成整合聯合兵力的重大限制。
en: Integration between land, air, and naval assets is poor to nonexistent—a major limitation in achieving an integrated joint force.

zh: 較高梯隊的單位，例如戰區，能夠取得先進的專業裝備，例如對流層散射無線電，但這些並未配備於戰術梯隊。
en: Higher echelon units, such as theater commands, have access to advanced, specialized equipment such as troposcatter radios, but these are not fielded at tactical echelons.

zh: 由於資源有限，戰術單位之間在廣大區域的通信是一項挑戰。
en: Communications between tactical units over wide areas is a challenge due to limited resources.

zh: 資料網路針對入侵進行強化，旅與集團軍梯隊的專門小組執行持續的電磁與通信網路防護任務。
en: Data networks are hardened against intrusion, and specialized cells at the brigade and group army echelons conduct ongoing electromagnetic and communications network protection missions.

zh: 此外，解放軍海軍至少有一個專責的特種作戰部隊旅，解放軍空軍有一個空降軍，武警至少有兩個高度專業化的特種作戰部隊群。
en: In addition, the PLAN employs at least one dedicated SOF brigade, the PLAAF employs an airborne army, and the PAP employs at least two highly specialized SOF groups.

zh: 解放軍陸軍特種作戰部隊與美軍特種部隊——美國特種作戰司令部（USSOCOM）——的任務與目的根本不同。
en: PLAA SOF units have a fundamentally different task and purpose than U.S. military special forces, the United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM).

zh: 美國特種作戰司令部的任務包括直接行動、戰略偵察、外國內部防衛、非傳統戰爭、反恐與民事事務。
en: USSOCOM missions include direct action, strategic reconnaissance, foreign internal defense, unconventional warfare, counterterrorism, and civil affairs.

zh: 它們的其他主要任務包括破壞、突襲、縱深目標指定，以及搜索與救援。
en: Their other primary missions include sabotage, raids, deep targeting, and search and rescue.

zh: 因此，解放軍陸軍特種作戰部隊可被視為菁英輕步兵能力，而非西方式的特種作戰部隊能力。
