en: As such, PLAA SOF can be viewed as an elite light infantry capability, as opposed to a Western-style SOF capability.

zh: 集團軍的解放軍陸軍特種作戰部隊旅，其運用方式與美國陸軍運用遊騎兵輕步兵單位大致相同。
en: PLAA SOF brigades at the group army will be employed in much the same way as the U.S. Army employs its Ranger light infantry units.

zh: 另一方面，武警特種作戰部隊單位更著重安全、反恐與人質救援任務，更可與美國國內菁英執法單位相比。
en: PAP SOF units, on the other hand, focus more on security, counterterrorism, and hostage rescue missions, and they are more comparable to elite U.S. domestic law enforcement units.

zh: 這兩種特種作戰部隊任務很可能在戰鬥情況中重疊，解放軍陸軍特種作戰部隊擔任較前方或縱深的角色，武警特種作戰部隊則擔任較後方的角色。
en: It is likely that these two SOF missions overlap in combat situations, with PLAA SOF taking a more forward or deep role and PAP SOF a more rearward role.

zh: 因此，其訓練與戰備程度很可能與美國陸軍最好的輕步兵單位相當。
en: As a result, their training and readiness level is likely comparable to that of the U.S. Army's best light infantry units.

zh: 然而，與大多數西方特種作戰部隊單位不同，它們並不總是從現役兵力中招募有經驗的士兵。
en: Unlike most Western SOF units, however, they do not always recruit experienced soldiers from the active-duty force.

zh: 優質的徵兵可直接招募進入特種作戰部隊訓練，新軍官也可直接被選派擔任特種作戰部隊職務。
en: Quality conscripts may be recruited directly into SOF training, and new officers can be selected directly for SOF assignments.

zh: 中國特種作戰部隊單位，特別是解放軍陸軍的，是依其所駐防的地區量身打造的。
en: Chinese SOF units, particularly those in the PLAA, are carefully tailored to the regions in which they serve.

zh: 所有中國特種作戰部隊單位都具備空降與空中突擊能力，不過沒有任何中國特種作戰部隊單位享有與美國特種作戰司令部單位相同的空中支援。
en: All Chinese SOF units are airborne and air assault capable, though no Chinese SOF unit has the same access to air support as USSOCOM units.

zh: 解放軍陸軍與解放軍空軍缺乏執行戰略層級直接行動或偵察所需的縱深秘密滲透的航空能力，但它們能夠為支援作戰單位而執行特種作戰部隊的空中投送。
en: The PLAA and PLAAF lack the aviation capabilities to conduct the deep clandestine insertions necessary for strategic-level direct action or reconnaissance, but they can conduct air insertions of SOF in support of operational units.

zh: 沒有任何解放軍陸軍特種作戰部隊單位是專為遠距離遠征作戰而設計或配備的，但各單位確實與其他國家軍隊進行聯合訓練演習。
en: There are no PLAA SOF units specially designed or equipped for long-distance expeditionary operations, but units do conduct joint training exercises with other national militaries.

zh: 除了在中國邊境地區與領海內及其周邊的作戰之外，解放軍陸軍特種作戰部隊通常以國內為導向。
en: Outside of operations in and around Chinese border areas and territorial waters, PLAA SOF are generally domestically oriented.

zh: 反恐與騷亂控制是解放軍陸軍與武警特種作戰部隊的關鍵任務，這兩種單位中的任何一種，都可與警察或其他安全人員配合，協助維持國內穩定。
en: Antiterrorism and riot control are key missions for both PLAA and PAP SOF, and either of these units may assist in maintaining domestic stability in conjunction with police or other security personnel.

zh: 解放軍陸軍特種作戰部隊不執行外國內部防衛或非傳統戰爭，中國緊鄰地理區域的地區可能例外。
en: PLAA SOF do not conduct foreign internal defense or unconventional warfare, with the possible exception of areas in the immediate geographic area of China.

zh: 隨著解放軍發展其遠征能力，這些任務可能會被採納。
en: It is possible that these missions will be adopted as the PLA develops its expeditionary capability.

zh: 指揮官在發布新命令之前閱讀了陸軍規則600-20。
en: The commander read AR 600-20 before issuing the new order.

zh: 每一份陸軍規則在發布之前都由參謀審查。
en: Each AR is reviewed by the staff before it is published.

zh: 這份陸軍規則界定各單位如何回報裝備狀態。
en: The AR defines how units report their equipment status.

zh: 士兵在訓練日接受了關於新陸軍規則的簡報。
en: Soldiers received a briefing on the new AR during the training day.

zh: 數份陸軍規則適用於單位之間的財產移交。
en: Several ARs apply to the transfer of property between units.

zh: 一份陸軍規則訂定體能測驗的標準。
en: An Army regulation sets the standard for physical fitness tests.

zh: 法務參謀在報告中引用了該陸軍規則。
en: The staff judge advocate cited the Army regulation in the report.

zh: 陸軍規則在準則改變時更新。
en: Army regulations are updated whenever the doctrine changes.

zh: 中國海警在演習期間巡邏沿海海域。
en: The CCG patrolled the coastal waters throughout the exercise.

zh: 一艘中國海警巡邏艇跟隨漁船船隊數小時。
en: A CCG cutter followed the fishing fleet for several hours.

zh: 中國海警向區域指揮部通報了這起事件。
en: The CCG reported the incident to the regional command.

zh: 中國海警船艦護送補給船進入港口。
en: CCG vessels escorted the supply ships into the harbor.

zh: 風暴過後，中國海警增加了巡邏次數。
en: The CCG increased its patrols after the storm passed.

zh: 分析人員將中國海警的船隊規模與鄰近國家的船隊規模相比較。
en: Analysts compared the size of the CCG fleet with that of neighboring states.

zh: 中國海警在統一的指揮架構下運作。
en: The China Coast Guard operates under a unified command structure.

zh: 中國海警在港口入口附近檢查了那艘商船。
en: The China Coast Guard inspected the merchant ship near the harbor entrance.

zh: 美國陸軍部上個月發布了新的訓練通報。
en: DA published the new training circular last month.

zh: 該旅向美國陸軍部提交了戰備報告。
en: The brigade submitted its readiness report to DA.

zh: 美國陸軍部上週核准了增加車輛的申請。
en: DA approved the request for additional vehicles last week.

zh: 指揮官在更改計畫之前等待美國陸軍部的指導。
en: The commander waited for guidance from DA before changing the plan.

zh: 美國陸軍部的參謀軍官審查了下一會計年度的預算。
en: Staff officers at DA reviewed the budget for the next fiscal year.

zh: 美國陸軍部為所有現役部隊頒布準則。
en: The Department of the Army issues doctrine for all active units.

zh: 美國陸軍部的一名代表參訪了訓練中心。
en: A representative from the Department of the Army visited the training center.

zh: 美國陸軍部更新了裝備維修政策。
en: The Department of the Army updated its policy on equipment maintenance.

zh: 人員情報提供了計畫行動的第一次預警。
en: HUMINT provided the first warning of the planned movement.

zh: 該小組結合人員情報與影像資料來確認位置。
en: The team combined HUMINT with imagery to confirm the location.

zh: 人員情報來源通報了邊境檢查站附近的活動。
en: HUMINT sources reported activity near the border crossing.

zh: 衛星涵蓋範圍有限時，分析人員仰賴人員情報。
en: Analysts rely on HUMINT when satellite coverage is limited.

zh: 該部隊在行動前要求增加人員情報支援。
en: The unit requested additional HUMINT support before the operation.

zh: 人員情報往往能揭露對手的意圖。
en: Human intelligence often reveals the intent of an adversary.

zh: 參謀在整個調查期間保護人員情報來源。
en: The staff protected human intelligence sources throughout the investigation.

zh: 人員情報報告比技術蒐集更快送達。
en: Human intelligence reports arrived faster than the technical collection.

zh: 這輛坦克與2000公尺外的目標交戰。
en: The tank engaged a target 2000 m away.

zh: 這座橋長40公尺，可以承載重型車輛。
en: The bridge is 40 m long and can support heavy vehicles.

zh: 巡邏隊在距離檢查哨300公尺處停下。
en: The patrol stopped 300 m from the checkpoint.

zh: 一條2公尺深的戰壕保護乘員免受彈片傷害。
en: A trench 2 m deep protected the crew from fragments.

zh: 雷達在500公尺高度偵測到該飛機。
en: The radar detected the aircraft at a height of 500 m.

zh: 突擊部隊在火力下通過了150公尺的開闊地。
en: The assault force crossed 150 m of open ground under fire.

zh: 天線桅桿高12公尺，從道路上看得到。
en: The antenna mast is 12 m tall and visible from the road.

zh: 觀察員沿著路線每隔100公尺設置一個標記。
en: Observers placed markers every 100 m along the route.

zh: 中華人民共和國發表了一份新的國防白皮書。
en: The PRC published a new white paper on national defense.

zh: 中華人民共和國的官員出席了區域安全會議。
en: Officials from the PRC attended the regional security meeting.

zh: 中華人民共和國在過去十年擴大了造船能力。
en: The PRC expanded its shipbuilding capacity over the past decade.

zh: 分析人員研究中華人民共和國如何編組其預備部隊。
en: Analysts study how the PRC organizes its reserve forces.

zh: 中華人民共和國成立於1949年。
en: The People's Republic of China was founded in 1949.

zh: 中華人民共和國與數個鄰國有陸地邊界。
en: The People's Republic of China shares land borders with several neighbors.

zh: 中華人民共和國接待了該代表團三天。
en: The People's Republic of China hosted the delegation for three days.

zh: 一份報告描述了中華人民共和國的國防預算。
en: A report described the defense budget of the People's Republic of China.

zh: 這輛兩棲裝甲車載著一個步兵班通過海灘。
en: The AAV carried a squad of infantry across the beach.

zh: 五輛兩棲裝甲車在主力部隊之前登陸。
en: Five AAVs landed ahead of the main force.

zh: 兩棲裝甲車可以穿越浪區，然後在陸地上繼續前進。
en: An AAV can move through the surf and then continue on land.

zh: 這輛兩棲裝甲車的乘員在下水前檢查了車體。
en: The crew of the AAV checked the hull before entering the water.

zh: 6月2日，我們在東山訓練基地觀察到5輛兩棲裝甲車。
en: On June 2nd, we observed 5 AAVs in the Dongshan training base.

zh: 兩棲裝甲車的設計是將部隊從船艦運送上岸。
en: The amphibious assault vehicle is designed to carry troops from ship to shore.

zh: 維修小組在登陸演習後修復了兩棲裝甲車。
en: Maintenance teams repaired the amphibious assault vehicles after the landing exercise.

zh: 兩棲裝甲車從運輸艦的跳板進入水中。
en: The amphibious assault vehicle entered the water from the ramp of the transport ship.

zh: 一架空中預警與管制機監控海峽上空的空域。
en: An AEW&C aircraft monitored the airspace above the strait.

zh: 空中預警與管制機將目標資料傳送給戰鬥機。
en: The AEW&C relayed target data to the fighters.

zh: 兩架空中預警與管制機在演習期間以跑道式航線飛行。
en: Two AEW&C platforms flew in a racetrack pattern during the exercise.

zh: 指揮官要求一架空中預警與管制機以延伸雷達涵蓋範圍。
en: The commander requested an AEW&C to extend radar coverage.

zh: 空中預警與管制機的機組人員協調友軍飛機的行動。
en: AEW&C crews coordinate the movements of friendly aircraft.

zh: 一架空中預警與管制機偵測到低空飛行的目標。
en: An airborne early warning and control aircraft detected the low-flying targets.

zh: 空中預警與管制機延伸地面雷達的探測範圍。
en: Airborne early warning and control aircraft extend the range of ground-based radar.

zh: 空中預警與管制機在八小時後返回基地。
en: The airborne early warning and control aircraft returned to base after eight hours.

zh: 空中預警與管制系統在遠距離偵測到來襲的飛機。
en: The AWACS detected the incoming aircraft at long range.

zh: 空中預警與管制系統引導戰鬥機飛向攔截點。
en: An AWACS directed the fighters toward the intercept point.

zh: 空中預警與管制系統的機組人員同時追蹤了100多個目標。
en: The crew of the AWACS tracked more than 100 targets at once.

zh: 空中預警與管制系統的支援提升了打擊編隊的情勢覺知。
en: AWACS support improved the situational awareness of the strike package.

zh: 盟軍在聯合演習期間共享空中預警與管制系統的資料。
en: Allied forces shared AWACS data during the joint exercise.

zh: 空中預警與管制系統可以協調數十架飛機。
en: The Airborne Warning and Control System can coordinate dozens of aircraft.

zh: 空中預警與管制系統從改裝的客機上運作。
en: The Airborne Warning and Control System operates from a modified airliner.

zh: 機械故障迫使空中預警與管制系統提前降落。
en: A mechanical fault forced the Airborne Warning and Control System to land early.

zh: 指管通資情監偵將感測器、指揮官與武器系統連結成單一網路。
en: C4ISR links sensors, commanders, and weapon systems into a single network.

zh: 該旅在野戰演習之前升級了指管通資情監偵裝備。
en: The brigade upgraded its C4ISR equipment before the field exercise.

zh: 敵軍試圖破壞特遣部隊的指管通資情監偵。
en: Enemy forces tried to disrupt the C4ISR of the task force.

zh: 可靠的指管通資情監偵讓指揮官能快速做出決策。
en: Reliable C4ISR allows commanders to make decisions quickly.

zh: 新司令部設有專屬的指管通資情監偵中心。
en: The new headquarters has a dedicated C4ISR center.

zh: 工程人員在指揮車上安裝了指管通資情監偵終端機。
en: Engineers installed C4ISR terminals on the command vehicles.

zh: 分析人員評估失去指管通資情監偵會如何影響行動。
en: Analysts assessed how a loss of C4ISR would affect the operation.

zh: 演習在嚴重的電子干擾下測試了指管通資情監偵。
en: The exercise tested C4ISR under heavy electronic interference.

zh: 近迫武器系統在近距離攔截來襲的飛彈。
en: The CIWS engaged the incoming missile at close range.

zh: 驅逐艦艦橋附近裝設了一套近迫武器系統。
en: A CIWS is mounted near the bridge of the destroyer.

zh: 乘員在離港前測試了近迫武器系統。
en: The crew tested the CIWS before leaving port.

zh: 近迫武器系統提供對抗掠海飛彈的最後一層防禦。
en: CIWS provides the last layer of defense against sea-skimming missiles.

zh: 近迫武器系統自動追蹤了目標。
en: The close-in weapon system tracked the target automatically.

zh: 近迫武器系統在短時間內發射大量彈藥。
en: The close-in weapon system fires a high volume of rounds in a short time.

zh: 近迫武器系統每個月進行一次維護。
en: Maintenance of the close-in weapon system takes place every month.

zh: 這艘護衛艦的甲板上配有兩套近迫武器系統。
en: The frigate carries two close-in weapon systems on its deck.

zh: 傘兵在黎明前降落在空投區。
en: The paratroopers landed at the DZ before dawn.

zh: 一支引導小組用燈光標示了空投區。
en: A pathfinder team marked the DZ with lights.

zh: 空投區的風況使空投延遲了一個小時。
en: Wind conditions at the DZ delayed the airdrop by one hour.

zh: 這個空投區夠大，可以接收重型裝備。
en: The DZ was large enough to receive heavy equipment.

zh: 士兵在補給機抵達前確保了空投區的安全。
en: Soldiers secured the DZ before the supply aircraft arrived.

zh: 空投區位於距離目標兩公里處。
en: The drop zone was located two kilometers from the objective.

zh: 規劃人員選擇了遠離人口密集區的空投區。
en: Planners selected a drop zone away from populated areas.

zh: 空投區在行動前一天清除了障礙物。
en: The drop zone was cleared of obstacles the day before the operation.

zh: 快速攻擊艇以高速接近目標。
en: The FAC approached the target at high speed.

zh: 數艘快速攻擊艇在夜間熄燈駛出港口。
en: Several FACs left the harbor at night without any lights.

zh: 快速攻擊艇體積小、速度快，並配備反艦飛彈。
en: A FAC is small, fast, and armed with anti-ship missiles.

zh: 快速攻擊艇中隊對船團進行了模擬攻擊。
en: The FAC squadron conducted a mock attack on the convoy.

zh: 雷達操作員在海浪中失去了快速攻擊艇的蹤跡。
en: Radar operators lost track of the FAC among the waves.

zh: 快速攻擊艇可以在較大型艦艇反應之前攻擊並撤離。
en: A fast attack craft can strike and withdraw before larger ships respond.

zh: 海軍為海岸防禦建造了一艘新的快速攻擊艇。
en: The navy built a new fast attack craft for coastal defense.

zh: 快速攻擊艇成群作戰，以壓制較大型艦艇的防禦。
en: Fast attack craft operate in groups to overwhelm the defenses of a larger ship.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦護送補給船通過海峽。
en: The FFG escorted the supply ships through the strait.

zh: 一艘飛彈護衛艦在黎明時加入任務群。
en: An FFG joined the task group at dawn.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦攜帶艦隊防禦用的地對空飛彈。
en: The FFG carries surface-to-air missiles for fleet defense.

zh: 兩艘飛彈護衛艦在港口附近的海上航道巡邏。
en: Two FFGs patrolled the sea lanes near the port.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦的乘員進行了滅火演練。
en: The crew of the FFG conducted a firefighting drill.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦可以搭載一架直升機作業。
en: A guided-missile frigate can operate with a helicopter on board.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦返回港口進行修理。
en: The guided-missile frigate returned to port for repairs.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦在實彈演習中發射了一枚飛彈。
en: The guided-missile frigate fired a missile during the live-fire exercise.

zh: 巡邏隊在道路旁發現了一枚簡易爆炸裝置。
en: The patrol found an IED beside the road.

zh: 工兵在車隊繼續前進之前清除了簡易爆炸裝置。
en: Engineers cleared the IED before the convoy continued.

zh: 一枚簡易爆炸裝置損壞了領頭車輛，但沒有人受傷。
en: An IED damaged the lead vehicle but no one was hurt.

zh: 部隊受訓辨識路線沿途簡易爆炸裝置的跡象。
en: Troops trained to spot signs of an IED along the route.

zh: 敵軍使用簡易爆炸裝置來減緩縱隊的前進。
en: The enemy used IEDs to slow the advance of the column.

zh: 一枚簡易爆炸裝置被藏在一堆瓦礫之下。
en: An improvised explosive device was hidden under a pile of rubble.

zh: 小組用機器人拆除了簡易爆炸裝置。
en: The team neutralized the improvised explosive device with a robot.

zh: 簡易爆炸裝置對沒有防護的車輛仍然是威脅。
en: Improvised explosive devices remain a threat to unprotected vehicles.

zh: 兩名士兵在伏擊後被通報陣亡。
en: Two soldiers were reported KIA after the ambush.

zh: 連長在報告中將三名官兵列為陣亡。
en: The company commander listed three men as KIA in the report.

zh: 該部隊在突擊期間陣亡人數很少。
en: The unit suffered few KIA during the assault.

zh: 參謀在午夜更新了陣亡人數。
en: The staff updated the KIA count at midnight.

zh: 傷亡報告將傷者與陣亡者分開記載。
en: Casualty reports separate the wounded from the KIA.

zh: 這名陣亡士兵的家人當天收到了消息。
en: The family of the soldier killed in action received the news that day.

zh: 該營在戰役期間記錄了六名士兵陣亡。
en: The battalion recorded six soldiers killed in action during the campaign.

zh: 陣亡的士兵在基地的儀式中受到表揚。
en: Soldiers killed in action were honored in a ceremony at the base.

zh: 兩棲突擊艦搭載了一個營的海軍陸戰隊員及其裝備。
en: The LHD carried a battalion of marines and their equipment.

zh: 兩棲突擊艦在同一艘艦上運用直升機與登陸艇。
en: An LHD operates helicopters and landing craft from the same ship.

zh: 兩棲突擊艦在外海下錨，開始登陸行動。
en: The LHD anchored offshore to begin the landing.

zh: 兩艘兩棲突擊艦參加了兩棲演習。
en: Two LHDs took part in the amphibious exercise.

zh: 兩棲突擊艦的飛行甲板上停滿了飛機。
en: The flight deck of the LHD was crowded with aircraft.

zh: 兩棲突擊艦擔任登陸部隊的指揮艦。
en: The LHD served as the command ship for the landing force.

zh: 水兵將車輛裝入兩棲突擊艦的塢艙。
en: Sailors loaded vehicles into the well deck of the LHD.

zh: 長期部署之後，兩棲突擊艦進港維修。
en: The LHD entered port for maintenance after the long deployment.

zh: 一名飛行員在任務後被列為任務中失蹤人員。
en: One pilot was listed as MIA after the mission.

zh: 搜尋小組尋找任務中失蹤人員達五天。
en: The search team looked for the MIA for five days.

zh: 最終報告在戰鬥後將四名士兵列為任務中失蹤。
en: The final report named four soldiers as MIA after the battle.

zh: 該部隊繼續在墜機地點附近搜尋任何任務中失蹤人員。
en: The unit continued to search for any MIA near the crash site.

zh: 指揮官必須在24小時內通報每一名任務中失蹤人員。
en: Commanders must report each MIA within 24 hours.

zh: 任務中失蹤的士兵與遭到俘虜的士兵不同。
en: Soldiers missing in action are different from those who are captured.

zh: 這名任務中失蹤的空勤人員的家人等候著消息。
en: The family of the airman missing in action waited for news.

zh: 救援人員在海上搜尋任務中失蹤的水兵。
en: Rescue crews searched the sea for the sailors missing in action.

zh: 該部隊俘虜了十二名敵軍士兵，並將他們視為戰俘。
en: The unit captured twelve enemy soldiers and treated them as POWs.

zh: 這名戰俘在野戰醫院接受了醫療照護。
en: The POW received medical care at the field hospital.

zh: 警衛將戰俘轉移到安全的營地。
en: Guards moved the POWs to a secure camp.

zh: 國際法要求人道對待每一名戰俘。
en: International law requires humane treatment of every POW.

zh: 指揮官下令每天早上清點戰俘人數。
en: The commander ordered a count of the POWs each morning.

zh: 戰俘只需提供姓名、階級與編號。
en: A prisoner of war must give only name, rank, and serial number.

zh: 這名戰俘在停火結束之後獲釋。
en: The prisoner of war was released after the ceasefire ended.

zh: 醫護人員在每名戰俘抵達時為其檢查。
en: Medics examined each prisoner of war on arrival.

zh: 快速反應部隊在十分鐘內抵達攻擊地點。
en: The QRF reached the site of the attack within ten minutes.

zh: 一支快速反應部隊全天候在基地待命。
en: A QRF stands ready at the base around the clock.

zh: 車隊指揮官呼叫快速反應部隊支援。
en: The convoy commander called the QRF for help.

zh: 快速反應部隊登上直升機，飛往目標。
en: The QRF boarded helicopters and flew toward the objective.

zh: 快速反應部隊的訓練包括夜間行動與城鎮戰鬥。
en: Training for the QRF includes night movement and urban combat.

zh: 快速反應部隊可以增援遭到攻擊的單位。
en: A quick reaction force can reinforce a unit that is under fire.

zh: 快速反應部隊攜帶了額外的彈藥與醫療補給。
en: The quick reaction force carried extra ammunition and medical supplies.

zh: 基地為緊急狀況維持一支快速反應部隊。
en: The base maintains a quick reaction force for emergencies.

zh: 防空壓制任務為轟炸機清出一條通道。
en: SEAD missions cleared a path for the bombers.

zh: 空中組成部隊在主要打擊之前規劃了防空壓制。
en: The air component planned SEAD before the main strike.

zh: 攜帶反輻射飛彈的戰鬥機執行了防空壓制任務。
en: Fighters carrying anti-radiation missiles flew the SEAD mission.

zh: 有效的防空壓制大幅減少友軍飛機的損失。
en: Effective SEAD greatly reduces losses among friendly aircraft.

zh: 該聯隊針對模擬雷達站進行防空壓制演練。
en: The wing practiced SEAD against simulated radar sites.

zh: 防空壓制為後續部隊打開空域。
en: Suppression of enemy air defenses opens the airspace for follow-on forces.

zh: 該計畫在第一夜仰賴防空壓制。
en: The plan relied on suppression of enemy air defenses during the first night.

zh: 防空壓制需要與電子攻擊部隊密切協調。
en: Suppression of enemy air defenses requires close coordination with electronic attack units.

zh: 無人飛行載具飛越山谷並傳回即時影像。
en: The UAV flew over the valley and sent back live video.

zh: 一架無人飛行載具發現了藏在樹下的車輛。
en: A UAV spotted the vehicles hidden under the trees.

zh: 操作人員從一小片空地發射了無人飛行載具。
en: Operators launched the UAV from a small clearing.

zh: 無人飛行載具燃料用盡，降落在基地附近。
en: The UAV ran out of fuel and landed near the base.

zh: 三架無人飛行載具同時搜尋該區域。
en: Three UAVs searched the area at the same time.

zh: 無人飛行載具可以在空中停留許多小時。
en: An unmanned aerial vehicle can stay in the air for many hours.

zh: 無人飛行載具搭載了攝影機與雷射指示器。
en: The unmanned aerial vehicle carried a camera and a laser designator.

zh: 士兵在課程中學習操控無人飛行載具。
en: Soldiers learned to control an unmanned aerial vehicle during the course.

zh: 無人戰鬥航空載具攻擊目標之後返回基地。
en: The UCAV attacked the target and then returned to base.

zh: 無人戰鬥航空載具可以攜帶飛彈與精準炸彈。
en: A UCAV can carry missiles and precision bombs.

zh: 操作人員從地面站操控無人戰鬥航空載具。
en: Operators controlled the UCAV from a ground station.

zh: 防空武器在海上擊落了一架無人戰鬥航空載具。
en: Air defenses shot down a UCAV over the sea.

zh: 該聯隊在打擊兵力中增加了兩架無人戰鬥航空載具。
en: The wing added two UCAVs to its strike force.

zh: 無人戰鬥航空載具不會使飛行員的生命陷入危險。
en: An unmanned combat aerial vehicle does not put the life of a pilot at risk.

zh: 無人戰鬥航空載具飛行了一條長航線以避開雷達。
en: The unmanned combat aerial vehicle flew a long route to avoid radar.

zh: 工程人員在試驗場測試了一款新的無人戰鬥航空載具。
en: Engineers tested a new unmanned combat aerial vehicle at the proving ground.

zh: 這項新條約禁止在全世界生產大規模毀滅性武器。
en: The new treaty bans the production of WMD worldwide.

en: A depth charge track lets crews roll charges over the side.

zh: 驅逐艦航行在船團前方搜尋潛艦。
en: The DD sailed ahead of the convoy to search for submarines.

zh: 驅逐艦速度快，並且就其大小而言武裝精良。
en: A DD is fast and well armed for its size.

zh: 輕型護衛艦在海岸巡邏並護送漁船。
en: The DDC patrolled the coast and escorted fishing boats.

zh: 輕型護衛艦夠小，可以在淺水中作業。
en: A DDC is small enough to operate in shallow water.

zh: 反潛驅逐艦用聲納追蹤潛艦長達數小時。
en: The DDE used sonar to follow the submarine for hours.

zh: 反潛驅逐艦載有深水炸彈與魚雷。
en: An antisubmarine destroyer carries depth charges and torpedoes.

zh: 飛彈驅逐艦對海上的無人機發射了一枚飛彈。
en: The DDG fired a missile at the drone over the sea.

zh: 飛彈驅逐艦配有垂直發射單元。
en: A guided missile destroyer carries vertical launch cells.

zh: 雷達哨戒驅逐艦在航空母艦前方遠處監視飛機。
en: The DDR watched for aircraft far ahead of the carriers.

zh: 雷達哨戒驅逐艦延伸艦隊的預警範圍。
en: A radar picket destroyer extends the warning range of the fleet.

zh: 護航艦保護北方航線上的補給船。
en: The DE protected the supply ships on the northern route.

zh: 護航艦停留在其所保護的船團附近。
en: An escort ship stays close to the convoy it protects.

zh: 管制護航艦引導登陸艇駛向海灘。
en: The DEC guided the landing boats toward the beach.

zh: 管制護航艦為突擊艇標示航道。
en: A control escort vessel marks the lanes for assault craft.

zh: 飛彈護航艦以地對空飛彈保護船團。
en: The DEG protected the convoy with surface-to-air missiles.

zh: 飛彈護航艦比驅逐艦小。
en: A guided missile escort ship is smaller than a destroyer.

zh: 雷達哨戒護航艦在遠離艦隊主力處擔任警戒。
en: The DER stood watch far from the main body of the fleet.

zh: 雷達哨戒護航艦以雷達向航空母艦示警。
en: A radar picket escort ship uses its radar to warn the carriers.

zh: 遠程預警系統在飛機抵達海岸很久之前就偵測到它。
en: The DEW detected the aircraft long before it reached the coast.

zh: 遠程預警系統仰賴北方的雷達站。
en: The Distant Early Warning System relied on radar stations in the north.

zh: 護衛艦護送船團橫越北方水域。
en: The DL escorted the convoy across the northern waters.

zh: 護衛艦比護航艦大，但比巡洋艦小。
en: A DL is larger than an escort ship but smaller than a cruiser.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦攜帶艦隊防禦用的地對空飛彈。
en: The DLG carried surface-to-air missiles for fleet defense.

zh: 飛彈護衛艦可以保護船團免受空中攻擊。
en: A guided missile frigate can protect a convoy from air attack.

zh: 核動力飛彈護衛艦在長期部署中護送核動力航空母艦。
en: The DLGN escorted the nuclear carrier on long deployments.

zh: 核動力飛彈護衛艦許多年都不需要加油。
en: A DLGN does not need to refuel for many years.

zh: 驅逐艦布雷艦在夜間於敵方海岸附近布雷。
en: The DM laid mines at night near the enemy coast.

zh: 驅逐艦布雷艦可以布雷，然後像驅逐艦一樣作戰。
en: A DM can lay mines and then fight like a destroyer.

zh: 高速掃雷艦在登陸前高速清掃了航道。
en: The DMS swept the channel at high speed before the landing.

zh: 高速掃雷艦是由一艘舊驅逐艦改裝而成。
en: A DMS was converted from an old destroyer.

zh: 實驗雜項輔助艦在海上測試了新的引擎設計。
en: The EAG tested a new engine design at sea.

zh: 實驗雜項輔助艦載有測試設備與科學家。
en: An experimental miscellaneous auxiliary carries test equipment and scientists.

zh: 海上快速傳送裝備讓船艦在航行時交換貨物。
en: The FAST allowed the ships to exchange cargo while moving.

zh: 海上快速傳送裝備加快補給品的運送。
en: Fast At Sea Transfer Equipment speeds up the delivery of supplies.

zh: 艦隊彈道飛彈從潛航中的潛艦發射。
en: The FBM was launched from a submerged submarine.

zh: 艦隊彈道飛彈可以打擊橫越海洋的目標。
en: A fleet ballistic missile can reach targets across an ocean.

zh: 砲艇沿河而上支援部隊。
en: The Gbt moved up the river to support the troops.

zh: 砲艇有輕型裝甲與幾門小口徑火砲。
en: A Gbt has light armor and a few small guns.

zh: 獵殺小組在該區域搜尋敵方潛艦。
en: The HUK group searched the area for enemy submarines.

zh: 獵殺作戰把飛機、艦艇與聲納結合在同一個搜尋計畫中。
en: HUK operations combine aircraft, ships, and sonar in one search plan.

zh: 近岸火力支援艦在登陸前砲擊了岸上陣地。
en: The IFS bombarded the shore positions before the landing.

zh: 近岸火力支援艦可以在短時間內發射許多火箭。
en: An IFS can fire many rockets in a short time.

zh: 未分類雜項輔助艦被用作水上訓練平台。
en: The IX was used as a floating training platform.

zh: 未分類雜項輔助艦沒有標準的任務。
en: An unclassified miscellaneous auxiliary ship has no standard role.

zh: 支援登陸艇把彈藥與醫療補給品運到海灘。
en: The LBP carried ammunition and medical supplies to the beach.

zh: 支援登陸艇在突擊期間停留在靠近海岸處。
en: A support landing boat stayed near the shore during the assault.

zh: 車輛登陸艇把兩輛卡車送上狹窄的海灘。
en: The LBV landed two trucks on the narrow beach.

zh: 車輛登陸艇在淺水中放下跳板。
en: A vehicle landing boat lowers its ramp in shallow water.

zh: 突擊登陸艇載著一個步兵班朝海岸前進。
en: The LCA carried a section of infantry toward the shore.

zh: 突擊登陸艇有裝甲保護艇內的部隊。
en: An assault landing craft has armor to protect the troops inside.

zh: 車輛登陸艇把一輛吉普車及其乘員送到海灘。
en: The LCB moved a jeep and its crew to the beach.

zh: 車輛登陸艇可以把輕型車輛從船上運到岸上。
en: An LCB can carry light vehicles from ship to shore.

zh: 兩棲指揮艦擔任登陸部隊的指揮艦。
en: The LCC served as the command ship for the landing force.

zh: 兩棲指揮艦有額外的無線電與供登陸參謀使用的艙室。
en: An LCC has extra radios and rooms for the landing staff.

zh: 管制登陸艇 Mk I 引導第一波部隊駛向海灘。
en: The landing craft, control Mk I guided the first wave toward the beach.

zh: 管制登陸艇 Mk I 為突擊艇標示航道。
en: A landing craft, control Mk I marks the lanes for the assault boats.

zh: 管制登陸艇 Mk II 載有比舊型更好的無線電。
en: The landing craft, control Mk II carried better radios than the older model.

zh: 管制登陸艇 Mk II 停在外海指揮登陸。
en: A landing craft, control Mk II stays offshore to direct the landing.

zh: 步兵登陸艇在部隊登陸前對海岸防禦開火。
en: The LCI(F) fired on the shore defenses before the troops landed.

zh: 步兵登陸艇配有火砲，而不是大量士兵。
en: An LCI(F) carries guns instead of a large number of soldiers.

zh: 大型步兵登陸艇把一整個連送上開闊的海灘。
en: The LCI(L) landed a full company on the open beach.

zh: 大型步兵登陸艇可以載運約兩百名士兵。
en: An LCI(L) can carry about two hundred soldiers.

zh: 步兵登陸艇以迫擊砲砲擊敵方戰壕。
en: The LCI(M) shelled the enemy trenches with mortars.

zh: 步兵登陸艇在步兵登陸時提供火力支援。
en: An LCI(M) gives fire support while the infantry lands.

zh: 步兵登陸艇對海灘發射了一輪火箭彈幕。
en: The LCI(R) fired a barrage of rockets at the beach.

zh: 步兵登陸艇可以在幾分鐘內發射數百枚火箭。
en: An LCI(R) can fire hundreds of rockets in a few minutes.

zh: 機械化登陸艇載著一輛坦克渡過海灣。
en: The landing craft, mechanized carried a tank across the bay.

zh: 機械化登陸艇可以讓車輛直接在整備好的海灘上岸。
en: An LCM can land vehicles directly on a prepared beach.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk II 把補給品從運輸艦運到岸上。
en: The LCM(2) carried supplies from the transport to the shore.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk II 比後來的型號小。
en: An LCM(2) is smaller than the later models.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk III 把重型裝備運到島上。
en: The LCM(3) moved heavy equipment to the island.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk III 多年來都是標準的登陸艇。
en: An LCM(3) became the standard landing craft for many years.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk VI 更長，可以載運更重的負載。
en: The LCM(6) was longer and could carry a heavier load.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk VI 一趟就送三輛車輛上岸。
en: An LCM(6) landed three vehicles in a single trip.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk VIII 可以載著大型坦克渡過波濤洶湧的水域。
en: The LCM(8) can carry a large tank across rough water.

zh: 機械化登陸艇 Mk VIII 有鋼製艇體與寬敞的貨艙甲板。
en: An LCM(8) has a steel hull and a wide cargo deck.

zh: 大型人員登陸艇把一個班的海軍陸戰隊員送到海灘。
en: The LCPL brought a squad of marines to the beach.

zh: 大型人員登陸艇速度快，在浪區中容易操控。
en: An LCPL is fast and easy to handle in the surf.

zh: 人員登陸艇（巢式）被設計成可以堆疊在運輸艦的甲板上。
en: The LCP(N) was designed to be stacked on the deck of the transport.

zh: 人員登陸艇（巢式）因為可以套在另一艘艇內而節省空間。
en: An LCP(N) saves space because it nests inside another boat.

zh: 人員登陸艇（具跳板）放下跳板，士兵跑上岸。
en: The LCPR dropped its ramp and the soldiers ran ashore.

zh: 人員登陸艇（具跳板）讓部隊能迅速離開艇上。
en: An LCPR lets troops leave the boat quickly.

zh: 大型充氣登陸艇把一個偵察巡邏隊送到隱蔽的海灘。
en: The LCR(L) carried a patrol of scouts to the hidden beach.

zh: 大型充氣登陸艇輕到可以由數人抬著走。
en: An LCR(L) is light enough to be carried by several men.

zh: 小型充氣登陸艇載著四名蛙人前往岩石海岸。
en: The LCR(S) took four swimmers to the rocky shore.

zh: 小型充氣登陸艇安靜，夜間難以被偵測。
en: An LCR(S) is quiet and hard to detect at night.

zh: 步兵登陸艇（支援型）以機槍火力掩護登陸。
en: The LCSL covered the landing with machine gun fire.

zh: 步兵登陸艇（支援型）攜帶武器來支援步兵登陸艇。
en: An LCSL carries weapons to support the infantry boats.

zh: 蛙人偵察登陸艇載著潛水員檢查海灘障礙物。
en: The LCSR carried divers to inspect the beach obstacles.

zh: 蛙人偵察登陸艇可以在不被察覺的情況下接近海岸。
en: An LCSR can approach the shore without being noticed.

zh: 小型支援登陸艇 Mk I 在登陸前對海灘發射火箭。
en: The LCS(S)(1) fired rockets at the beach before the landing.

zh: 小型支援登陸艇 Mk I 雖然小，卻載有數挺機槍。
en: An LCS(S)(1) is small but carries several machine guns.

zh: 小型支援登陸艇 Mk II 的裝甲比第一型更強。
en: The LCS(S)(2) had stronger armor than the first model.

zh: 小型支援登陸艇 Mk II 在登陸期間緊跟著步兵。
en: An LCS(S)(2) stayed close to the infantry during the landing.

zh: 戰車登陸艇一趟就把五輛坦克送上海岸。
en: The LCT delivered five tanks to the shore in one trip.

zh: 戰車登陸艇有平底，可以在海灘上登陸。
en: An LCT has a flat bottom for landing on a beach.

zh: 通用登陸艇把重型卡車與燃料運到島上。
en: The LCU moved heavy trucks and fuel to the island.

zh: 通用登陸艇用於載運多種貨物。
en: An LCU is used for many kinds of cargo.

zh: 車輛登陸艇載著一輛小卡車前往登陸地點。
en: The LCV carried a small truck to the landing site.

zh: 車輛登陸艇可以在沒有碼頭的情況下讓輕型車輛上岸。
en: An LCV can land light vehicles without a pier.

zh: 車輛人員登陸艇在第一波運載了三十名士兵。
en: The LCVP carried thirty soldiers in the first wave.

zh: 車輛人員登陸艇可以送一輛吉普車或一群部隊上岸。
en: An LCVP can land either a jeep or a group of troops.

zh: 近岸火力支援艦發射了數千枚火箭來整備海灘。
en: The LFR fired thousands of rockets to prepare the beach.

zh: 近岸火力支援艦在靠近海岸線處提供重火力。
en: An LFR provides heavy fire close to the shoreline.

zh: 兩棲火力支援艦以火砲與火箭掩護登陸。
en: The LFS covered the landing with guns and rockets.

zh: 兩棲火力支援艦停在靠近海灘處支援海軍陸戰隊。
en: An LFS stays near the beach to support the marines.

zh: 兩棲突擊艦載有一整個營及其直升機。
en: The LHA carried a full battalion and its helicopters.

zh: 兩棲突擊艦可以同時以空中與海上投送部隊。
en: An LHA can launch troops by air and by sea at the same time.

zh: 兩棲貨運艦把坦克與卡車卸到登陸艇上。
en: The LKA unloaded tanks and trucks onto the landing craft.

zh: 兩棲貨運艦載運兩棲部隊的重型貨物。
en: An LKA carries the heavy cargo of the amphibious force.

zh: 羅蘭遠程導航系統在夜間為領航員提供準確的位置。
en: The Loran gave the navigator an accurate position at night.

zh: 羅蘭遠程導航系統的訊號在遠離海岸處也能接收。
en: Loran signals can be received far from the coast.

zh: 兩棲運輸艦載運一個團的海軍陸戰隊橫越海洋。
en: The LPA carried a regiment of marines across the ocean.

zh: 兩棲運輸艦從艦的兩側放出登陸艇。
en: An LPA launches landing craft from its sides.

zh: 船塢登陸艦把車輛載在塢艙，把部隊安置在艙房。
en: The LPD carried vehicles in its well deck and troops in its quarters.

zh: 船塢登陸艦可以打開艦尾閘門放出小艇。
en: An LPD can open its stern gate to release small boats.

zh: 小型兩棲運輸艦在夜間送上岸一支小型突襲部隊。
en: The LPR landed a small raiding force at night.

zh: 小型兩棲運輸艦是改裝而成的中型船艦。
en: An LPR is a converted ship of moderate size.

zh: 船塢登陸艦對塢艙注水並放出登陸艇。
en: The LSD flooded its well deck and released the landing craft.

zh: 船塢登陸艦把小型艦艇載在艦體內部。
en: A dock landing ship carries small craft inside its hull.

zh: 兩棲艦隊旗艦擔任兩棲艦隊的旗艦。
en: The LSFF served as the flagship of the amphibious flotilla.

zh: 兩棲艦隊旗艦容納登陸部隊的指揮官與參謀。
en: An LSFF holds the commander and staff of the landing force.

zh: 步兵登陸艦載運步兵渡海前往登陸海灘。
en: The LSI carried infantry across the sea to the invasion beach.

zh: 步兵登陸艦載運了一整個營的士兵。
en: A landing ship, infantry carried a full battalion of soldiers.

zh: 步兵登陸艦以火砲支援海灘上的部隊。
en: The LSI(G) used its guns to support the troops on the beach.

zh: 步兵登陸艦除了士兵之外還載有火砲。
en: An LSI(G) carries guns in addition to its soldiers.

zh: 大型步兵登陸艦是登陸群中最大的艦艇。
en: The LSI(L) was the largest ship in the landing group.

zh: 大型步兵登陸艦可以載運數千名士兵橫越海洋。
en: An LSI(L) can carry thousands of soldiers across the ocean.

zh: 步兵登陸艦對敵方陣地發射迫擊砲彈。
en: The LSI(M) fired mortar shells at the enemy positions.

zh: 步兵登陸艦以間接火力支援登陸。
en: An LSI(M) supports the landing with indirect fire.

zh: 步兵登陸艦在步兵上岸時發射火箭。
en: The LSI(R) fired rockets as the infantry came ashore.

zh: 步兵登陸艦可以以火箭火力覆蓋海灘。
en: An LSI(R) can saturate the beach with rocket fire.

zh: 中型登陸艦載運數輛坦克到島上海灘。
en: The LSM carried a few tanks to the island beach.

zh: 中型登陸艦可以在海灘上打開艦艏艙門。
en: A medium landing ship can open its bow doors on the beach.

zh: 中型火箭登陸艦是一種裝有火箭發射器的中型登陸艦。
en: The LSM(R) was a medium landing ship fitted with rocket launchers.

zh: 中型火箭登陸艦是以火箭支援海灘突擊的中型登陸艦。
en: An LSM(R) is a medium landing ship that supports the beach assault with rockets.

zh: 大型支援登陸艦 Mk III 載有支援海灘的火箭與火砲。
en: The LSS(L) carried rockets and guns for beach support.

zh: 大型支援登陸艦 Mk III 停在靠近海岸處保護部隊。
en: An LSS(L) stays near the shore to protect the troops.

zh: 戰車登陸艦把坦克與卡車直接運到海灘上。
en: The LST carried tanks and trucks directly onto the beach.

zh: 戰車登陸艦在艦艏有一道大型艙門。
en: A tank landing ship has a large door at the bow.

zh: 戰車登陸艦把傷員運離登陸海灘。
en: The LSTH carried the wounded away from the invasion beach.

zh: 戰車登陸艦配有病床與醫護人員。
en: An LSTH was fitted with beds and medical staff.

zh: 通用登陸艦載運各式車輛與一般補給品。
en: The LSTS carried a mix of vehicles and general supplies.

zh: 通用登陸艦可以在平緩的海灘上卸載貨物。
en: An LSTS can unload its cargo on a gentle beach.

zh: 通用登陸艦把燃料與卡車運到島上。
en: The LSU brought fuel and trucks to the island.

zh: 通用登陸艦是把補給品運送到近岸處的有用船艦。
en: An LSU is a useful ship for moving supplies close to shore.

zh: 車輛登陸艦載運大量卡車橫渡海洋。
en: The LSV carried a large number of trucks across the sea.

zh: 車輛登陸艦有一條長而開放的供車輛使用的貨艙甲板。
en: An LSV has a long and open cargo deck for vehicles.

zh: 大型拖船把駁船拖離碼頭。
en: The LT pulled the barges away from the pier.

zh: 大型拖船被陸軍用來在港口移動裝備。
en: An LT is used by the army to move equipment in the harbor.

zh: 突擊登陸車越過礁石登上該島。
en: The LVA crossed the reef and landed on the island.

zh: 裝卸駁船把商船上的木箱卸到碼頭。
en: The YS unloaded crates from the merchant ship at the pier.

zh: 裝卸駁船協助碼頭工人搬運貨物。
en: A stevedoring barge helps the dock workers move cargo.

zh: 水上機打撈起重船把一架受損的水上機從水中吊起。
en: The YSD lifted a damaged seaplane from the water.

zh: 水上機打撈起重船載有起重機以回收降落在海上的飛機。
en: A YSD carries a crane to recover aircraft that land in the sea.

zh: 污泥清除駁船清除港底的泥巴與廢棄物。
en: The YSR removed mud and waste from the bottom of the harbor.

zh: 污泥清除駁船讓泊位免於廢棄物堆積。
en: A YSR keeps the berths clear of waste.

zh: 存放浮筒保存著浮橋的各個部件。
en: The YSP held the pieces of the floating bridge.

zh: 存放浮筒用來在水上存放裝備。
en: A stowage pontoon is used to store equipment on the water.

zh: 港勤拖船把受損的船推到修理碼頭。
en: The YT pushed the damaged ship to the repair pier.

zh: 港勤拖船協助較大的船艦進出港口。
en: A harbor tug helps larger ships enter and leave the port.

zh: 大型港勤拖船拖著航空母艦通過狹窄的港口入口。
en: The YTB towed the carrier through the narrow harbor entrance.

zh: 大型港勤拖船的動力比小型的更強。
en: A large harbor tug has more power than a small one.

zh: 小型港勤拖船在擁擠的碼頭周圍移動駁船。
en: The YTL moved the barges around the crowded pier.

zh: 小型港勤拖船在狹窄的地方作業良好。
en: A small harbor tug works well in narrow places.

zh: 中型港勤拖船把貨運駁運船拖到島上。
en: The YTM towed the cargo lighter to the island.

zh: 中型港勤拖船的大小介於小型與大型之間。
en: A medium harbor tug is between the small and large sizes.

zh: 魚雷試驗駁船把魚雷運到試驗場進行發射試驗。
en: The YTT carried torpedoes to the test range for firing trials.

zh: 魚雷試驗駁船記錄每枚魚雷的航跡。
en: A torpedo testing barge records the path of each torpedo.

zh: 無人機彈射管制艇管制彈射器發射的無人機。
en: The YV controlled the drone aircraft launched by the catapult.

zh: 無人機彈射管制艇載有發射標靶飛機的裝備。
en: A YV carried the equipment for launching target aircraft.

zh: 彈射器駁運船把一具重型彈射器運到航空母艦。
en: The YVC moved a heavy catapult to the carrier.

zh: 彈射器駁運船有堅固的甲板來承載重型裝備。
en: A catapult lighter has strong decks to hold heavy equipment.

zh: 運水駁船把淡水送給下錨的船艦。
en: The YW brought fresh water to the ships at anchor.

zh: 運水駁船有自己的引擎，可以前往各艘船。
en: A YW has its own engine and can move to each ship.

zh: 運水駁船為碼頭上的人員存放飲用水。
en: The YWN held drinking water for the men on the pier.

zh: 運水駁船依賴拖船才能抵達各船。
en: A YWN relies on a tug to reach the ships.

zh: 兩棲裝甲車排在午夜前進入集結區。
en: The AAV platoon moved to the assembly area before midnight.

zh: 海軍陸戰隊員在碼頭把兩棲裝甲車裝上兩棲艦。
en: Marines loaded the AAVs onto the amphibious ship at the pier.

zh: 每輛兩棲裝甲車除了乘員之外，還載運一個步槍班。
en: Each AAV carries a rifle squad in addition to its crew.

zh: 這輛兩棲裝甲車的駕駛員在洶湧的浪區中朝海灘駛去。
en: The driver of the AAV steered toward the beach through heavy surf.

zh: 數輛兩棲裝甲車在近水線的軟沙中拋錨。
en: Several AAVs stalled in the soft sand near the water line.

zh: 步兵戰車與兩棲裝甲車一同向內陸推進。
en: The IFVs and the AAVs advanced inland together.

zh: 指揮官命令兩棲裝甲車在海岸線堅守陣地。
en: The commander ordered the AAVs to hold position at the shoreline.

zh: 工兵在長距離渡水之後檢查了兩棲裝甲車的履帶。
en: Engineers inspected the AAV tracks after the long water crossing.

zh: 3月14日，我們在港口清點到12輛兩棲裝甲車。
en: On March 14th, we counted 12 AAVs at the harbor.

zh: 兩棲裝甲車比主戰坦克輕，裝甲也比較薄。
en: An AAV is lighter than an MBT and carries thinner armor.

zh: 該連為登陸演習部署了二十輛兩棲裝甲車。
en: The company deployed twenty AAVs for the landing exercise.

zh: 乘員在渡水期間於兩棲裝甲車內穿著救生衣。
en: Crews wore life vests inside the AAV during the water crossing.

zh: 天氣轉壞時，該營損失了兩輛兩棲裝甲車。
en: The battalion lost two AAVs when the weather turned bad.

zh: 技師在野外更換了受損兩棲裝甲車的引擎。
en: A mechanic replaced the engine of the damaged AAV in the field.

zh: 兩棲裝甲車在橫渡潟湖之前排成橫隊。
en: The AAVs formed a line abreast before crossing the lagoon.

zh: 觀察員通報兩棲裝甲車正朝北方海灘駛去。
en: Observers reported that the AAVs were heading toward the northern beach.

zh: 訓練基地把兩棲裝甲車存放在潟湖附近的有頂棚庫房。
en: The training base keeps its AAVs in a covered shed near the lagoon.

zh: 兩棲裝甲車在水邊停下，直到信號到達。
en: The AAV stopped at the edge of the water until the signal arrived.

zh: 衛星影像顯示8輛兩棲裝甲車停在碼頭旁。
en: Satellite imagery showed 8 AAVs parked beside the pier.

zh: 部隊指揮官在登陸開始前檢查了每一輛兩棲裝甲車。
en: The unit commander inspected each AAV before the landing began.

zh: 作者希望本報告所含的資訊能填補學術研究上的重大空白，成為解放軍研究界的寶貴資源，並有助於推動對解放軍火箭軍的進一步研究與更深入的理解。
en: The author hopes that the information contained in this report will fill a critical gap in scholarship, serve as a valuable resource to the PLA research community, and help facilitate further research and greater understanding of the PLARF.

zh: 這個單位負責的基地支援職能包括警衛、工程、氣象、測繪與核生化防護。
en: Base support functions handled by this unit include security, engineering, meteorology, survey and mapping, and NBC defense.

zh: 64基地是唯一設有裝檢旅而非裝檢團的基地。
en: Base 64 is the only base which has an Equipment Inspection Brigade rather than regiment.

zh: 61基地另有一個團負責無人飛行載具作業，63基地另有一個團主要負責為其液體燃料洲際彈道飛彈加註燃料。
en: Base 61 also hosts one additional regiment responsible for UAV operations, while Base 63 hosts one additional regiment responsible primarily for fueling of its liquid-fueled ICBMs.

zh: 從2019年開始，這些部隊代號正逐步淘汰，改用969xx系列，但截至2020年仍有許多在使用。
en: Beginning in 2019, these MUCDs are being slowly phased out and replaced with the 969xx series, but many are still used as of 2020.

zh: 但願這次對解放軍火箭軍部隊代號的去神祕化，能讓日後的單位辨識更容易。
en: Hopefully this de-mystification of PLARF MUCDs will make unit identification easier in the future.

zh: 它們是解放軍火箭軍的參謀部、政治工作部、裝備部與後勤部。
en: These are the PLARF Staff Department, Political Work Department, Equipment Department, and Logistics Department.

zh: 這一點尚未獲得官方消息來源證實。
en: This has not been confirmed by official sources.

zh: 它也可能具備無人飛行載具或其他空中能力，用於執行空中攝影。
en: It may also have a UAV or other airborne capability to conduct aerial photography.

zh: 它位於台灣海峽附近，顯示在與台灣發生衝突時，它會在目標獲得上扮演角色，包括針對反艦彈道飛彈的目標獲得。
en: Its location near the Taiwan Strait suggests it would play a role in target acquisition, including for ASBMs, in the event of conflict with Taiwan.

zh: 眉山東南方有一座小型軍用機場，已知供解放軍空軍的殲-6無人機駐用，但不確定該機場是否也與這個單位有關。
en: There is a small military airfield to the southeast of Meishan known to house PLAAF J-6 drones, although it is unknown if it is also associated with this unit.

zh: 截至2016年，它似乎是唯一的非文職成員。
en: As of 2016 it appears to be the only non-civilian member.

zh: 它與火箭軍士官學校第4學員大隊同駐於豐潤的一處大型訓練設施。
en: It is co-located with the 4th Student Group of the Rocket Force NCO School at a large training facility in Fengrun.

zh: 發射旅每天從這個單位取得氣象報告，並結合自身的氣象能力，規劃最佳的發射窗口。
en: Launch brigades receive daily weather reports from this unit, which they use in combination with their own meteorological capabilities to plan optimal launch windows.

zh: 這個單位可能主要負責對地攻擊巡弋飛彈的導航與導引研究，特別著重於數位景象匹配區域相關（DSMAC）導引。
en: This unit may be primarily responsible for research into LACM navigation and guidance, with a specific focus on DSMAC (digital scene matching area and correlation) guidance.

zh: 目前尚不清楚它是否已改隸戰略支援部隊，或仍隸屬於解放軍火箭軍。
en: It remains unclear as to whether it has been resubordinated to the Strategic Support Force, or remains under the PLARF.

zh: 它負責儲存與運輸解放軍火箭軍的裝備，包括車輛等重型裝備，並擁有自己的鐵路運輸與武裝押運能力。
en: It is responsible for storing and transporting PLARF equipment, including heavy equipment such as vehicles, and has its own rail transport and armed escort capabilities.

zh: 它可以在天然災害期間部署，提供衛生與防疫支援。
en: It can deploy to provide sanitation and epidemic prevention support during natural disasters.

zh: 士官學校學員經常被派到這個基地接受野外訓練。
en: NCO School cadets are often sent to this base for field training.

zh: 有一份消息來源稱它是後勤部非任務必要物資與零組件的主要倉庫。
en: One source describes it as the Logistics Department's primary depot for non-mission essential materials and components.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍後勤部在北京大興郊區設有一處基地，從事新農業技術的試驗、培育與訓練。
en: The PLARF Logistics Department maintains a base for testing, cultivation, and training in new agricultural techniques in the Daxing suburb of Beijing.

zh: 這些基地的優先事項之一，是創新農業技術，讓駐在困難環境的工作單位能自行種植糧食，改善人員的飲食與營養攝取。
en: Among the priorities for these bases is innovating agricultural techniques to allow work units based in difficult environments to grow their own food, improving personnel diet and nutritional intake.

zh: 它似乎具有雙重功能：既為人員提供療養照護，包括有藥物成癮問題者，也是授予頂尖幹部的休養度假地點。
en: It appears to serve dual functions of providing convalescent care to personnel, including those with drug addiction issues, as well as serving as a rest/vacation destination awarded to top cadres.

zh: 它既是人員休養的場所，也是獎勵模範人員及其家人卓越服務的度假地點。
en: It serves as a spot for recuperating personnel, as well as a vacation spot awarded to model personnel and their families for exemplary service.

zh: 它的維修任務可能著重於某些複雜的精密裝備，例如飛彈雷射指示器，以及某些飛彈零件、發射車與支援裝備。
en: Its repair mission may focus on certain types of complex precision equipment like missile laser targeters, as well as certain missile parts, launch vehicles, and support equipment.

zh: 這個單位負責飛彈的檢測與維修，重點在固體火箭發動機。
en: This unit is responsible for missile inspection and repair, with a focus on solid rocket engines.

zh: 它也負責飛彈指揮與管制系統維修、緊急飛彈快速修復、飛彈壽命監控與預警，以及飛彈整修與延壽。
en: It is also responsible for missile command and control system repair, rapid emergency missile repairs, missile lifespan monitoring and warning, and missile renovation and life extension.

zh: 該單位每年對多種飛彈進行檢測與驗證，並把飛彈在作戰地點與單位工廠之間往返運輸，以供檢測。
en: The unit conducts annual inspections and verifications of multiple missile types, transporting missiles to and from operations sites to unit factories for inspection.

zh: 它為數個發射旅的飛彈發射裝備提供維修支援，每年隨這些旅部署數次（最多10次）進行聯合訓練，時間從1至2週到數個月不等。
en: It provides maintenance support for missile launch equipment to several launch brigades, deploying several (up to 10) times per year along with these brigades for joint training lasting from 1-2 weeks to several months.

zh: 該單位先到發射旅了解他們需要維修哪些裝備，再外出招募能維修那些特定裝備的人員。
en: The unit recruited by first going to the launch brigades and figuring out which equipment they would need to maintain, then going out and recruiting personnel capable of repairing that specific equipment.

zh: 該單位每年舉行數次這類快速動員演練。
en: The unit holds several such rapid mobilization drills every year.

zh: 該基地還有獨特的支援體系：一個旅負責大量短程常規飛彈的測試與運輸，另有自己的無人飛行載具團，負責台灣海峽上空的情報、監視與偵察。
en: The Base also has a unique support system, with a brigade responsible for testing and transport of its high number of short-range conventional missiles, and its own UAV regiment for ISR over the Taiwan Strait.

zh: 它近期配備的是核武型東風-21A中程彈道飛彈，但可能很快換裝新系統，也許是東風-31的某個衍生型。
en: As of recently, it was equipped with the nuclear DF-21A MRBM, but it may soon be equipped with a new system, possibly some variant of the DF-31.

zh: 它近期配備的是核武型東風-21A中程彈道飛彈，但可能已經換裝新系統，很可能是東風-31AG洲際彈道飛彈。
en: As of recently, it was equipped with the nuclear DF-21A MRBM, but it may already be equipped with a new system, likely the DF-31AG ICBM.

zh: 本報告中的推定編成，代表依據多個實例所估計的編制。
en: Presumed compositions in this report represent the estimated structure based on multiple examples.

zh: 它配備的是相對老舊的東風-15，因此很適合改裝為東風-17，但這仍有待證實。
en: The fact that it is equipped with the relatively old DF-15 makes it a good candidate for conversion to the DF-17, but this remains to be confirmed.

zh: 它後來升級為改良的東風-11衍生型。
en: It has since upgraded to an improved DF-11 variant.

zh: 它可能很快就會升級為新系統。
en: It may soon upgrade to a new system.

zh: 這是根據其與發射區的距離，以及東風-15參與演習的影像所做的判斷。
en: This is based upon proximity to the launch area combined with images of DF-15s participating in the exercises.

zh: 駐紮在中國東部城市金華的617旅，是第二個配備東風-16短程彈道飛彈的旅。
en: The 617 Brigade, garrisoned in the eastern Chinese city of Jinhua, was the second brigade equipped with the DF-16 SRBM.

zh: 因此該基地開始把作戰技能納入基礎訓練。
en: The base thus began incorporating operations skills into basic training.

zh: 與大多數國家由紅軍扮演侵略者的做法不同，解放軍秉持馬列主義者的立場，指定藍軍擔任這個角色，而紅軍是本方部隊。
en: Unlike most countries, in which the Red Team plays the role of aggressor, as good Marxist-Leninists the PLA designates the Blue Team for this role, while the Red Team is the home force.

zh: 這個團負責61基地的通信。
en: This regiment is responsible for Base 61 communications.

zh: 這使這個單位在解放軍火箭軍的綜合保障團中獨樹一格，因為它沒有納入基地技術勤務團，後者仍是獨立的單位。
en: This makes this unit unique among the PLARF's comprehensive support regiments by not incorporating the base Technical Service Regiment, which remains a distinct unit.

zh: 依據其組成部分，它大概會包括分散在多處的維修資產與飛彈倉庫。
en: Based upon its component parts, it would presumably include repair assets and missile depots spread across multiple locations.

zh: 這一點頗具爭議，因為有些人認為有限的發射機會應保留給訓練發射專業人員，但後來認為有必要讓測試專業人員更了解飛彈。
en: This was somewhat controversial, as some believed that limited launch opportunities should be reserved for training launch specialists, but was deemed necessary to allow testing specialists to better understand the missiles.

zh: 61基地裝檢團負責儲存、管理與運輸該基地的核彈頭。
en: The Base 61 Equipment Inspection Regiment is responsible for storage, management, and transport of the Base’s nuclear warheads.

zh: 尚不清楚這個團是否仍駐在該處，但解放軍火箭軍的另一個無人飛行載具部隊目前駐在該處。
en: It is unclear if this regiment is still active at that location, but the PLARF’s other UAV unit is currently garrisoned at that location.

zh: 與其他基地醫院一樣，它指揮野戰醫療小組，負責在戰時為61基地的單位提供醫療支援。
en: Like the other base hospitals, it commands field medical teams tasked with providing medical support to Base 61 units in wartime.

zh: 訓練科目包括核生化防護與戰場醫學。
en: Training subjects included NBC defense and battlefield medicine.

zh: 它指揮兩個公路機動洲際彈道飛彈旅、兩個核常兼備的中遠程彈道飛彈旅、一個對地攻擊巡弋飛彈旅、一個反艦彈道飛彈旅，以及可能是解放軍火箭軍第一個極音速中程彈道飛彈旅。
en: It commands two road-mobile ICBM brigades, two dual nuclear-conventional IRBM brigades, one LACM brigade, one ASBM brigade, and likely the PLARF’s first hypersonic MRBM brigade.

zh: 它最近向內陸遷移，顯示正在改裝射程更遠的系統。
en: Its recent move inland suggests conversion to a longer range system.

zh: 從2020年開始，這個旅可能已著手改裝為一種身分不明的新型飛彈，但目前沒有跡象顯示那是什麼。
en: Beginning in 2020, this brigade may have begun conversion to an unidentified new missile type, although there are as yet no indications as to what it might be.

zh: 就這個旅的情況而言，考慮到它最近遷往南海的海南，任何新飛彈都合理地具備反艦能力。
en: In the case of this brigade, it would make sense that any new missile would have an anti-ship capability, given this brigade’s recent move to Hainan in the South China Sea.

zh: 有一份消息來源把它描述為一種新型作戰力量，以其新型飛彈為核心，並有新的指揮系統與兵力結構。
en: It is described by one source as a new type of operations force centered around its new missile, with a new command system and force structure.

zh: 這次遷移伴隨著改換新型飛彈，據信是東風-26中遠程彈道飛彈。
en: This move came with a transition to a new missile type, believed to be the DF-26 IRBM.

zh: 位於東南部城市普寧的627旅成立於2017年3月，是一支「新型作戰力量」。它很可能是第一個配備東風-17極音速滑翔載具的旅，而且似乎已具備完整戰力。
en: The 627 Brigade, located in the southeast Chinese city of Puning, was established in March 2017 as a “new type of operations force.” It is likely the first brigade equipped with the DF-17 hypersonic glide vehicle, and appears to have achieved full combat capability.

zh: 62基地訓練團負責62基地士兵的基礎訓練。
en: The Base 62 Training Regiment is responsible for basic training of Base 62 enlisted personnel.

zh: 他們必須精通一個職位，同時對另外1至2個職位有一定的實務了解。
en: They must be skilled in one billet, while having some working knowledge of 1-2 other billets.

zh: CJ-10與東風-21D都部署在62基地的旅。
en: The CJ-10 and DF-21D are both deployed with Base 62 brigades.

zh: 它也負責訓練該基地至少部分的女性人員。
en: It is also responsible for the training of at least some of the base’s female personnel.

zh: 62基地裝檢團負責該基地核彈頭的儲存、管理與運輸。
en: The Base 62 Equipment Inspection Regiment is in charge of storage, management, and transport of the base’s nuclear warheads.

zh: 這些醫療小組能在野外提供各種醫療服務，包括戰場手術。
en: These medical teams are capable of conducting a wide range of medical services in the field, including battlefield surgery.

zh: 自2017年起，它已從五個飛彈旅擴編為六個。
en: Since 2017 it has expanded from five to six missile brigades.

zh: 它位於內陸南部城市懷化，據信配備東風-5發射井式洲際彈道飛彈的最新B型。
en: It is located in the inland southern Chinese city of Huaihua and believed to be equipped with the newest B variant of the DF-5 silo-based ICBM.

zh: 據一份消息來源指出，這導致大批資深人員退役，並出現領導力不足的問題。
en: According to one source, this led to the retirement of a high number of veteran personnel and problems with a lack of leadership.

zh: 632旅位於內陸南部城市邵陽，配備東風-31公路機動洲際彈道飛彈的最新東風-31AG衍生型。
en: The 632 Brigade is located in the inland southern Chinese city of Shaoyang and equipped with the latest DF-31AG variant of the DF-31 road-mobile ICBM.

zh: 它配備東風-5發射井式洲際彈道飛彈的一種衍生型。
en: It is equipped with a variant of the DF-5 silo-based ICBM.

zh: 這是駐在內陸南部城市懷化的第三個飛彈旅。
en: This is the third missile brigade to be garrisoned in the inland southern Chinese city of Huaihua.

zh: 它是第一個配備東風-16的單位，現在可能同時配備東風-16與東風-16A。
en: It was the first unit equipped with the DF-16, and may now be equipped with both the DF-16 and DF-16A.

zh: 這種技能不匹配起初造成必須克服的問題，但該營在成立僅三個月後，就成功完成了一次重大發射任務。
en: This mismatch of skillsets initially presented a problem that had to be overcome, but the Battalion was able to successfully carry out a major launch mission only three months after formation.

zh: 在第三年，它執行了第一次值勤任務。
en: In its third year it carried out its first on-duty mission.

zh: 這個團負責63基地士兵的訓練。
en: This regiment is responsible for training of Base 63 enlisted personnel.

zh: 若是如此，它負責武器與裝備的儲存、管理與運輸，並負責裝備的修理與保養。
en: If so, it is responsible for weapons and equipment storage, management, and transportation, in addition to equipment repair and maintenance.

zh: 一份消息來源指出，它保有鐵路運輸能力，顯示它可能仍在運輸基地的其他裝備。
en: One source states that it retains its rail transport capability, suggesting it may still transport other base equipment.

zh: 約在2006年成立的63基地裝檢團，負責該基地核彈頭的儲存、管理與運輸。
en: The Base 63 Equipment Inspection Regiment, established around 2006, is responsible for storage, management, and transport of the Base’s nuclear warheads.

zh: 然而該消息來源是2016年的，因此這個連有可能已經轉隸勤務團。
en: However the source is from 2016, and it is thus possible this company has since been transferred to the Service Regiment.

zh: 96603部隊醫院是63基地的官方醫院。
en: The Unit 96603 Hospital is the official hospital attached to Base 63.

zh: 自2017年起，它的規模已近乎倍增，從四個飛彈旅擴編為七個。
en: Since 2017 it has nearly doubled in size, expanding from four to seven missile brigades.

zh: 它位於中部城市韓城，可能配備東風-31公路機動洲際彈道飛彈。
en: It is located in the central Chinese city of Hancheng and possibly equipped with the DF-31 road-mobile ICBM.

zh: 到2018年，它已改換為一種身分不明的新型飛彈，衛星影像顯示出與東風-31相關的基礎設施正在擴建，不過截至本文撰寫時仍沒有確切證據。
en: By 2018 it had converted to an unidentified new missile type, and satellite imagery suggests a buildout of infrastructure associated with the DF-31, although there is no definitive proof as of this writing.

zh: 然而，對基地基礎設施的分析目前尚未提供支持這一點的證據。
en: However analysis of base infrastructure does not yet provide supporting evidence for this.

zh: 2017年的消息來源顯示，它最近已改換為新的衍生型，可能是東風-31AG。
en: Sources from 2017 suggest it has recently converted to a new variant, possibly the DF-31AG.

zh: 2017年在中部城市漢中成立的644旅，很可能是第一個配備最新東風-41公路機動洲際彈道飛彈的旅。
en: The 644 Brigade, established in 2017 in the central Chinese city of Hanzhong, is likely the first equipped with the newest DF-41 road-mobile ICBM.

zh: 截至2020年底，這個旅的資訊極少。
en: Very little information has emerged on this brigade as of late 2020.

zh: 這個旅值得注意的是，它同時承擔核與常規打擊任務，這是第一次確認單一旅具備這種雙重任務。
en: This brigade is notable for being tasked with both nuclear and conventional strike missions, the first time this type of dual mission had been confirmed within a single brigade.

zh: 這項差異的意義並不立即明朗。
en: The significance of this difference is not immediately clear.

zh: 這是目前唯一確認具備這項能力的旅，但它也引出一種可能：解放軍火箭軍部分或全部的東風-26旅，可能被賦予同樣的任務。
en: This is so far the only brigade confirmed to possess this capability, but it raises the possibility that some or all PLARF DF-26 brigades could be tasked in the same way.

zh: 這個團負責訓練分派到這個基地的新兵。
en: This regiment is responsible for training of new enlisted personnel assigned to this base.

zh: 它也負責這些資產以及64基地其他設施與裝備的修理與保養。
en: It is also responsible for repair and maintenance of these assets as well as other Base 64 facilities and equipment.

zh: 城北區司令部位於一座火車站旁，可能利用該車站執行其運輸任務。
en: The Chengbei District HQ is located next to a railway station, which it may make use of for its transport mission.

zh: 值得注意的是，64基地是唯一指揮旅級裝檢單位的基地。
en: Notably, Base 64 is the only base to command a brigade-sized Equipment Inspection unit.

zh: 目前不清楚它與位於蘭州的96604部隊醫院之間的關係。
en: It is unclear what its relationship is with the separate Unit 96604 Hospital in Lanzhou.

zh: 自2017年初以來，它的規模已倍增，從三個飛彈旅擴編為六個。
en: Since the beginning of 2017 it has doubled in size, expanding from three to six missile brigades.

zh: 較新的證據顯示，它已改換為東風-31洲際彈道飛彈的一種不明衍生型。
en: More recent evidence suggests it has converted to an unknown variant of the DF-31 ICBM.

zh: 從2019年開始，這個旅可能已著手改換為另一種不明的新型飛彈。
en: Beginning in 2019, this brigade may have begun converting to another unknown new missile.

zh: 因此，2019年以前的消息來源會把這個旅列為駐在萊蕪。
en: Thus, sources prior to 2019 will list this brigade as being located in Laiwu.

zh: 目前沒有確切證據顯示這種新型飛彈是什麼，但推測可能是東風-26（也許是反艦衍生型），或是目前所知甚少的最新東風-21E。
en: There is currently no firm evidence as to what this new missile type may be, but speculatively it could be the DF-26, perhaps an anti-ship variant, or the newest DF-21E, of which little is currently known.

zh: 有一些初步證據顯示，這個單位可能配備東風-17極音速飛彈。
en: There is some initial evidence this unit may be equipped with the DF-17 hypersonic missile.

zh: 雖然尚未得到確切證實，初步證據顯示這可能是第一個配備最新CJ-100對地攻擊巡弋飛彈的旅。
en: While not yet definitively confirmed, initial evidence suggest this may be the first brigade equipped with the newest CJ-100 LACM.

zh: 這是一個全部或幾乎全部由女性組成的分隊。
en: It is an all or mostly all female subunit.

zh: 65基地作戰保障團可能成立於2012年前後，負責多項保障專業，包括警衛、核生化防護、工程、氣象、測繪與應急回應。
en: The Base 65 Operations Support Regiment was likely established around 2012 and is responsible for several support specialties including security, NBC defense, engineering, meteorology, survey and mapping, and emergency response.

zh: 因此，該團負責基地裝備的維護與修理，負責儲存飛彈、燃料、彈藥、車輛與其他補給品，並負責經由公路與鐵路把這些資產運送到65基地的各單位。
en: The regiment is thus responsible for maintenance and repair of base equipment, storage of missiles, fuel, munitions, vehicles and other supplies, and transport of these assets via road and rail to Base 65 units.

zh: 它的位置靠近鐵軌，顯示可能參與鐵路運輸。
en: Its position near rail tracks suggests possible involvement with rail transport.

zh: 65基地裝檢團負責儲存、管理與運輸65基地的核彈頭。
en: The Base 65 Equipment Inspection Regiment is responsible for storage, management, and transport of Base 65 nuclear warheads.

zh: 它的人員以軍人為主，但也聘用少數文職人員，包括四名護理長。
en: Its staff is primarily military, though it does employ a small number of civilian personnel, including four head nurses.

zh: 它派遣醫療小組為通化附近的社區與解放軍退伍軍人服務，同時也為第一線單位提供醫療照護。
en: It dispatches medical teams to serve communities and PLA veterans in the vicinity of Tonghua, as well as providing medical care to first line units.

zh: 自2017年起，它已從四個飛彈旅擴編為六個。
en: Since 2017 it has expanded from four to six missile brigades.

zh: 近期的工程顯示，這可能是新的發射井式東風-41，但這仍屬推測。
en: Recent construction suggests this may be a new silo-based DF-41, but this remains speculative.

zh: 位於中部城市南陽的663旅，配備東風-31A公路機動洲際彈道飛彈。
en: The 663 Brigade, located in the central Chinese city of Nanyang, is equipped with the DF-31A road-mobile ICBM.

zh: 它現在很可能配備東風-31公路機動洲際彈道飛彈的最新東風-31AG衍生型。
en: It is likely now equipped with the latest DF-31AG variant of the DF-31 road-mobile ICBM.

zh: 早期消息來源指出該旅駐在衛輝，但後來的消息來源把它列在長治，顯示衛輝可能只是早期的臨時駐地。
en: Early sources had the brigade stationed in Weihui, but later sources place it in Changzhi, indicating Weihui may have been an early temporary garrison.

zh: 66基地訓練團負責66基地新兵的基礎訓練，以及上崗前的專業訓練。
en: The Base 66 Training Regiment is responsible for basic training of new enlisted base personnel, as well as pre-billet specialist training.

zh: 它也可能在其他保障職能中扮演角色，例如伙食準備、車輛駕駛，以及某些保障人員的訓練。
en: It may also have a role in other support functions, such as food preparation, vehicle driving, and training of certain support personnel.

zh: 這個團過去負責把核彈頭、飛彈、彈藥、燃料與其他零組件儲存並運送到66基地的各單位。
en: This regiment was responsible for storage and transport of nuclear warheads, missiles, munitions, fuel, and other components to Base 66 units.

zh: 前技術勤務團可能的司令部，僅在幾個街區之外。
en: The likely headquarters of the former Technical Service Regiment is only a few blocks away.

zh: 66基地裝檢團負責儲存、管理與運輸66基地的核彈頭。
en: The Base 66 Equipment Inspection Regiment is responsible for storage, management, and transport of Base 66 nuclear warheads.

zh: 因此，這些營此後開始交叉訓練，現在能夠處理多種飛彈。
en: Thus, the battalions have since begun cross-training and are now able to handle multiple missile types.

zh: 它隸屬於66基地保障部。
en: It is subordinate to the Base 66 Support Department.

zh: 到1997年它正式編入解放軍火箭軍時，已有30名人員與188隻犬。
en: By 1997, when it was formally incorporated into the PLARF, it had 30 personnel and 188 dogs.

zh: 該單位似乎隸屬於66基地，並位於661旅的一處衛星設施，但不清楚它是隸屬於這個旅，還是直接隸屬於66基地。
en: The unit appears to be subordinate to Base 66 and located at a satellite facility of the 661 Brigade, although it is unclear if it is subordinate to this brigade, or directly subordinate to Base 66.

zh: 與這個基地有關的單位經常使用「國寶」一詞，作為指稱核武庫的間接說法。
en: Units associated with this base frequently invoke the term "National Treasure" as an oblique reference to the nuclear stockpile.

zh: 它位於市區較中心的位置，這可能是一個基地行政中心。
en: More centrally located in the city, this may be a base administrative center.

zh: 這些事實似乎暗示，該單位的任務包括飛彈及（或）彈頭組件的檢測，並可能包括維修。
en: These facts seem to imply the unit includes inspection and possibly repair of missile and/or warhead components as a part of its mission.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍應急處置大隊於2008年由一個警衛與防化營改編成立，負責核生化應急回應與災害援助。
en: The PLARF Emergency Management Group, established in 2008 from a security and chemical defense battalion, is responsible for NBC emergency response and disaster assistance.

zh: 它也可能為負責核彈頭處理與管理的作戰基地人員提供訓練。
en: It may also provide training for operations base personnel tasked with nuclear warhead handling and management.

zh: 這個新單位從原本單純的裝備與車輛修理任務，轉為負責全面的裝備與後勤保障，包括車輛與裝備的修理、儲存與運輸，並可能包括醫療與炊事保障等其他後勤專業。
en: The new unit went from having a simple equipment and vehicle repair mission to being responsible for comprehensive equipment and logistics support, including vehicle and equipment repair, storage, and transport, as well as possibly other logistical specialties like medical and culinary support.

zh: 經過訓練，它設法把這些比率分別提高到80%與100%。
en: Through training it managed to raise these rates to 80% and 100%, respectively.

zh: 這可能是對彈頭本身的間接指稱。
en: This could be an oblique reference to the warhead itself.

zh: 另一份消息來源提到，該研究所從事延壽與整修。
en: Another source mentions the Institute is engaged in lifespan extension and renovations.

zh: 它能經由公路與鐵路運輸彈頭，甚至還具備空運能力。
en: It is capable of transporting warheads via both road and rail, and even possesses an air transport capability.

zh: 2012年改編之後，這些團被改編為旅。
en: Following its reorganization in 2012, these regiments were converted to brigades.

zh: 它在戰時也會負責隧道、道路、橋梁與飛彈陣地的緊急修復。
en: It would also be responsible for emergency repairs of tunnels, roads, bridges, and missile sites in wartime.

zh: 它在戰時也會負責緊急工程支援，包括迅速修復道路、橋梁、隧道與其他基礎設施。
en: It would also be responsible for emergency engineering support in wartime, including rapid repairs to roads, bridges, tunnels, and other infrastructure.

zh: 2008年，它是汶川地震的早期救援單位之一。
en: In 2008, it was an early responder to the earthquake in Wenchuan.

zh: 混凝土加固被描述為該旅的「核心」任務。
en: Concrete reinforcement is described as a “core” mission for the brigade.

zh: 它在戰時也會負責隧道、道路與橋梁的緊急修復。
en: In wartime it would also be responsible for emergency repairs of tunnels, roads, and bridges.

zh: 它在2010年之後的某個時間點由團改編為旅，很可能是2012年改編的一部分。
en: It converted from a regiment to a brigade at some point after 2010, likely as part of the 2012 reorganization.

zh: 它也被發現安裝鋼製支撐梁、監視攝影機、感測器與控制系統，以及一部18噸的柴油發電機，並負責隧道粉刷。
en: It has also been noted installing steel support girders, security cameras, sensors, and control systems, and an 18 ton diesel generator, as well as being responsible for tunnel whitewashing.

zh: 這包括北京的一項大型工程，涉及供水、電力與通風設備的安裝。
en: This included a major project in Beijing that involved water, electrical, and ventilation installation.

zh: 前96544部隊因對2008年四川地震的出色應變而受到表彰。
en: The former Unit 96544 was recognized for its excellent response to the 2008 Sichuan earthquake.

zh: 消息來源明確指出，這並非罕見的情形。
en: The source makes clear that this is not an uncommon occurrence.

zh: 他們從事道路、橋梁與機場的修建與修復。
en: They were engaged in building and restoring roads, bridges, and airfields.

zh: 它能在戰時或緊急狀況下，部署並迅速架設野戰機動通信樞紐。
en: It is capable of deploying and rapidly setting up field mobile communications hubs during wartime or emergencies.

zh: 在戰時，96882部隊的任務是在需要的地方架設通信節點，96885部隊的任務是修復並恢復受損的通信線路。
en: In wartime, Unit 96882 is tasked with setting up communications nodes where needed, and Unit 96885 is tasked with repairing and restoring damaged communications lines.

zh: 這個團也負責在通信基礎設施受損或遭毀時進行緊急修復。
en: This regiment is also tasked with conducting emergency repairs of communications infrastructure if damaged or destroyed.

zh: 這是661旅部分單位的已知所在地。
en: This is a known location for elements of the 661 Brigade.

zh: 它原本駐在吉林，越來越多證據顯示它可能已在2019年遷往銀川。
en: Originally garrisoned in Jilin, there is growing evidence that it may have moved to Yinchuan in 2019.

zh: 這個單位有可能曾暫時駐在靖宇，直到它位於銀川的司令部開始運作。
en: It is possible this unit was temporarily based in Jingyu until its Yinchuan HQ was operational.

zh: 該基地的特種作戰隊也遷往偏遠的山區環境。
en: The base's special operations team also moved to a remote mountain environment.

zh: 如今它可能還從事其他類型的訓練，消息來源指出它可能參與與資產鐵路運輸相關的訓練。
en: Today, it likely engages in other types of training as well - sources indicate it may be involved in training related to asset rail transport.

zh: 這引發了早期的推測，認為這個單位最終可能被分出去，成為CJ-10飛彈旅，不過情況似乎並非如此。
en: This led to early speculation that this unit may eventually be spun off into a CJ-10 missile brigade, although this does not appear to be the case.

zh: 雖然目前對這個單位所知甚少，但它被描述為負責全年戰術訓練的「專業訓練與評估單位」。
en: While little is currently known about this unit, it is described as a “specialized training and evaluation unit” responsible for year-round tactical training.

zh: 與大多數國家由紅軍扮演侵略者的做法不同，解放軍指定藍軍擔任這個角色，並以紅軍作為本方部隊。
en: Unlike most countries, in which the Red Team plays the role of aggressor, the PLA designates the Blue Team for this role and the Red Team as the home force.

zh: 現行的團成立於2018年初，是一個實驗性質的工作單位。
en: The current regiment was established in early 2018 as an experimental work unit.

zh: 與69基地一樣，它在靖宇與銀川西夏區都設有據點。
en: Like Base 69, it has locations in both Jingyu and Yinchuan's Xixia District.

zh: 這個單位在某些消息來源中被稱為「勤務站」或「發射勤務站」，可能為鄰近的太原衛星發射中心（TSLC）（隸屬於戰略支援部隊）所進行的彈道飛彈試射，提供支援並維持解放軍火箭軍在當地的存在。
en: This unit, referred to in some sources as a "Service Station" or "Launch Service Station," likely provides support and a local PLARF presence for ballistic missile test launches from the nearby Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center (TSLC) (subordinate to the SSF).

zh: 副站為指揮所即時計算飛彈彈道。
en: The secondary station calculates missile trajectory in real time for the command post.

zh: 由於位於阿拉善右旗，它大概不與其他阿拉善的單位同址。
en: Being located in Alxa's Right Banner, it is probably not co-located with the other Alxa units.

zh: 這個單位先前可能隸屬於前貴陽訓練基地，後者在同一個村莊設有據點，但現在似乎已分出去成為獨立單位。
en: This unit may have previously been subordinate to the former Guiyang Training Base, which had a presence in the same village, but now appears to have been spun off into its own unit.

zh: 它似乎是一座全新的醫院，建在一家舊飯店的原址上。
en: It appears to be a brand new hospital built at the site of a former hotel.

zh: 在其40多年的歷史中，它已培養超過30,000名學員，其中超過120人後來成為將軍。
en: In its 40+ years it has graduated over 30,000 cadets, over 120 of whom have gone on to become generals.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍大多數的旅長、參謀長與總工程師，以及較低層級的營長與連長，都畢業於這所大學。
en: The majority of the PLARF's brigade commanders, chiefs of staff, and chief engineers, as well as lower-level battalion and company commanders, graduated from this university.

zh: 這個營負責包含真實飛彈發射在內的演練部署。
en: This battalion handles drill deployments which include real missile launches.

zh: 士官學校人員在這個地點進行後勤專業的訓練。
en: NCO School personnel train in logistical specialties at this location.

zh: 以下是無法被適當辨識，或無法被準確放入解放軍火箭軍層級架構的單位清單。
en: The following is a list of units that could not be properly identified or accurately placed within the PLARF hierarchy.

zh: 它很可能位於清河的解放軍火箭軍司令部內或附近。
en: It is likely located in or near PLARF HQ in Qinghe.

zh: 在此之前，它研究的主題範圍很廣，包括電子戰、飛彈與無人飛行載具故障，以及巡弋飛彈戰損評估。
en: Prior to this, it conducted research into a wide array of topics, including electronic warfare, missile and UAV malfunctions, and cruise missile damage assessment.

zh: 它似乎與位於清河的解放軍火箭軍司令部同址。
en: It appears to be co-located with PLARF HQ in Qinghe.

zh: 它位於清河街道，很可能與解放軍火箭軍司令部同址。
en: It is located in Qinghe Subdistrict, and is likely co-located with PLARF HQ.

zh: 除了單一消息來源提供的北京豐台區一處地址之外，沒有更多資訊。
en: No further information available, other than an address in Fengtai District, Beijing from a single source.

zh: 它可能專注於野外技能，例如搭帳篷、炊事與野戰通信。
en: It may be focused on field skills like erecting tents, cooking, and field communications.

zh: 考慮到它位於普蘭店，它大概是某個金輪工程單位較舊的部隊代號。
en: Given its location in Pulandian, it is probably an older MUCD for one of the Jinlun Engineering units.

zh: 這個陣地在大多數消息來源中通常被稱為玉門發射井陣地，因為它相對靠近玉門市，但它實際上位於瓜州縣，而不在玉門。
en: This field has typically been referred to as the Yumen Silo Field in most sources due to its relative proximity to the city of Yumen, but is actually located in Guazhou County and not Yumen.

zh: 一個很有可能的發展是，這將促成新增作戰基地，也就是解放軍火箭軍／解放軍第二砲兵部隊五十多年來首次新設的作戰基地。
en: One strong possibility is that this will lead to the creation of additional Bases, the PLARF/PLASAF's first new operations Bases in over fifty years.

zh: 技術偵察局為司令部蒐集並分析技術情報。
en: The TRB collects and analyzes technical intelligence for the headquarters.

zh: 新成立的技術偵察局負責管理信號與影像單位。
en: A new Technical Reconnaissance Bureau was formed to manage signals and imagery units.

zh: 軍事代表局監督交付部隊的裝備品質。
en: An MRB oversees the quality of equipment delivered to the troops.

zh: 每個軍事代表局都派有軍官駐在其監督的工廠。
en: Each Military Representative Bureau has officers stationed at the factories it supervises.

zh: 綜合保障營為旅提供補給、維修與運輸。
en: The Comprehensive Support Battalion provides supply, maintenance, and transport for the brigade.

zh: 綜合保障營的一輛卡車把燃料運到發射場。
en: A truck from the Comprehensive Support Battalion delivered fuel to the launch site.

zh: 通信營把旅司令部與其發射營連接起來。
en: The Communications Battalion links the brigade headquarters with its launch battalions.

zh: 通信營的士兵在指揮所與發射陣地之間敷設了電纜。
en: Soldiers of the Communications Battalion laid cable between the command post and the firing positions.

zh: 通信團維護整個基地的安全網路。
en: The Communications Regiment maintains the secure network for the whole base.

zh: 基地通信團在冬季演習期間訓練了其操作人員。
en: The base Communications Regiment trained its operators during the winter exercise.

zh: 作戰保障營在每次演練之前整備發射陣地。
en: The Operations Support Battalion prepares the launch positions before each drill.

zh: 作戰保障營的工兵與駕駛員清理了通往該地點的道路。
en: Engineers and drivers from the Operations Support Battalion cleared the road to the site.

zh: 每個發射營在野外操作數具運輸起豎發射車。
en: Each Launch Battalion operates several transporter-erector-launchers in the field.

zh: 發射營在演習期間每晚都轉移到新的陣地。
en: The Launch Battalion moved to a new position every night during the exercise.

zh: 技術營在飛彈裝上發射架之前進行檢查。
en: The Technical Battalion checks the missiles before they are loaded onto the launchers.

zh: 技術營的技術人員更換了一個故障的導引單元。
en: Technicians in the Technical Battalion replaced a faulty guidance unit.

zh: 裝檢研究所在新組件投入使用之前進行測試。
en: The Equipment Inspection Institute tests new components before they enter service.

zh: 裝檢研究所的研究人員發表了一篇關於彈頭儲存的研究。
en: Researchers at the Equipment Inspection Institute published a study on warhead storage.

zh: 技術勤務營為基地修理車輛與支援裝備。
en: The Technical Service Battalion repairs vehicles and support equipment for the base.

zh: 技術勤務營的一組人員在兩天內重新組裝了發電機。
en: A Technical Service Battalion crew rebuilt the generator in two days.

zh: 技術勤務旅儲存並運送發射旅使用的飛彈。
en: The Technical Service Brigade stores and moves the missiles used by the launch brigades.

zh: 技術勤務旅的卡車在黎明時越過訓練區的邊界。
en: Trucks of the Technical Service Brigade crossed the border of the training area at dawn.

zh: 技術勤務大隊負責測試設備與備用零件。
en: The Technical Service Group handles test equipment and spare parts.

zh: 技術勤務大隊的人員上週檢查了儲存地點。
en: Staff of the Technical Service Group inspected the storage site last week.

zh: 飛彈技術勤務旅負責測試與運輸該基地的飛彈。
en: The Missile Technical Service Brigade tests and transports the missiles of the base.

zh: 飛彈技術勤務旅在大型演習期間隨發射旅一同部署。
en: The Missile Technical Service Brigade deploys with the launch brigades during large exercises.

zh: 汽車營為基地的其他單位提供卡車與駕駛員。
en: The Vehicle Battalion supplies trucks and drivers to the other units of the base.

zh: 汽車營的駕駛員在山路上練習夜間車隊行駛。
en: Drivers of the Vehicle Battalion practiced night convoys on the mountain roads.

zh: 工兵連修築了一條通往儲存地點的新道路。
en: The Engineering Company built a new access road to the storage site.

zh: 工兵連的士兵在車隊抵達之前修復了一座橋。
en: Soldiers from the Engineering Company repaired a bridge before the convoy arrived.

zh: 綜合倉庫為多個單位保管備用零件、工具與醫療補給品。
en: The Comprehensive Depot keeps spare parts, tools, and medical supplies for several units.

zh: 一輛卡車載著帳篷與毛毯離開綜合倉庫。
en: A truck left the Comprehensive Depot with a load of tents and blankets.

zh: 油料倉庫為基地的車輛供應柴油與汽油。
en: The Fuel Storage Depot supplies diesel and gasoline to the vehicles of the base.

zh: 油料倉庫的工作人員檢查油槽有無洩漏。
en: Workers at the Fuel Storage Depot checked the tanks for leaks.

zh: 軍械倉庫把彈藥分別存放在獨立的混凝土掩體中。
en: The Munitions Depot stores ammunition in separate concrete bunkers.

zh: 軍械倉庫的警衛檢查每一輛進入大門的車輛。
en: Guards at the Munitions Depot inspect every vehicle that enters the gate.

zh: 測控團從多個站點追蹤飛彈的飛行。
en: The Control Regiment tracks missile flights from several stations.

zh: 測控團的操作人員在測試期間練習了資料鏈路。
en: Operators of the Control Regiment practiced data links during the test.

zh: 試驗訓練區在夏季舉行實彈演練。
en: The Training District hosts live-fire drills during the summer.

zh: 數個旅派遣官兵前往試驗訓練區參加年度評估。
en: Several brigades sent personnel to the Training District for the annual evaluation.

zh: 綜合訓練基地設有教室、靶場與宿舍。
en: The Comprehensive Training Base offers classrooms, ranges, and living quarters.

zh: 新兵在初春抵達綜合訓練基地。
en: Recruits arrived at the Comprehensive Training Base in early spring.

zh: 測繪大隊以高精度測量發射陣地。
en: The Survey and Mapping Group measures launch positions with high precision.

zh: 測繪大隊的一個小組更新了訓練區的地圖。
en: A team from the Survey and Mapping Group updated the maps of the training area.

zh: 偵察團蒐集邊境附近地形的資訊。
en: The Reconnaissance Regiment gathers information on the terrain near the border.

zh: 偵察團的偵察兵帶著橋梁的照片返回。
en: Scouts of the Reconnaissance Regiment returned with photographs of the bridge.

zh: 自動化指揮中心在一個螢幕上顯示每個單位的狀態。
en: The Automated Command Center displays the status of every unit on one screen.

zh: 自動化指揮中心的軍官把新命令傳送給各旅。
en: Officers in the Automated Command Center sent the new order to the brigades.

zh: 氣象中心向發射人員通報風速與氣溫。
en: The Meteorology Center reports wind speed and temperature to the launch crews.

zh: 氣象中心的預報員在演習之前發出暴風雨警告。
en: Forecasters at the Meteorology Center warned of a storm before the exercise.

zh: 新兵訓練團教導新兵行軍、射擊與維護裝備。
en: The New Soldier Training Regiment teaches recruits to march, shoot, and maintain equipment.

zh: 一批新兵於12月從新兵訓練團結業。
en: A class of recruits graduated from the New Soldier Training Regiment in December.

zh: 巡弋飛彈任務規劃中心為每次發射準備航線。
en: The Cruise Missile Mission Planning Center prepares the routes for each launch.

zh: 巡弋飛彈任務規劃中心的分析人員比較了數條可能的航線。
en: Analysts at the Cruise Missile Mission Planning Center compared several possible routes.

zh: 軍犬訓練隊訓練犬隻偵測爆裂物。
en: The Military Canine Training Team trains dogs to detect explosives.

zh: 軍犬訓練隊的訓犬員夜間帶著犬隻沿圍籬巡行。
en: Handlers of the Military Canine Training Team walked the dogs along the fence at night.

zh: 特種裝備運輸團以公路與鐵路運送重型貨物。
en: The Special Equipment Transport Regiment moves heavy loads by road and rail.

zh: 特種裝備運輸團的一支車隊在夜間離開倉庫。
en: A convoy of the Special Equipment Transport Regiment left the depot at night.

zh: 鐵路運輸連在車站把裝備裝上平板車。
en: The Rail Transport Company loads equipment onto flatcars at the station.

zh: 鐵路運輸連的士兵練習連結車廂。
en: Soldiers of the Rail Transport Company practiced coupling the cars.

zh: 汽車維修分隊在野外修理引擎與輪胎。
en: The Vehicle Repair Subunit fixes engines and tires in the field.

zh: 汽車維修分隊的一名技師更換了拋錨卡車的煞車。
en: A Vehicle Repair Subunit mechanic replaced the brakes of a stalled truck.

zh: 研究院研究火箭發動機的新材料。
en: The Research Academy studies new materials for rocket motors.

zh: 研究院的科學家測試了較輕的燃料槽。
en: Scientists at the Research Academy tested a lighter fuel tank.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍（PLARF）在2016年之前稱為解放軍第二砲兵部隊（PLASAF），負責解放軍的陸基核彈道飛彈與常規彈道飛彈。
en: The PLA Rocket Force (PLARF), formerly known as the PLA 2nd Artillery Force (PLASAF) until 2016, is responsible for the PLA’s land-based nuclear and conventional ballistic missiles.

zh: 第二砲兵部隊於1966年正式成立，並被賦予指揮中國小規模陸基區域核飛彈的權責。
en: The Second Artillery Force was officially established in 1966 and given command of China’s small inventory of land-based, regional nuclear missiles.

zh: 這些第一代飛彈大多被歸類為不夠精密，射程與能力有限。
en: These first-generation missiles were largely categorized as unsophisticated and of limited range and capability.

zh: 解放軍第二砲兵部隊所配屬的平台日益多樣化、能力日益提升，與其規模的穩步成長相互呼應。
en: The steady diversification of platforms and improvement in capabilities assigned to the PLASAF was matched by its equally steady growth in size.

zh: 在1980年至2000年間成立了四個新旅，其中三個配備了這些最新的武器系統。
en: Four new brigades were stood up between 1980 and 2000, three of which were equipped with these latest weapons systems.

zh: 這項擴張在2000年代加速：2000年至2010年間，解放軍第二砲兵部隊成立了多達十一個新旅，配備其不斷擴大的武器陣容，包括第一種地面發射巡弋飛彈CJ-10，以及第一種公路機動洲際彈道飛彈東風-31。
en: This expansion accelerated in the 2000s: between 2000 and 2010, the PLASAF stood up as many as eleven new brigades equipped with its growing array of weapons, including its first ground-launched cruise missile, the CJ-10, and its first road-mobile ICBM, the DF-31.

zh: 令人驚訝的是，2017年到2019年底之間，解放軍火箭軍新增了至少十個飛彈旅。
en: Incredibly, between 2017 and late 2019 the PLARF added at least ten new missile brigades.

zh: 這次前所未有的擴張，從29個旅增加到39個旅，在短短三年內規模成長超過33%。
en: This unprecedented expansion from 29 to 39 brigades represented a more than 33% increase in size in only three years.

zh: 隨後在2021年，解放軍火箭軍的發射井式洲際彈道飛彈部隊明顯大幅擴充。
en: This was followed by an apparent massive expansion of the PLARF’s silo-based ICBM force in 2021.

zh: 因此，解放軍火箭軍已從一支規模小、不夠精密、由射程短且脆弱的彈道飛彈組成的部隊，發展為規模日益龐大、現代化的部隊，擁有核武與常規武器的廣泛平台。
en: Thus, the PLARF has evolved from a small, unsophisticated force of short-ranged and vulnerable ballistic missiles to an increasingly large and modern force with a wide array of both nuclear and conventional weapons platforms.

zh: 儘管近來的學術研究已大幅揭開中國彈道飛彈部隊的神祕面紗，它在許多方面仍是一個鮮為人知的現象，即使以解放軍嚴格的標準來看，其保密程度也異常之高。
en: While recent scholarship has gone a long way toward demystifying China’s ballistic missile force, it remains in many ways a poorly understood phenomenon, with an unusually high degree of censorship even by the strict standards of the PLA.

zh: 作者嘗試盡可能為更多解放軍火箭軍的單位與機構編纂檔案，並盡可能納入每個單位的歷史、任務、位置、領導、裝備與兵力結構等資訊，運用範圍廣泛、主要為中文的資料來源。
en: The author has attempted to compile dossiers on as many PLARF units and institutions as possible, including information, where available, on each unit’s history, mission, location, leadership, equipment, and force structure, utilizing a wide range of mostly Chinese language sources.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍直接隸屬於中央軍事委員會（CMC），後者是中華人民共和國最高的國防機構。
en: The PLARF is directly subordinate to the Central Military Commission (CMC), the PRC’s supreme national defense authority.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍核發射部隊的指揮權責頗為繁複：在行政上，核部隊隸屬於各自的基地，但在戰時則置於中央軍事委員會的直接作戰管制之下。
en: Command authority of the PLARF’s nuclear launch forces is somewhat byzantine: administratively, nuclear forces are subordinate to their individual bases, but in wartime are placed under direct operational control of the CMC.

zh: 常規飛彈部隊的作戰管制，特別是它們在多大程度上隸屬於地方聯合戰區指揮部，而不是各自的解放軍火箭軍基地，目前較不明朗。
en: Operational control of conventional missile forces, in particular the extent to which they are subordinate to the local joint theater command versus their individual PLARF bases, is less well understood.

zh: 初步證據顯示，常規飛彈部隊正持續整合到當地戰區指揮部，且當地戰區指揮部可能對這些部隊行使一定程度的作戰管制，有利於飛彈部隊與其空、陸、海對應部隊進行聯合作戰。
en: Initial evidence suggests that integration of conventional missile forces into the local theater command is ongoing, and that the local theater command may exercise a degree of operational control over these forces, facilitating joint operations between missile forces and their air, land, and sea counterparts.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍掌管九個基地，全部都是軍長或副軍長職等。
en: The PLARF controls nine bases, all of which are either Corps or Corps Deputy Leader grade.

zh: 六個作戰基地各自涵蓋不同的地理區域。
en: Each of the six operations bases cover discrete geographical areas.

zh: 六個解放軍火箭軍作戰基地大致遵循標準化的編制，依基地不同，各轄六至七個飛彈旅與五至七個保障團。
en: The six PLARF operations bases largely conform to a standardized structure, with six to seven subordinate missile brigades and five to seven support regiments, depending on the base.

zh: 飛彈旅：負責發射彈道飛彈。
en: Missile Brigades: Responsible for launching of ballistic missiles.

zh: 每個基地管轄六至八個這類旅。
en: Each Base oversees between six to eight of these brigades.

zh: 訓練團：負責分派到這個基地之新兵的基礎訓練，以及必要時的某些進階專業訓練。
en: Training Regiment: Responsible for basic training of new recruits assigned to this base, as well as certain advanced specialist training as needed.

zh: 通信團：負責確保基地司令部與下屬單位之間的通信。
en: Communications Regiment: Responsible for ensuring communications between Base Headquarters and subordinate elements.

zh: 這些團管理解放軍火箭軍所使用的各種通信方式，包括光纖、衛星、微波與對流層散射通信。
en: These regiments manage the variety of communications methods employed by the PLARF, including fiberoptic, satellite, microwave, and troposcatter communications.

zh: 作戰保障團：這種團型約在2012年成立，把數項分散的保障職能整合到單一個團之下。
en: Operations Support Regiment: This regiment type was established around 2012 by taking several disparate support functions and consolidating them under a single regiment.

zh: 因此，這個團負責基地車輛與裝備的維修與保養，負責儲存飛彈、燃料、彈藥與其他補給品，並負責經由公路與鐵路把這些資產運送到基地各單位。
en: Thus, this regiment is responsible for repair and maintenance of base vehicles and equipment, as well as storage of missiles, fuel, munitions, and other supplies, and transport of these assets via road and rail to base units.

zh: 它也可能負責其他各項雜項保障任務，例如車輛駕駛、伙食準備、文化與媒體工作，以及某些保障人員的訓練。
en: It may also be in charge of other miscellaneous support missions, such as vehicle driving, food preparation, cultural/media work, and training of certain support personnel.

zh: 裝檢團：這個團負責儲存、管理與分發分配給各基地的核彈頭。
en: Equipment Inspection Regiment: This regiment is responsible for storage, management, and distribution of nuclear warheads assigned to each base.

zh: 雖然解放軍火箭軍的大部分核武庫存放在太白的一處中央地點，但據信有限數量的彈頭前沿部署到各基地，由這些團管理。
en: While most of the PLARF’s nuclear stockpile is stored in a central location at Taibai, it is believed that a limited number of warheads are forward-deployed to each base and managed by these regiments.

zh: 這些團以自身的公路與鐵路運輸能力，把彈頭運送到飛彈旅。
en: These regiments transport warheads to missile brigades via their own road and rail transport capabilities.

zh: 基地醫院：每個基地至少有一所相關的醫院。
en: Base Hospital: Each base has at least one associated hospital.

zh: 醫院人員經常與基地部隊一同部署進行訓練。
en: Hospital staff frequently deploy for training with base units.

zh: 在戰時，這些醫院會部署野戰醫療小組，為前線的基地部隊提供全面的醫療照護。
en: In wartime these hospitals would deploy field medical teams to provide comprehensive medical care to base units at the front line.

zh: 基地醫院通常是師長或副師長職等的單位。
en: Base hospitals are typically Division Leader or Division Deputy Leader grade organizations.

zh: 在六個作戰基地中，有四個符合這種確切的編制，兩個（61基地與63基地）略有不同。
en: Of the six operations bases, four conform to this exact structure, while two, Bases 61 and 63, differ slightly.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍管轄40個飛彈旅，構成其全部飛彈兵力。
en: The PLARF oversees 40 missile brigades which constitute the entirety of its missile force.

zh: 如前所述，每個作戰基地管轄六至八個這類旅，這些旅大致遵循標準化的編制：六個發射營（每個通常由兩個發射連組成），以及四至六個保障營。
