en: The PRC’s approach to nuclear force includes a declaratory no-first-use (NFU) policy, stating it will never use nuclear weapons first at any time under any circumstances, including unconditionally not using or threatening to use of nuclear weapons against any non-nuclear-weapon state or in nuclear-weapon-free zones.

zh: 中華人民共和國在平時混編部分常規與核子飛彈部隊，以及其不首先使用核武條件的模糊之處，可能使衝突期間的嚇阻與升級管理複雜化。
en: The PRC’s commingling of some of its conventional and nuclear missile forces during peacetime and ambiguities in its NFU conditions could complicate deterrence and escalation management during a conflict.

zh: 此外，潛在對手對中華人民共和國常規飛彈部隊相關指揮與管制中心的攻擊，可能無意間削弱中華人民共和國的核指揮與管制，並產生核武使用或喪失的壓力，也就是在武器遭鎖定之前使用它們的壓力。
en: Furthermore, potential adversary attacks against the PRC’s conventional missile force-associated C2 centers could inadvertently degrade the PRC’s nuclear C2 and generate nuclear use-or-lose—the pressure to use weapons before they are targeted.

zh: 中華人民共和國的武庫中約有400枚洲際彈道飛彈，全部都能抵達美國本土。
en: The PRC has approximately 400 ICBMs in its arsenal, all of which can reach CONUS.

zh: 這個戰略武庫由公路機動的東風-26中遠程彈道飛彈補充，這些飛彈能夠打擊印太地區的目標。
en: This strategic arsenal is complemented by road-mobile DF-26 IRBMs capable of ranging targets in the Indo-Pacific region.

zh: 中華人民共和國很可能已把射程延伸型CSS-N-20（巨浪-3）潛射彈道飛彈部署在中華人民共和國的JIN級彈道飛彈核潛艦上，使中華人民共和國得以從近海水域瞄準美國本土，並使解放軍海軍能夠考慮堡壘作戰，以強化其海基嚇阻力量的存活力。
en: The PRC probably fielded the extended-range CSS-N-20 (JL-3) SLBM on the PRC’s JIN class SSBN, giving the PRC the ability to target CONUS from littoral waters and enabling the PLAN to consider bastion operations to enhance the survivability of its sea-based deterrent.

zh: 中華人民共和國持續建造更多JIN級彈道飛彈核潛艦。
en: The PRC continued to construct additional JIN class SSBNs.

zh: 目前不清楚JIN級彈道飛彈核潛艦的持續生產，是中華人民共和國次世代096型彈道飛彈核潛艦研發延遲的結果，還是依習近平指示加速其海基核能力的努力。
en: It is unclear whether continued JIN class SSBN production is the result of delays in the development of the PRC’s next-generation Type 096 SSBN or an effort to accelerate its sea-based nuclear capability as Xi has directed.

zh: 096型彈道飛彈核潛艦很可能旨在部署配備分導式多彈頭的潛射彈道飛彈，並很可能在2020年代中期開始建造。
en: The Type 096 SSBN probably is intended to field MIRVed SLBMs and probably will begin construction in the mid-2020s.

zh: 根據中華人民共和國第一代核動力攻擊潛艦超過30年的服役壽命，中華人民共和國將同時運作其JIN級與096型彈道飛彈核潛艦艦隊。
en: Based on the 30-plus-year service life of the PRC’s first-generation SSNs, the PRC will operate its JIN and Type 096 SSBN fleets concurrently.

zh: 中華人民共和國很可能持續以其六艘現役JIN級彈道飛彈核潛艦，進行近乎不間斷的海上嚇阻巡邏，這些潛艦最多可攜帶12枚CSS-N-14（巨浪-2）或CSS-N-20（巨浪-3）潛射彈道飛彈。
en: The PRC probably continued to conduct near-continuous at-sea deterrence patrols with its six operational JIN class SSBNs, which are equipped to carry up to 12 CSS-N-14 (JL-2) or CSS-N-20 (JL-3) SLBMs.

zh: 轟-6N攜帶的空射彈道飛彈，似乎配備機動再入載具，顯示該空射彈道飛彈與東風-26中遠程彈道飛彈，很可能能夠對印太戰區的目標進行核精確打擊。
en: The ALBM carried by the H-6N appears to be armed with a maneuvering reentry vehicle, indicating the ALBM—along with the DF-26 IRBM—likely can conduct nuclear precision strikes against targets in the Indo-Pacific theater.

zh: 發射井裝填的速度，顯示解放軍在建立「預警反擊」態勢方面正取得進展，以提高這些系統的存活力與反應能力。
en: The rate of silo arming suggests the PLA is progressing in establishing its “early warning counterstrike” posture to increase the survivability and responsiveness of these systems.

zh: 這次發射很可能驗證了解放軍火箭軍快速發射多枚飛彈的能力，這是預警反擊能力的關鍵部分。
en: This launch probably validated the PLARF’s ability to rapidly launch multiple missiles, a key part of an early warning counterstrike capability.

zh: 到2030年，美國國防部估計中華人民共和國將擁有超過1,000枚可作戰使用的核彈頭，其中大多數將部署在能夠打擊美國本土的系統上。
en: By 2030, DoD estimates that the PRC will have over 1,000 operational nuclear warheads, most of which will be fielded on systems capable of ranging CONUS.

zh: 中華人民共和國很可能正在發展先進的核武投射系統，例如戰略極音速滑翔載具與FOB系統，部分原因是長期擔憂美國的飛彈防禦能力，也為了與未來全球飛彈能力達到質的對等。
en: The PRC probably is developing advanced nuclear delivery systems, such as a strategic HGV and a FOB system, in part due to long-term concerns about United States missile defense capabilities as well as to attain qualitative parity with future worldwide missile capabilities.

zh: 一種「遠程」東風-27彈道飛彈已部署至解放軍火箭軍，很可能有極音速滑翔載具酬載選項，並具備常規對地攻擊、常規反艦與核子能力。
en: A “long-range” DF-27 ballistic missile is deployed to the PLARF and likely has a HGV payload option as well as conventional land-attack, conventional antiship, and nuclear capabilities.

zh: 中華人民共和國官方軍事著作指出，這個射程等級涵蓋5,000至8,000公里，使東風-27被列為中遠程彈道飛彈或洲際彈道飛彈，而中華人民共和國媒體指出，它可能打擊遠至阿拉斯加與夏威夷的目標。
en: Official PRC military writings indicate this range-class spans 5,000–8,000 km, designating the DF-27 as an IRBM or ICBM, and PRC media indicates that it can potentially range as far as Alaska and Hawaii.

zh: 2021年7月27日，中華人民共和國試驗了一個射程達洲際彈道飛彈等級的極音速滑翔載具，飛行了40,000公里。
en: On July 27, 2021, the PRC tested an ICBM-range HGV that travelled 40,000 km.

zh: 2017年一份國防工業出版物指出，已研發出一種較低當量的武器，用於對付戰役與戰術目標，可降低附帶損害。
en: A 2017 defense industry publication indicated a lower-yield weapon had been developed for use against campaign and tactical targets that would reduce collateral damage.

zh: 這種態勢大致類似美國與俄羅斯的預警發射態勢。
en: This posture is broadly similar to the U.S. and Russian LOW posture.

zh: 中華人民共和國很可能設法讓其至少一部分兵力，特別是新的發射井基單位，保持預警發射態勢。
en: The PRC probably seeks to keep at least a portion of its force, especially its new silo-based units, on a LOW posture.

zh: 自2017年以來，解放軍火箭軍進行了涉及核打擊預警與預警發射反應的演習。
en: Since 2017, the PLARF has conducted exercises involving early warning of a nuclear strike and LOW responses.

zh: 近年來，中華人民共和國已能在支援預警發射態勢所需的預警方面取得進展。
en: In recent years, the PRC has been able to make advances in early warning needed to support a LOW posture.

zh: 儘管有這些發展，中華人民共和國仍呼籲其他國家放棄類似的預警發射態勢以增強戰略穩定，同時拒絕就降低風險進行實質對話。
en: Despite these developments, the PRC has called on other states to abandon similar LOW postures to enhance strategic stability while declining to engage in substantive dialogue on risk reduction.

zh: 中華人民共和國似乎認為，預警發射態勢與其不首先使用核武政策一致，因為它涉及在接獲對手來襲首次攻擊的警告之後才發生的報復性打擊。
en: The PRC seems to believe a LOW posture is consistent with its NFU policy, given that it involves a retaliatory strike that occurs after warning of an inbound first attack from an adversary.

zh: 同時，中華人民共和國的軍事著作指出，包括預警系統在內的指揮與管制系統，可能成為意外核戰的根源。
en: At the same time, PRC military writings note that C2 systems—including early warning systems—can be a source of accidental nuclear war.

zh: 這些節點旨在使解放軍所有軍種與領域，以及其聯合部隊，具備不間斷的指揮與管制、通信、戰力維持與反擊能力。
en: These nodes aim to enable continuous C2, communications, sustainment, and counterstrike capabilities across all PLA services and domains as well as its joint forces.

zh: 每個戰區接受中央軍事委員會的指示；對其戰區內所配屬的解放軍、武警與民兵部隊擁有作戰權限；並負責其責任區內所有常規作戰與非作戰行動。
en: Each theater command receives direction from the CMC; has operational authority over assigned PLA, PAP, and militia forces in its theater; and is responsible for all conventional combat and non-combat operations in its area of responsibility.

zh: 2023年期間，東部戰區進行了一系列訓練活動與演習，以提升聯合作戰與戰備，組織的演習與操演包括遠距離訓練與動員、空戰、實彈訓練，以及運用改裝民用渡輪加強運輸。
en: During 2023, the ETC engaged in a series of training events and exercises to improve joint operations and combat readiness, organizing exercises and drills consisting of long-distance training and mobilization, aerial combat, live-fire training, and the use of modified civilian ferries to augment transportation.

zh: 南部戰區回應美國在南海的航行自由行動，並可視需要，對所有執行行動、以落實中華人民共和國所宣稱主權並支援解放軍行動的中國海警與海上民兵船艦，接掌指揮權。
en: The STC responds to U.S. freedom of navigation operations in the SCS and can assume command as needed over all CCG and CMM ships conducting operations enforcing the PRC’s claimed sovereignty and supporting PLA operations.

zh: 2023年，南部戰區單位在南海中華人民共和國占領的島礁附近，進行了多次實彈演練與兩棲訓練活動。
en: In 2023, STC units performed multiple live-fire drills and amphibious training events near PRC-occupied features in the SCS.

zh: 南部戰區負責回應美國在南海的航行自由行動，方式是定期追蹤並應對在中華人民共和國斷續線主張範圍內活動的美國艦艇。
en: The STC is responsible for responding to U.S. freedom of navigation operations in the SCS by regularly tracking and reacting to U.S. ships operating in the PRC’s dashed-line claim.

zh: 南部戰區在解放軍與東南亞國家的雙邊與多邊演習中扮演重要角色，例如在2023年參與與寮國、新加坡與柬埔寨的雙邊軍事演習。
en: The STC plays a significant role in the PLA’s bilateral and multilateral exercises with countries in Southeast Asia, such as participating in bilateral military exercises with Lao People’s Democratic Republic, Singapore, and Cambodia in 2023.

zh: 南部戰區參加了在廣東舉行、由柬埔寨、寮國、馬來西亞、泰國與越南參與的「和平友誼-2023」多邊軍事演習。
en: The STC participated in the multilateral military exercise, Peace and Friendship-2023, hosted in Guangdong and attended by Cambodia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam.

zh: 解放軍駐香港部隊與駐澳門部隊隸屬於南部戰區。
en: The PLA Hong Kong and Macao garrisons are subordinate to the STC.

zh: 由於中華人民共和國的另一艘航空母艦遼寧艦在2023年進行維修，山東艦訓練的增加，顯示解放軍有能力更遠離中華人民共和國邊界，進入菲律賓海。
en: With the PRC’s other aircraft carrier, Liaoning in maintenance for 2023, the increase in training with Shandong demonstrates the PLA’s capabilities further from the PRC’s borders and into the Philippine Sea.

zh: 西部戰區的主要重點是確保中華人民共和國與印度的邊界安全。
en: The WTC’s primary focus is on securing the PRC’s border with India.

zh: 解放軍自2020年衝突以來，並未縮減其陣地或兵力數量，且已建設基礎設施與支援設施，以維持沿實際控制線的多個旅部署。
en: The PLA has not drawn down its positions or troop numbers since the 2020 clash and has built infrastructure and support facilities to maintain multiple BDE deployments along the LAC.

zh: 在國內，西部戰區聚焦於新疆與西藏自治區，中共在這些地區認為存在分裂主義與恐怖活動的高度威脅，特別是在新疆的維吾爾族人口之中。
en: Domestically, the WTC focuses on the Xinjiang and Tibet Autonomous Regions, where the CCP perceives a high threat of separatism and terrorist activity, particularly among Uyghur populations in Xinjiang.

zh: 北京很可能向所有戰區與軍區發布了廣泛的反恐政策，以緩解外界認為少數族群人口在西部戰區遭到針對的觀感。
en: Beijing likely issued a broad counterterrorism policy to all theater commands and military districts to alleviate perceived targeting of minority populations in the WTC.

zh: 北部戰區涵蓋中華人民共和國與蒙古、俄羅斯、北韓及黃海接壤的各省。
en: The NTC includes the PRC’s provinces bordering Mongolia, Russia, North Korea, and the Yellow Sea.

zh: 在突發事件期間，北部戰區很可能對戰區內的部分前戰略支援部隊單位行使指揮權，並從前戰略支援部隊的單位接受戰略情報支援，以改善戰場覺知並促進戰區內的聯合作戰。
en: During a contingency, the NTC likely exercises command over some former SSF units in theater and receives strategic intelligence support from the elements of the former SSF to improve battlefield awareness and facilitate joint operations within the theater.

zh: 中部戰區的主要責任是保衛首都與中共領導層，同時為其他戰區提供戰略預備隊。
en: CTC’s primary responsibility is to defend the capital and CCP leadership while providing a strategic reserve to the other theater commands.

zh: 2023年全年，北京持續侵蝕台灣及其周邊的長期規範，對台灣採用一系列施壓手段，包括在台灣周邊維持海軍存在、增加越過台灣自行宣告的中線與防空識別區，以及在台灣附近進行大規模軍事演習。
en: Throughout 2023, Beijing continued to erode longstanding norms in and around Taiwan by employing a range of pressure tactics against Taiwan, including maintaining a naval presence around Taiwan, increasing crossings into Taiwan’s self-declared centerline and ADIZ, and conducting major military exercises near Taiwan.

zh: 儘管北京重申「和平統一」是其偏好的行動方案，中華人民共和國從未放棄使用武力，並持續表示願意對台灣動用軍事力量。
en: Although Beijing reaffirms that “peaceful reunification” is its preferred course of action, the PRC has never renounced the use of force and continues to signal its willingness to use military force against Taiwan.

zh: 中華人民共和國很可能以同步進行的電子戰、網路攻擊與資訊作戰，來補充其空中與海上封鎖，以進一步孤立台灣當局與民眾，並掌控衝突的國際敘事。
en: The PRC likely would complement its air and maritime blockades with concurrent EW, network attacks, and IO to further isolate Taiwan’s authorities and populace and control the international narrative of the conflict.

zh: 其中最突出的聯合島嶼登陸戰役，設想一場依賴電子戰、後勤、空中與海軍支援之協調且相互銜接的戰役之複雜作戰。
en: The most prominent of these, the Joint Island Landing Campaign, envisions a complex operation relying on coordinated, interlocking campaigns for EW, logistics, air, and naval support.

zh: 根據台灣國防部（MND）的資料，解放軍進入台灣防空識別區的情況全年持續，2023年略有減少，為1,641次，2022年為1,733次。
en: According to Taiwan Ministry of National Defense (MND) data, the PLA entries into the Taiwan ADIZ persisted throughout the year, with a slight decrease in 2023 to 1,641 events, compared to 1,733 in 2022.

zh: 同時，根據同一資料，解放軍飛機在2023年至少越過台灣海峽中線712次，高於2022年的552次，顯示解放軍侵入防空識別區的行動中，包含越過中線的比例更高。
en: Concurrently, PLA aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait centerline at least 712 times in 2023, up from 552 in 2022, indicating a greater percentage of PLA ADIZ incursions included centerline crossings, according to the same data.

zh: 根據中國海警福建分局的說法，中國海警將定期監控廈門南部海岸外的水域，該處距離金門群島僅約5公里。
en: According to the CCG’s Fujian division, the CCG will regularly monitor the waters off the southern coast of Xiamen—which is only approximately 5 km from the Kinmen Islands.

zh: 解放軍陸軍編有六個兩棲合成旅，其中四個在東部戰區（最靠近台灣），兩個在南部戰區。
en: The PLAA fields six amphibious combined arms BDEs—four in the ETC (nearest Taiwan) and two in the STC.

zh: 新聞報導聲稱，解放軍廣泛運用海上、空中與地面無人飛行載具系統，支援兩棲突擊作戰。
en: Press reports claimed that the PLA extensively used sea, air, and ground UAS in support of the amphibious assault operation.

zh: 解放軍海軍正在提升其防空、反水面與反潛作戰能力，引進能在平時與戰時執行多樣任務的新型多任務平台，並自2022年8月以來增加了在台灣周邊的部署態勢。
en: The PLAN is improving its anti-air, anti-surface, and ASW capabilities, is introducing new multi-mission platforms capable of conducting diverse missions during peace and war, and has increased its posture surrounding Taiwan since August 2022.

zh: 解放軍海軍於2022年服役了第三艘YUSHEN級兩棲突擊艦，截至2023年12月，第四艘YUSHEN級艦艇已下水並開始海試。
en: The PLAN commissioned its third YUSHEN-class LHA in 2022 and, as of December 2023, a fourth YUSHEN-class ship was launched and began sea trials.

zh: 目前沒有跡象顯示中華人民共和國正在大幅增加其戰車登陸艦與中型登陸艇的數量。
en: There is no indication the PRC is significantly expanding its number of tank landing ships and medium-sized landing craft at this time.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍已準備好對高價值目標進行飛彈攻擊，包括台灣的指揮與管制設施、空軍基地與雷達站，企圖削弱台灣的防禦、癱瘓台灣的領導階層，或瓦解民眾的作戰意志。
en: The PLARF is prepared to conduct missile attacks against high-value targets, including Taiwan’s C2 facilities, air bases, and radar sites, in an attempt to degrade Taiwan’s defenses, neutralize Taiwan’s leadership, or break the public’s will to fight.

zh: 前戰略支援部隊將扮演戰略資訊與通信支援的角色，集中技術情報的蒐集與管理，並為涉及台灣突發事件的各戰區提供戰略情報支援。
en: The former SSF would play a strategic information and communications support role, centralizing technical intelligence collection and management and providing strategic intelligence support to theater commands involved in a Taiwan contingency.

zh: 聯勤保障部隊的主要目標，是透過執行聯合後勤的指揮與管制、運送物資並監督各種支援機制，為解放軍的戰略與戰役層級作戰（例如台灣突發事件）提供聯合後勤支援。
en: The JLSF’s primary goal is to provide joint logistics support to the PLA’s strategic and campaign-level operations, such as a Taiwan contingency, by conducting C2 of joint logistics, delivering materiel, and overseeing various support mechanisms.

zh: 聯勤保障部隊參與聯合的戰區層級演習，當單位在遠離駐地、超出其自有後勤能力的地方作戰時，其作用最為關鍵。
en: The JLSF participates in joint, theater-level exercises, becoming most relevant when units operate far from their home garrisons and beyond their organic logistics capabilities.

zh: 台灣民選總統是台灣軍隊的最高統帥，統轄國家安全會議與台灣國防部，兩者共同制定並執行國家安全與國防政策。
en: Taiwan’s elected president, who is the commander in chief of Taiwan’s armed forces, oversees the National Security Council and the MND, which altogether formulate and implement national security and defense policy.

zh: 台灣正採取措施因應解放軍構成的軍事威脅，包括建立戰爭儲備物資、擴大國防工業基礎、改善聯合作戰與危機應變能力，並強化其軍官與士官團。
en: Taiwan is taking steps to address the military threat posed by the PLA, including building its war reserve stocks, growing its defense-industrial base, improving joint operations and crisis response capabilities, and strengthening its officer and noncommissioned officer corps.

zh: 2023年，台灣把全社會途徑列為優先，作為提升防衛韌性的手段。
en: In 2023, Taiwan prioritized a whole-of-society approach as a means to improving defensive resilience.

zh: 截至2021年，台灣國防部已達成以志願役人員填補90%現役員額（169,000個）的目標。
en: As of 2021, the MND had accomplished its goal of filling 90% of the active-duty billets (169,000) with volunteers.

zh: 自2021年起，蔡總統的政府編列了兩筆總額160億美元的多年期追加預算，用於常規與不對稱系統。
en: Starting in 2021, President Tsai’s administration allocated two multiyear supplemental budgets totaling $16 billion for conventional and asymmetric systems.

zh: 這些追加預算涵蓋採購66架F-16 V戰鬥機、飛彈艦艇，以及雄風飛彈系統等反艦武器。
en: The supplemental budgets cover the purchase of 66 F-16 V fighter jets, missile ships, and anti-ship weapons, such as the Hsiung Feng missile system.

zh: 然而，北京斷然拒絕仲裁庭的裁決，中華人民共和國持續使用脅迫手段，包括動用中國海警與海上民兵船艦，並讓解放軍海軍處於監控位置，以落實其非法主張。
en: Beijing, however, categorically rejects the tribunal decision, and the PRC continues to use coercive tactics, including the employment of CCG and CMM ships, with PLAN in overwatch positions, to enforce its illegal claims.

zh: 2023年，中華人民共和國持續選擇性地執行每年一次、單方面的3個月禁漁令，禁漁範圍包含菲律賓與越南專屬經濟海域內的水域，藉此漸進式地落實其非法海洋主張。
en: In 2023, the PRC continued to selectively enforce a yearly, unilateral 3-month fishing ban that includes the waters inside the EEZ of the Philippines and Vietnam to incrementally enforce its unlawful maritime claims.

zh: 解放軍海軍、解放軍空軍、解放軍陸軍與戰略支援部隊，已部署海外執行反海盜、人道援助與災害救援、維和、訓練演習與太空支援作戰。
en: The PLAN, PLAAF, PLAA, and SSF have deployed abroad for counterpiracy, HA/DR, peacekeeping, training exercises, and space support operations.

zh: 北京把這些努力定位為推進合作式全球治理、和平發展與《聯合國憲章》的原則，這些都是其負責任全球大國敘事的關鍵組成部分。
en: Beijing frames these efforts as advancing cooperative global governance, peaceful development, and the principles of the UN Charter, which are key components of its responsible global power narrative.

zh: 2023年解放軍其他雙邊演習，包括與柬埔寨的多域GOLDEN DRAGON演習、在新疆與阿拉伯聯合大公國舉行的FALCON SHIELD空中演習，以及與沙烏地阿拉伯第二次舉行的BLUE SWORD演習。
en: Other bilateral PLA exercises in 2023 included the multi-domain GOLDEN DRAGON exercise with Cambodia, the air exercise FALCON SHIELD with the United Arab Emirates in Xinjiang, and the second iteration of BLUE SWORD with Saudi Arabia.

zh: 中華人民共和國利用警務合作取得安全准入，特別是在太平洋島國。
en: The PRC uses police cooperation to gain security access, especially in the PICs.

zh: 解放軍國防大學的國防研究學院，提供中華人民共和國解放軍對外國軍官開設的最高層級訓練。
en: The College of Defense Studies of the PLA NDU provides the highest level of training for foreign officers offered by the PRC PLA.

zh: 除了訓練外國高階軍事官員之外，解放軍國防大學還就國防與安全議題進行國際交流與學術討論。
en: In addition to training foreign senior military officials, PLA NDU conducts international exchanges and academic discussions on defense and security issues.

zh: 解放軍國防大學已招收來自100多個夥伴國家的學員，並與拉丁美洲及非洲軍隊建立關係。
en: The PLA NDU has accepted students from more than 100 partner nations and has pursued relationships with Latin American and African militaries.

zh: 例如，與俄羅斯的院校相比，解放軍國防大學為學員提供更高的津貼，以及更多接觸中華人民共和國科技創新（例如人工智慧的軍事應用）的機會。
en: For example, PLA NDU offers students higher stipends and greater exposure to PRC technological and scientific innovations (such as military applications of AI) than Russian schools.

zh: 在解放軍國防大學的課程中，軍事倫理與人權是禁止討論的議題；無論是中國學員或外國學員，都被禁止批評北京在這些領域的紀錄。
en: Military ethics and human rights are off-limits for discussion in the PLA NDU curriculum; students are prohibited from criticizing Beijing’s record in these areas, whether they are Chinese or a foreign student.

zh: 自2002年以來，解放軍國防大學透過主辦年度安全研討會，設法增加與國際軍事社群的交流，這些研討會旨在促進合作、強化軍事交流，並試圖對社群關注的議題傳達共同的作法。
en: Since 2002, the PLA NDU sought to increase exchanges with the international military community by sponsoring annual security seminars which aim to foster cooperation, strengthen military exchanges, and attempt to impart a common approach to issues of interest to the community.

zh: 解放軍國防大學已接收來自90多個國家的數千名學員，並與10多個國家的軍事院校，以及140多個國家的軍隊保持定期聯繫。
en: The PLA NDU has received thousands of students from over 90 countries and maintains regular contacts with military academies in more than 10 countries and with over 140 countries’ militaries.

zh: 有準則確保解放軍武官具備作戰背景；然而，所有解放軍武官先前都是中央軍事委員會聯合參謀部軍事情報局的情報軍官。
en: Guidelines exist to ensure PLA attachés have operational backgrounds; however, all PLA attachés were previously intelligence officers with the CMC Joint Staff Department Military Intelligence Directorate.

zh: 2023年全年，中華人民共和國部署解放軍海軍、中國海警、海上民兵與民用船舶，以維持在爭議地區的存在，例如仁愛礁、黃岩島與沙洲／中業島。
en: Throughout 2023, the PRC deployed PLAN, CCG, CMM, and civilian ships to maintain a presence in disputed areas, such as Second Thomas Shoal, Scarborough Reef, and Sandy Cay/Thitu Island.

zh: 中華人民共和國把其侵略性行動，建立在對南海大部分區域的權利主張之上，這侵犯了該區域其他國家的專屬經濟海域。
en: The PRC bases its aggressive action on claims of rights over most of the SCS which encroaches on the EEZ’s of the other countries in the region.

zh: 參與規劃並協商軍事後勤設施的關鍵組織，是中央軍事委員會聯合參謀部、中央軍事委員會後勤保障部，以及各軍種司令部。
en: Critical organizations involved in planning and negotiating for military logistics facilities are the CMC Joint Staff Department, the CMC Logistic Support Department, and service headquarters.

zh: 北京很可能在其評估有助於為其安全目標營造有利環境的地區推動這類努力，但這些努力並不表示對海外基地部署有明確興趣。
en: Beijing probably pursues such efforts in regions it assesses can help foster favorable environments for its security goals but these efforts do not signal definite interest in overseas basing.

zh: 2022年5月，該碼頭宣布已全面投入運作。
en: In May 2022, the pier was announced to be fully operational.

zh: 該碼頭很可能能夠停靠解放軍海軍的航空母艦、其他大型作戰艦艇與潛艦。
en: The pier likely can accommodate the PLAN’s aircraft carriers, other large combatants, and submarines.

zh: 中華人民共和國很可能考慮過緬甸、泰國、印尼、巴基斯坦、斯里蘭卡、阿拉伯聯合大公國、肯亞、赤道幾內亞、塞席爾、坦尚尼亞、安哥拉、奈及利亞、納米比亞、莫三比克、孟加拉、巴布亞紐幾內亞、索羅門群島與塔吉克。
en: The PRC has likely considered Burma, Thailand, Indonesia, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, United Arab Emirates, Kenya, Equatorial Guinea, Seychelles, Tanzania, Angola, Nigeria, Namibia, Mozambique, Bangladesh, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, and Tajikistan.

zh: 2024年，兩國進行了數次聯合行動，包括進入北極地區的轟炸機、海軍與海岸防衛隊巡邏，其中首次聯合轟炸機巡邏進入了阿拉斯加防空識別區。
en: In 2024, both nations conducted several combined operations including bomber, naval, and coast guard patrols that entered the Arctic region, with the first combined bomber patrol entering the Alaskan ADIZ.

zh: 北京並未透明公布其軍事採購與研發經費；然而，擴大國防工業部門一直是主要優先事項，這很可能需要大量投資才能改革。
en: Beijing does not transparently announce its military procurement and R&D funding; however, expansion of the defense industrial sector has been a major priority, which likely requires significant investment to reform.

zh: 中華人民共和國生產種類繁多的彈道、巡弋、空對空與地對空飛彈，其中許多在品質上可與其他國際頂尖生產者相媲美，供國內軍事使用與出口。
en: The PRC produces a wide range of ballistic, cruise, air-to-air, and SAMs, many comparable in quality to those of other international top-tier producers, for domestic military use and export.

zh: 北京於2020年部署了其首款配備極音速滑翔載具的飛彈，並於2021年試驗了新的極音速武器系統，延續先前在極音速武器發展上的進展。
en: Beijing fielded its first missile with a HGV in 2020 and tested a new hypersonic weapon system in 2021, building on previous progress in hypersonic weapons development.

zh: 2019年4月，解放軍海軍在其70週年慶祝活動中透露，其新型飛彈巡洋艦能夠運用遠程對地攻擊巡弋飛彈，並在2022年發射了旨在擊敗航空母艦的鷹擊-21極音速飛彈。
en: In April 2019, the PLAN revealed during its 70th anniversary celebration that its new guided-missile cruiser can employ long-range, land-attack cruise missiles and, in 2022, launched the YJ-21 hypersonic missile designed to defeat aircraft carriers.

zh: 2023年，據信能從400公里外打擊目標的PL-17空對空飛彈，很可能已達成初始作戰能力。
en: In 2023, the PL-17 air-to-air missile, which is believed to be able to strike targets from 400 km away, likely reached initial operating capability.

zh: 天宮太空站於2022年成功完成，及其規劃中的擴建，顯示該產業持續取得進展。
en: The successful completion of the Tiangong Space Station in 2022 and its planned expansion demonstrates the industry’s continued progress.

zh: 中華人民共和國的生產能力正在改善所有解放軍地面系統類別：主力戰車與輕型戰車、裝甲運兵車、突擊車輛、防空砲兵系統與砲兵系統。
en: The PRC’s production capacity is improving all PLA ground system categories: main and light battle tanks, armored personnel carriers, assault vehicles, air defense artillery systems, and artillery systems.

zh: 中國航空工業集團設計並生產中華人民共和國的軍用飛機，包括殲-20第五代戰鬥機、運-20重型運輸機，以及未來的轟-20飛翼隱形轟炸機。
en: AVIC designs and produces the PRC’s military aircraft, including the J-20 fifth-generation fighter, the Y-20 heavy transport, and the future H-20 flying wing stealth bomber.

zh: COMAC生產大型客機，並已開始向印尼出口ARJ21支線客機，以配合其拓展國際商用客機市場的努力。
en: COMAC produces large passenger aircraft and has begun to export the ARJ21 regional jet to Indonesia, in line with its efforts to expand into the international commercial airliner market.

zh: 2024年初，一架殲-35隱形戰鬥機的模型出現在中華人民共和國第一艘航空母艦遼寧艦的甲板上，遼寧艦是解放軍航空母艦能力的試驗平台。
en: In early 2024, a model of the J-35 stealth fighter appeared on the deck of the PRC’s first aircraft carrier, the Liaoning—a test bed for PLA carrier capabilities.

zh: 中華人民共和國的軍事航空工業持續向海外出口無人飛行載具，包括2023年向剛果民主共和國出售九架武裝無人機。
en: The PRC’s military aviation industry has continued to export UAVs abroad, including its sale of nine armed drones to the Democratic Republic of Congo in 2023.

zh: 在關鍵科學與技術領域達成自給自足的目標，是中華人民共和國國家計畫數十年來的主題，最近在第14個五年計畫中再次重申。
en: The goal of attaining self-sufficiency in key S&T sectors—a theme of PRC state plans going back decades—was recently reiterated in the 14th FYP.

zh: 在其第14個五年計畫中，中華人民共和國優先推進新一代人工智慧、量子資訊、腦科學與生物技術、半導體，以及深空、深海與極地相關技術。
en: In its 14th FYP, the PRC prioritized the advancement of next-generation AI, quantum information, brain science and biotechnology, semiconductors, and deep space, deep sea, and polar-related technologies.

zh: 中華人民共和國維持高水準的研發經費，並對從事前沿技術的國內企業提供大量補貼。
en: The PRC sustains high levels of R&D funding and offers significant subsidies to domestic companies working on frontier technologies.

zh: 中華人民共和國的目標是在2025年之前，於人工智慧研發方面超越西方，並在2030年之前成為人工智慧的世界領導者。
en: The PRC aims to overtake the West in AI R&D by 2025 to become the world leader in AI by 2030.

zh: 中華人民共和國已把人工智慧列為優先的國家級科學與技術發展領域，並評估人工智慧與自主性的進展，是智慧化戰爭的核心，而智慧化戰爭是中華人民共和國對未來戰爭的概念。
en: The PRC has designated AI as a priority, national-level S&T development area and assesses that advances in AI and autonomy are central to intelligentized warfare, the PRC’s concept of future warfare.

zh: 中華人民共和國的研究人員在某些人工智慧應用方面是世界領先者，例如臉部辨識與自然語言處理，而中華人民共和國的公司正在行銷國內設計的人工智慧晶片。
en: PRC researchers are world leaders in certain AI applications, such as facial recognition and natural language processing, and PRC companies are marketing domestically-designed AI chips.

zh: 雖然中華人民共和國仍依賴某些外國能力來生產人工智慧硬體，例如先進半導體製造工具與軟體，但中華人民共和國的研究人員持續探索次世代半導體的新材料與設計概念。
en: While the PRC remains reliant on certain foreign capabilities to produce AI hardware, such as advanced semiconductor fabrication tools and software, PRC researchers continue to explore new materials and design concepts for next-generation semiconductors.

zh: 截至2021年，中華人民共和國尋求至少36架俄羅斯Ka-52K艦載重型攻擊直升機，以便從075型兩棲突擊艦上作業，同時發展國產替代方案。
en: As of 2021, the PRC sought at least 36 Russian Ka-52K ship-borne heavy attack helicopters to operate from Type 075 LHAs while it develops a domestic alternative.

zh: 中華人民共和國的武器銷售主要透過國營出口機構進行，例如中國航空工業集團與中國北方工業公司。
en: The PRC’s arms sales operate primarily through state-run export organizations, such as AVIC and North Industries Corporation.

zh: 雖然中華人民共和國通常不公開購買這類武器的國家，但緬甸在2021年展示了SY-400運輸起豎發射車，卡達則在2017年展示了JARM。
en: Although the PRC typically does not disclose the countries purchasing these types of arms, in 2021, Burma displayed an SY-400 TEL in 2021 and Qatar displayed a JARM in 2017.

zh: 2023年4月，泰國接收了一艘新護衛艦，作為潛艦母艦使用。
en: In April 2023, Thailand received a new frigate to serve as a submarine tender.

zh: 所有由CSC資助的學生，都被期望承認其向上級機關報告與中華人民共和國國家科學與技術相關事項的法律義務。
en: All CSC-funded students are expected to acknowledge their legal obligation to report to higher authorities on matters relating to PRC state S&T.

zh: 自2020年衝突以來，西部戰區與印度指揮官已舉行21次軍長級會談。
en: WTC and Indian commanders have held 21 corps commander-level talks since the 2020 clash.

zh: 部分由CSC資助的學生已公開表示，打算運用所蒐集的技術與專有知識，使中華人民共和國的機構受益。
en: Some CSC-funded students have openly stated their intent to use collected technologies and proprietary knowledge to benefit PRC institutions.

zh: 參謀長聯席會議主席於2023年12月，與中華人民共和國聯合參謀部首長進行了一次國防電話熱線（DTL）視訊通話，討論作業安全以及區域與功能性議題。
en: The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff held one defense telephone link (DTL) video call with the PRC head of the Joint Staff Department in December 2023 to discuss operational safety along with regional and functional issues.

zh: 美國國防部把信心建立措施視為降低誤解或誤判風險、簡報重要政策文件、執行戰俘與任務中失蹤人員查核，以及促進國際規則與規範的場合。
en: DoD views CBMs as venues to reduce risks of misunderstanding or misperceptions, brief significant policy documents, carry out POW/MIA accounting, and promote international rules and norms.

zh: 他們在2024年4月進行了一次國防電話熱線視訊通話，並於2024年5月在新加坡香格里拉對話場邊會晤一次。
en: They conducted one DTL video call in April 2024 and met once in May 2024 on the sidelines of the Shangri La Dialogue in Singapore.

zh: 2024年1月，國防部戰俘與任務中失蹤人員查核署的一個小組，在中華人民共和國進行場址勘查，以尋找在第二次世界大戰中任務中失蹤的美國軍人。
en: In January 2024, a Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency team conducted site surveys in the PRC to locate U.S. service members missing in action from World War II.

zh: 振興政治工作的努力，源自習近平對軍隊政治忠誠與腐敗問題的關切。
en: Efforts to revitalize political work derive from the Xi’s concerns regarding political loyalty and corruption in the armed forces.

zh: 解放軍的政治工作包括領導中共在各軍種的工作、管理人員與福利、監督晉升與任職、處理公共關係、督導個人與單位的政治訓練，以及在戰時瓦解對抗兵力。
en: Political work in the PLA includes leading the work of the CCP in the armed services, managing personnel and welfare, overseeing promotions and assignments, handling public relations, supervising individual and unit political training, and undermining opposing forces in wartime.

zh: 雖然黨委員會對重大議題做出決策，但軍事主官通常負責軍事與作戰事務的日常決策，而政治委員通常負責單位的政治工作與人事決策。
en: While the party committee makes decisions on major issues, the military commander is usually responsible for daily decisions on military and operational matters, whereas the political commissar is typically responsible for the unit’s political work and personnel decisions.

zh: 政治軍官被安排在政治職業軌道上，並在職業中期與高階階段，於院校或中央黨校參加政治教育課程。
en: Political officers are slotted in the political career track and enroll in political education courses at academies or the Central Party School at the mid-career and senior-levels.

zh: 解放軍單位領導層通常包括單位指揮官、政治委員、單位政治工作部的主官，以及依其在單位內的任職而被指派黨內職務的其他人員。
en: PLA unit leadership typically includes the unit commander, political commissar, head of the unit’s political work department, and other individuals assigned party positions based on their assignment within the unit.

zh: 黨委員會負責對規劃與訓練、軍官考核與晉升、經費支出與人事管理做出整體決策。
en: Party committees are responsible for making overall decisions on planning and training, officer evaluations and promotions, expenditure of funds, and personnel management.

zh: 連級單位設有黨支部，由黨支部委員會領導。
en: Company-level organizations have party branches overseen by party branch committees.

zh: 該體系與各級黨委員會，在解放軍全軍傳達並執行中共中央委員會與中央軍事委員會的決策與計畫方面，扮演重要角色。
en: The system, along with party committees at all levels, plays an important role in transmitting and implementing the decisions and plans for the CCP Central Committee and CMC throughout the PLA.

zh: 「綜合國力」一詞，至今仍被中華人民共和國的官員、戰略家與理論家廣泛使用。
en: The term CNP remains broadly used by PRC officials, strategists, and theorists today.

zh: 綜合國力被用作衡量發展的內部指標，以及敵對治理體系之間競爭的校準參照，也就是中華人民共和國的社會主義體系與西方的資本主義體系。
en: CNP is used as an internal measurement of development and a calibrated reference for competition between inimical governance systems—the PRC’s socialist system and the West’s capitalist system.

zh: 綜合國力與軍事競爭密不可分，因為對中華人民共和國而言，戰場上的對抗不僅是兩國軍事體系之間的較量，更是以各國整體實力為基礎的體系性對抗。
en: CNP is inexorably tied to military competition as, for the PRC, confrontation on the battlefield represents not just a contest between two countries’ military systems but a systemic confrontation based on the overall strength of each country.

zh: 習近平在第20次黨代表大會上明確指出，綜合國力衡量中華人民共和國朝2035年與2049年國家目標邁進的進展。
en: Xi Jinping made clear at the 20th Party Congress that CNP measures the PRC’s progress toward its 2035 and 2049 national goals.

zh: 整體而言，中華人民共和國認為其綜合國力正在加速成長，而美國的綜合國力則在減速。
en: In general, the PRC perceives that its CNP growth is accelerated while that of the United States is decelerating.

zh: 中華人民共和國的理論家強調，中華人民共和國必須同時提升綜合國力的所有面向，為中華人民共和國的發展「打下堅實的物質基礎」。
en: PRC theorists emphasize that the PRC must simultaneously grow all aspects of CNP to “lay a solid material foundation” for the PRC’s development.

zh: 就軍事與非軍事實力之間的平衡而言，他們主張同步成長，不僅止於在兩者之間尋找適當的資源分配平衡，而是要完善一種體系性做法，使國防投資帶動後續的經濟發展，反之亦然。
en: As it applies to the balance between military and non-military strengths, they champion simultaneous growth, going beyond finding an adequate balance of resource allocation between the two to perfecting a systemic approach where investments in national defense create follow-on economic development and vice versa.

zh: 整體而言，中華人民共和國關於發展INSS&C與提升中華人民共和國綜合國力的討論，都帶有一種憂慮，即在確保中華人民共和國自身崛起的同時，必須為持久的戰略競爭與不可預測的國際環境做好準備。
en: Overall, PRC discussions of developing the INSS&C and growing the PRC’s CNP are tinged with concern about preparing for enduring strategic competition and an unpredictable international environment while ensuring the PRC’s own rise.

zh: 在整個後毛澤東改革時代，特別是冷戰結束後，黨的領導人認識到，其社會主義體系過去是、並且長期而言仍將是與西方之間緊張關係的根本來源。
en: Throughout the post-Mao reform era and particularly after the end of the Cold War, the Party’s leaders recognized their socialist system was—and would remain over the long-term—an underlying source of tension with the West.

zh: 近年來，全國人民代表大會也通過了一系列旨在處理更具體國家安全問題的法律，包括反間諜（2014年，2022年更新）、反恐（2015年）、網路安全（2016年）、中國境內的外國非政府組織（2016年）、情報（2017年）、密碼（2019年）與海警（2021年）。
en: In recent years, the NPC has also passed a series of laws intended to address more specific national security concerns including counterespionage (2014, updated in 2022), counterterrorism (2015), cybersecurity (2016), foreign non-governmental organizations in China (2016), intelligence (2017), cryptography (2019), and the coast guard (2021).

zh: 中華人民共和國官員也把澳英美三邊安全夥伴關係描繪為核擴散行為與對區域穩定的威脅，以激起國際社會對該三邊安全夥伴關係的疑慮，並施壓各國限制與美國支持的聯盟的往來。
en: PRC officials have also framed AUKUS as an act of nuclear proliferation and threat to regional stability to stoke international concerns about the trilateral security partnership and press countries to limit engagement with U.S.-backed alliance.

zh: 俄羅斯對烏克蘭的戰爭，對北京而言是一項重大且出乎意料的挑戰，因為北京設法因應這場自第二次世界大戰結束以來歐洲最大的軍事衝突。
en: The Russian war on Ukraine represented a major, unexpected challenge for Beijing as it sought to react to the largest military conflict in Europe since the end of World War II.

zh: 俄軍已在烏克蘭使用源自中國的無人機，執行目標指示、監視與打擊任務。
en: Chinese-origin drones have been employed by Russian forces for targeting, surveillance, and strike missions in Ukraine.

zh: 2023年8月，北京宣布將對民用與軍民兩用無人機市場，以及民用反無人機系統的銷售，實施首次管制，以回應國際上對中國無人機被用於俄羅斯在烏克蘭侵略戰爭的揣測。
en: In August 2023, Beijing announced it would implement its first controls on the civilian and dual-use drone market, as well as the sale of civilian-use counter-UAV systems, in response to international speculation over Chinese drones’ use in Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine.

zh: 然而，截至2022年底，中國官員仍未明確界定全球安全倡議將如何實際推進其所主張的模糊安全目標，例如維護「綜合」安全與保護領土完整。
en: As of the end of 2022, however, Chinese officials had yet to clearly define how GSI would actually advance the vague security goals it espouses, such as safeguarding “comprehensive” security and protecting territorial integrity.

zh: 值得注意的是，2022年5月下旬與6月初，時任中華人民共和國外交部長王毅訪問了包括斐濟與索羅門群島在內的七個太平洋島國，並設法推動中國與太平洋島國關係的擴展。
en: Of note, in late May and early June 2022, then PRC Foreign Minister Wang Yi traveled to seven PICs, including Fiji and the Solomon Islands, and sought to promote the expansion of Sino-PICs relations.

zh: 北京很可能設法利用與太平洋島國的安全協議，為解放軍在該區域擴大安全活動提供正當理由。
en: Beijing probably seeks to use security agreements with the PICs to justify the expansion of PLA security activities in the region.

zh: 沿實際控制線（LAC）與印度的緊張情勢，在2020年5月中旬引發中國與印度部隊之間的對峙，並持續到冬季。
en: Tensions with India along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) sparked a standoff between Chinese and Indian forces in mid-May 2020, which persisted into the winter.

zh: 日本主張，應以涉及各國之間的等距線劃分專屬經濟海域，而中共則主張超出等距線、延伸至沖繩海槽的延伸大陸礁層。
en: Japan maintains that an equidistant line from each country involved should separate the EEZs, while China claims an extended continental shelf beyond the equidistant line to the Okinawa Trench.

zh: 2022年全年，中華人民共和國持續運用解放軍海軍（PLAN）、中國海警與海上民兵在該區域巡邏。
en: The PRC continued to employ the PLA Navy (PLAN), China Coast Guard, and maritime militia to patrol the region throughout 2022.

zh: 中華人民共和國長期以不符合《聯合國海洋法公約》所反映之習慣國際法規則的方式，挑戰外國在其所主張的專屬經濟海域（EEZ）內的軍事活動。
en: The PRC has long challenged foreign military activities in its claimed exclusive economic zone (EEZ) in a manner that is inconsistent with the rules of customary international law as reflected in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

zh: 例子包括派遣情報蒐集船，對軍事演習進行蒐集，例如2014年與2018年在夏威夷外海的環太平洋（RIMPAC）演習、2017年、2019年與2021年在澳洲外海的TALISMAN SABER，以及2017年與2021年在阿拉斯加附近活動。
en: Examples include sending intelligence collection ships to collect on military exercises such as the Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) exercise off Hawaii in 2014 and 2018, TALISMAN SABER off Australia in 2017, 2019, and 2021, and operating near Alaska in 2017 and 2021.

zh: 中華人民共和國的調查船在南海也極為活躍，經常在該區域其他國家宣稱的專屬經濟海域內活動，例如菲律賓、越南與馬來西亞。
en: PRC survey ships are also extremely active in the SCS and frequently operate in the claimed EEZs of other nations in the region such as the Philippines, Vietnam, and Malaysia.

zh: 基本經濟制度包含中國的公有制經濟與多種所有制經濟。
en: The basic economic system comprises China’s public ownership economy and the multi-ownership economy.

zh: 中華人民共和國透過以下方式尋求並取得外國技術：外國直接投資、海外併購、合法技術進口、設立外國研發（R&D）中心、合資企業、研究與學術夥伴關係、人才招募，以及工業與網路空間的間諜活動與竊取。
en: The PRC seeks and obtains foreign technology through the following means: foreign direct investment, overseas acquisitions, legal technology imports, the establishment of foreign research and development (R&D) centers, joint ventures, research and academic partnerships, talent recruitment, industrial, and cyberspace espionage and theft.

zh: 中華人民共和國領導人用來設定戰略指示的重要活動，也避免提及「中國製造」，包括2019年中央經濟工作會議與全國人民代表大會。
en: Key events that PRC leaders use to set strategic directives have also avoided references to “Made in China,” including the 2019 Central Economic Work Conference and the NPC.

zh: 北京運用「一帶一路」支持其民族復興戰略，設法擴大全球運輸與貿易聯繫，以支持其發展，並深化與周邊及更遠國家的經濟整合。
en: Beijing uses BRI to support its strategy of national rejuvenation by seeking to expand global transportation and trade links to support its development and deepen its economic integration with nations along its periphery and beyond.

zh: 第二，北京開始以強調合作與夥伴關係的措辭，取代先前的「一帶一路」論述，這很可能旨在使「一帶一路」對外國夥伴更具吸引力。
en: Second, Beijing began to replace previous BRI rhetoric with language highlighting cooperation and partnership, which likely is designed to make BRI more appealing to foreign partners.

zh: 這些努力的執行因缺乏集中的政府控制，以及黨國體制內存在的組織障礙而停滯。
en: Implementation of these efforts stalled due to a lack of centralized government control and the organizational barriers that exist across the party-state.

zh: 除了彰顯其重要性之外，中共中央委員會把軍民融合發展戰略提升為國家級戰略，也是為了克服黨國體制內執行上的障礙。
en: In addition to signifying its importance, the CCP Central Committee’s elevation of the MCF Development Strategy to a national-level strategy also was intended to overcome obstacles to implementation across the party-state.

zh: 這個軍民融合體系旨在極大化國家科學與技術發展的全部效益與潛力。
en: This MCF system seeks to maximize the full benefits and potential of the country’s S&T development.

zh: 這個軍民融合體系中的具體努力，包括強化並促進先進軍民兩用技術的民用與軍事研發，以及促進軍事與民用基礎研究的相互交流。
en: Specific efforts in this MCF system include strengthening and promoting civilian and military R&D in advanced dual-use technologies and cross-pollinating military and civilian basic research.

zh: 這包括在建設民用私人與公共運輸基礎設施時，把軍事需求與軍民兩用目的納入考量，例如機場、港口設施、鐵路、公路與通信網路。
en: This includes factoring military requirements and dual-use purposes into building civilian private and public transportation infrastructure such as airports, port facilities, railways, roads, and communications networks.

zh: 鑑於中共對復興後的中國抱持深遠的抱負，黨不太可能以中華人民共和國對美國或任何其他潛在對手保持軍事劣勢，作為終極狀態目標。
en: Given the far-reaching ambitions the CCP has for a rejuvenated China, it is unlikely that the Party would aim for an end state in which the PRC would remain in a position of military inferiority vis-à-vis the United States or any other potential rival.

zh: 幾個月後，習近平在其年度新年賀詞中，強調了2022年的軍事與戰略成就，包括解放軍成立95週年、解放軍海軍第三艘航空母艦下水，以及中國太空站的建成。
en: A few months later, in his annual new year’s address, Xi highlighted military and strategic achievements from 2022 including the PLA’s 95th anniversary, the launching of the PLAN’s third aircraft carrier, and the completion of China’s space station.

zh: 中共中央軍事委員會目前由習近平擔任主席，是中華人民共和國最高軍事決策機構。
en: The CCP CMC, currently chaired by Xi, is the highest military decision-making body in the PRC.

zh: 中央軍事委員會主席是文人，通常同時擔任中共總書記與中華人民共和國主席。
en: The CMC Chairman is a civilian, usually serving concurrently as the General Secretary of the CCP and President of the PRC.

zh: 2022年，中央軍事委員會由兩名副主席、國防部長、聯合參謀部與政治工作部的首長，以及紀律檢查委員會的負責人組成。
en: In 2022, the CMC consisted of two vice chairs, the Minister of National Defense, the chiefs of the Joint Staff and Political Work Departments, and the head of the Discipline Inspection Commission.

zh: 戰略支援部隊（SSF）集中解放軍的戰略太空、網路空間、電子戰、資訊、通信與心理戰任務與能力。
en: The Strategic Support Force (SSF) centralizes the PLA’s strategic space, cyberspace, electronic warfare, information, communications, and psychological warfare missions and capabilities.

zh: 最後，聯勤保障部隊負責軍需、運輸、醫療服務與其他後勤職能，以增強解放軍在平時與戰時的聯合能力。
en: Lastly, the JLSF handles quartermaster, transportation, medical services, and other logistic functions to enhance PLA’s joint capabilities during peace and war.

zh: 2020年國防大學的《軍事戰略學》，把解放軍陸軍的發展描述為從區域防衛轉變為全球作戰力量。
en: The 2020 National Defense University’s Science of Military Strategy described the PLAA’s development as a transition from a regional defense to a global combat force.

zh: 解放軍陸軍還指揮戰區陸軍司令部之下的數個邊防與海防旅，以及新疆與西藏軍區之下的團。
en: The PLAA also commands several border and coastal defense brigades under the Theater Army Commands and regiments under the Xinjiang and Tibet Military Districts.

zh: 解放軍陸軍的訓練活動與中華人民共和國媒體的報導顯示，支援兩棲作戰、多維突擊、發展密接空中支援戰術，以及有人無人協同（MUM-T），如今已成為訓練的標準部分。
en: PLAA training events and reports in PRC media show that support to amphibious operations, multi-dimensional assaults, developing close air support tactics, and manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) are now a standard part of training.

zh: 2022年，解放軍陸軍防空單位專注於改進對低慢威脅的戰術防空，例如無人飛行載具系統（UAS）與遊蕩彈藥，以滿足不斷演變的防空要求。
en: PLAA air defense units in 2022 concentrated on improving their tactical air defense against low and slow threats like Uncrewed Aerial Systems (UAS) and loitering munitions to meet evolving air defense requirements.

zh: 複合式自走防空砲兵系統（SPADA）、火砲防空砲兵、小型專用電子戰系統，以及攜帶型防空飛彈（MANPADS），構成中華人民共和國反制戰術無人飛行載具系統這項不斷演進的解決方案之核心。
en: Hybrid self-propelled air defense artillery systems (SPADA), gun air defense artillery, small focused electronic warfare systems, and Man-Portable Air Defense Systems (MANPADS) form the core of the PRC’s evolving solution to countering tactical UAS.

zh: 部署至輕型合成旅、具高度反無人飛行載具系統潛力的系統之一，配備六管25毫米旋轉砲，可能使用可程式化定時引信預破片（PTFP）彈藥，並在砲塔上掛載四枚FN-16攜帶型防空飛彈。
en: One of the systems with high counter UAS potential being fielded to light combined arms brigades is armed with a six barreled 25mm rotary cannon, which possibly uses Programmable Timed Fuse Pre-Fragmented (PTFP) rounds, and also mounts four FN-16 MANPADS on its turret.

zh: 與合成旅部署電子戰能力類似，解放軍陸軍防空部隊已迅速部署新的反空電子攻擊能力，這些能力將補充傳統防空，並支援全解放軍的反介入與區域拒止（A2AD）任務。
en: Similar to the combined arms brigade’s fielding of EW capabilities, the PLAA’s air defense forces have rapidly fielded new counter-air electronic attack capabilities that will complement traditional air defense and support the PLA-wide anti-access, area-denial (A2AD) mission.

zh: 除了解放軍陸軍持續部署到印度邊境的實際控制線之外，解放軍陸軍還在全國各地的訓練場，進行了多次「全天候」大規模演習，包括因應2022年美國與台灣行動的聯合作戰。
en: In addition to continued PLAA deployments to the LAC on the Indian border, the PLAA conducted multiple “around the clock” large-scale exercises in training areas throughout the country to include joint operations in response to the U.S. and Taiwan actions in 2022.

zh: 新型遠程多管火箭發射器能夠從中國大陸打擊台灣。
en: The new long-range MRL is capable of striking Taiwan from mainland China.

zh: 同時，解放軍海軍在其他國家的專屬經濟海域內活動，包括美國、澳洲、菲律賓、越南與馬來西亞。
en: At the same time, the PLAN conducts activities in the EEZs of other countries, including the United States, Australia, Philippines, Vietnam, and Malaysia.

zh: 解放軍海軍於2021年12月服役第二艘YUSHEN級兩棲突擊艦（075型兩棲突擊艦），並於2022年10月服役第三艘，該級首艘艦在2022年3月達成初始作戰能力（IOC）。
en: The PLAN commissioned its second YUSHEN-class amphibious assault ship (TYPE 075 LHA) in December 2021 and the third in October 2022 with the first ship in the class achieving initial operating capability (IOC) in March 2022.

zh: 然而，近年來，解放軍已開始在包括美國在內的其他國家專屬經濟海域內，於第一島鏈內外進行同類型的軍事活動。
en: However, in recent years, the PLA has begun conducting the same types of military activities inside and outside the FIC in the EEZs of other countries, including the United States.

zh: 中華人民共和國正處於運作解放軍所稱「多航空母艦兵力」的初期階段。中華人民共和國持續從營運其第一艘航空母艦遼寧艦的經驗中汲取教訓。
en: The PRC is in the beginning stages of operating what the PLA calls its “multi-carrier force.” The PRC continues to learn lessons from operating its first aircraft carrier, Liaoning.

zh: CV-18福建艦於2022年6月下水，預計於2024年服役。
en: CV-18 Fujian launched in June 2022 and is expected to commission in 2024.

zh: 這個新的SHANG級衍生型，將增強解放軍海軍的反水面作戰能力，若配備對地攻擊巡弋飛彈（LACM），還可提供隱密的對地攻擊選項。
en: This new SHANG-class variant will enhance the PLAN’s anti-surface warfare capability and could provide a clandestine land-attack option if equipped with land-attack cruise missiles (LACM).

zh: 解放軍海軍也透過發展其水面作戰艦艇與特殊任務飛機，改善其反潛作戰能力，但仍缺乏強健的深海反潛作戰（ASW）能力。
en: The PLAN is also improving its anti-submarine warfare capabilities through the development of its surface combatants and special mission aircraft, but it continues to lack a robust deep-water anti-submarine warfare (ASW) capability.

zh: 截至2022年底，解放軍海軍正在建造一艘航空母艦、一批新的飛彈巡洋艦、飛彈驅逐艦，以及一批新的飛彈護衛艦，包括代號JIANGKAI III的新型054衍生型。
en: As of late 2022, the PLAN was building an aircraft carrier, a new batch of guided-missile cruisers, guided-missile destroyers, and a new batch of guided missile frigates, including a new 054 variant designated JIANGKAI III.

zh: 到2019年底，解放軍海軍已服役第30艘JIANGKAI II級飛彈護衛艦，據報導完成了這批生產。
en: By the end of 2019, the PLAN had commissioned its 30th JIANGKAI II-class FFG, reportedly completing the production run.

zh: 這種新型艦射反艦彈道飛彈，可能可由LUYANG III與LUYANG III MOD飛彈驅逐艦發射。
en: The new ship launched anti-ship ballistic missile can possibly be launched by the LUYANG III and LUYANG III MOD DDGs.

zh: 少數現代化驅逐艦已加裝超音速鷹擊-12A反艦飛彈（270海浬），而次世代護衛艦也可能配備這種飛彈。
en: A few modernized destroyers have been retrofitted with the supersonic YJ-12A ASCM (270NM), and the next-generation frigates may also receive this missile.

zh: 此外，解放軍海軍有八艘大型YUZHAO級船塢登陸艦（LPD）（071型）服役。
en: In addition, the PLAN has eight large YUZHAO-class amphibious transport docks (LPD) (TYPE 071) in service.

zh: 這種設計將使其能夠支援更多戰鬥機、固定翼預警機與更快速的飛行作業，從而擴大其艦載攻擊機的作戰範圍與效能。
en: This design will enable it to support additional fighter aircraft, fixed-wing early-warning aircraft, and more rapid flight operations and thus extend the reach and effectiveness of its carrier-based strike aircraft.

zh: 另外兩種殲-15衍生型正在研發中：雙座串列的殲-15S衍生型，以及電子戰衍生型殲-15D，後者配備翼尖電子支援措施／電子情報蒐集莢艙，以及數具貼合式天線。
en: Two other J-15 variants are in development – the J-15S tandem-seat variant and the J-15D electronic warfare variant, which is equipped with wingtip electronic support measures/electronic intelligence gathering pods as well as several conformal antennas.

zh: 除了戰鬥機之外，中華人民共和國正在改進一種稱為空警-600的艦載空中預警（AEW）機的設計。
en: Beyond fighter aircraft, the PRC is refining the design of a carrier-borne airborne early warning (AEW) aircraft, known as the KJ-600.

zh: 北京也正為解放軍海軍發展直-20F直升機，預定配屬RENHAI巡洋艦與LUYANG III MOD驅逐艦，並可能配屬YUSHEN兩棲突擊艦。
en: Beijing is also developing the Z-20F helicopter for the PLAN, intended for the RENHAI cruisers and LUYANG III MOD destroyers and possibly the YUSHEN LHAs.

zh: 直-20F類似美國海軍的SH-60，並將使反潛作戰能力，較解放軍海軍目前操作的較小型直-9與Ka-28直升機有顯著提升。
en: The Z-20F is similar to the U.S. Navy’s SH-60 and will provide significant improvements in ASW capabilities over the smaller Z-9 and Ka-28 helicopters the PLAN currently operates.

zh: 直-20F也將補充從解放軍海軍航空母艦上作業的較大型直-18F。
en: The Z-20F will also complement the larger Z-18Fs that operate from the PLAN’s aircraft carriers.

zh: 一個小型光電（EO）／紅外線轉塔位於前輪正後方，且這個衍生型在主起落架前方配備內部武器艙。
en: A small electro-optical (EO)/infrared turret is located just behind the nose wheel, and this variant is equipped with an internal weapons bay in front of the main landing gear.

zh: 中華人民共和國也從陸地基地操作中型至大型的固定翼無人飛行載具。
en: The PRC also operates a fixed-wing medium to large size UAVs from land bases.

zh: 解放軍海軍持續建造大量遠洋輔助與支援艦艇，包括情報蒐集艦、海洋監視艦、補給油艦、醫療艦、潛艦救難艦，以及各種用於專門任務的其他大型輔助艦艇。
en: The PLAN continues to build a large number of seagoing auxiliary and support ships, including AGIs, AGOs, fleet replenishment oilers, hospital ships, submarine salvage and rescue ships, and various other large auxiliaries for specialized missions.

zh: 對解放軍海軍與中共而言，擁有彈道飛彈核潛艦長期以來被視為達成大國地位的重要象徵。
en: For the PLAN and CCP, the possession of SSBNs has long been seen as an important symbol in achieving great power status.

zh: 中華人民共和國有六艘現役094型JIN級彈道飛彈核潛艦，這些潛艦正在進行海上嚇阻巡邏。
en: The PRC has six operational TYPE 094 JIN-class SSBNs, and these submarines are conducting at sea deterrent patrols.

zh: 解放軍海軍的JIN彈道飛彈核潛艦配備最多可攜帶12枚潛射彈道飛彈（SLBM）；巨浪-2（CSS-N-14）與巨浪-3（CSS-N-20）代表中華人民共和國第一個可信的海基核嚇阻力量。
en: The PLAN’s JIN SSBNs are equipped to carry up to 12 sea launched ballistic missiles (SLBMs); JL-2 (CSS-N-14) and JL-3 (CSS-N-20) representing the PRC’s first viable sea-based nuclear deterrent.

zh: 根據中華人民共和國第一代核動力攻擊潛艦超過30年的服役壽命，中華人民共和國將同時運作094型與096型彈道飛彈核潛艦。
en: Based on the 30-plus-year service life of the PRC’s first-generation SSNs, the PRC will operate the TYPE 094 and TYPE 096 SSBNs concurrently.

zh: 2020年，中共強調一個解放軍海軍陸戰隊特種作戰部隊單位，已加入先前派駐吉布地的解放軍海軍陸戰隊單位。
en: In 2020, China highlighted a PLANMC SOF unit that had joined the previously assigned PLANMC unit in Djibouti.

zh: 解放軍海軍陸戰隊也派遣一支陸戰隊分遣隊，隨解放軍海軍以亞丁灣反海盜為重點的海軍護航特遣隊出動，以支援中華人民共和國的貿易利益。
en: The PLANMC also embarks a contingent of marines with the PLAN’s Gulf of Aden counterpiracy-focused naval escort task force that supports the PRC’s trade interests.

zh: 該訓練也納入05式的偵察衍生型，並以在廣東南部舉行的多旅總結性活動作結。
en: The training also incorporated a reconnaissance variant of the Type-05, and it concluded with a multi-brigade culminating event in southern Guangdong.

zh: 年內，解放軍海軍陸戰隊航空旅參與了立體兩棲突擊訓練，內容包括空中突擊部分、兩棲裝甲車，以及氣墊登陸艇（LCAC）與突擊艇的組合。
en: The PLANMC aviation brigade participated in three-dimensional amphibious assault training during the year which included air assault components, amphibious assault vehicles, and a combination of Landing Craft Air Cushion (LCAC) and assault boats.

zh: 中央軍事委員會的意圖，是把解放軍空軍轉型為更有效、更有能力且精通執行聯合作戰的兵力。
en: The CMC’s intent is to transform the PLAAF into a more effective and capable force that is proficient at conducting joint operations.

zh: 解放軍空軍正在為殲-20準備升級，可能包括增加該戰鬥機在低可觀測構型下可攜帶的空對空飛彈（AAM）數量、安裝推力向量噴嘴，以及透過安裝推力更高的國產WS-15發動機增加超音速巡航能力。
en: The PLAAF is preparing upgrades for the J-20, which may include increasing the number of air-to-air missiles (AAM) the fighter can carry in its low-observable configuration, installing thrust-vectoring engine nozzles, and adding super cruise capability by installing higher-thrust indigenous WS-15 engines.

zh: 較小型的FC-31／殲-31仍在持續研發，用於出口，或作為解放軍海軍下一級航空母艦的未來艦載戰鬥機。
en: Development continues on the smaller FC-31/J-31 for export or as a future naval fighter for the PLAN’s next class of aircraft carriers.

zh: 轟-6N具備經修改的機身，使其能夠在外部攜帶可能具備核能力的空射彈道飛彈（ALBM）。
en: The H-6N features a modified fuselage that allows it to carry externally an air-launched ballistic missile (ALBM) that may be nuclear capable.

zh: 2020年10月，觀察到一架轟-6N攜帶空射彈道飛彈。
en: In October 2020, an H-6N was observed carrying an air-launched ballistic missile.

zh: 2019年，解放軍空軍公開亮相其新型運-9通信干擾／電子反制飛機（稱為GX-11）。
en: In 2019, the PLAAF publicly debuted its new Y-9 communications jamming/electronic countermeasures aircraft (known as the GX-11).

zh: 這些飛機放大了解放軍空軍在不同條件下、以更大數量、更遠距離偵測、追蹤並瞄準威脅的能力，它也擴大了解放軍整合防空系統（IADS）網路的範圍。
en: These aircraft amplify PLAAF’s ability to detect, track, and target threats in varying conditions, in larger volumes, and at greater distances, It also extends the range of the PLA’s integrated air defense system (IADS) network.

zh: 先進的小型無人飛行載具系統，越來越多地出現在軍事與民用應用中，而中國產業仍是各種尺寸無人飛行載具系統及其零組件的主要出口者。
en: Advanced small UASs are increasingly appearing in both military and civilian applications, with Chinese industry remaining a key exporter of UASs and components of all sizes.

zh: 解放軍空軍空降兵軍指揮六個空降合成旅、一個特種作戰部隊旅、一個作戰支援旅、一個航空運輸旅、一個訓練基地與一個新的訓練旅。
en: The PLAAF Airborne Corps commands six airborne combined arms brigades, a SOF brigade, an operational support brigade, an aviation transport brigade, a training base, and a new training brigade.

zh: 若發展並部署，這類能力將使中華人民共和國能夠威脅對美國本土、夏威夷與阿拉斯加的目標進行常規打擊。
en: If developed and fielded, such capabilities would allow the PRC to threaten conventional strikes against targets in the continental United States, Hawaii, and Alaska.

zh: 2020年，中華人民共和國在南海對移動目標發射了反艦彈道飛彈。
en: In 2020, the PRC fired anti-ship ballistic missiles against a moving target in the SCS.

zh: 射程超過11,000公里的CSS-10 Mod 2（東風-31A），能夠抵達美國本土內的大部分地點。
en: The CSS-10 Mod 2 (DF-31A), with a range in excess of 11,000 km, can reach most locations within the continental United States.

zh: 中華人民共和國很可能正在發展先進的核武投射系統，例如戰略極音速滑翔載具與部分軌道轟炸（FOB）系統。
en: The PRC probably is developing advanced nuclear delivery systems such as a strategic hypersonic glide vehicle and a fractional orbital bombardment (FOB) system.

zh: 戰略支援部隊直接向中央軍事委員會報告，並以其能力支援整個解放軍。
en: The SSF reports directly to the CMC and supports the entire PLA with its capabilities.

zh: 在司令部層級，戰略支援部隊有一個四部門的行政架構，包括參謀部、裝備部、政治工作部與後勤部。
en: At the headquarters level, the SSF has a four-department administrative structure that includes the Staff, Equipment, Political Work, and Logistics Departments.

zh: 戰略支援部隊NSD，也稱為CSF，負責資訊戰，其任務組合包括網路空間作戰、技術偵察、電子戰與心理戰。
en: The SSF NSD, also referred to as the CSF, is responsible for information warfare with a mission set that includes cyberspace warfare, technical reconnaissance, EW, and psychological warfare.

zh: NSD營運五個與戰區對應的技術偵察基地、數個信號情報局，以及數個研究所。
en: The NSD operates five theater–aligned technical reconnaissance bases, a number of signals intelligence bureaus, and several research institutes.

zh: SSD營運至少八個基地，包括核心任務為發射、追蹤、研發與操作對中華人民共和國天基指管通資情監偵架構至關重要的衛星的基地。
en: The SSD operates at least eight bases, including those whose core missions are the launch, tracking, R&D, and operation of the satellites vital to the PRC’s overhead C4ISR architecture.

zh: 中華人民共和國正邀請各國參與中國太空站或由中國與俄羅斯共同主導的國際月球科研站，並已向世界各國出售衛星發射服務與地面站。
en: The PRC is inviting countries to participate on the Chinese space station or International Lunar Research Station, which is jointly led by China and Russia, and has sold satellite launching services and ground stations to countries around the world.

zh: 該組織計畫改進光學系統的能力、覆蓋範圍與冗餘，以及資料分享網路。
en: The organization is planning to improve optical system capabilities, coverage, and redundancy as well as data sharing networks.

zh: 聯勤保障部隊的司令部設在武漢聯勤保障基地。
en: The JLSF is headquartered at Wuhan Joint Logistics Support Base.

zh: 聯勤保障部隊為解放軍提供聯合戰略與戰役層級的後勤，使解放軍能夠進行大規模作戰。
en: The JLSF provides the PLA with joint strategic-and campaign-level logistics, enabling the PLA to conduct large-scale operations.

zh: 為解放軍作戰兵力提供直接戰時支援的聯勤保障部隊單位，分為武器彈藥儲存、倉儲、醫療服務、運輸、油料、工程與營建管理、儲備裝備，以及採購支援。
en: Elements of the JLSF who provide direct wartime support to the PLA fighting force are categorized as weapons and ammunition storage, warehousing, medical services, transport, fuel, engineering and construction management, reserve equipment, and procurement support.

zh: 平時，聯勤保障部隊對JLSC的運作與活動擁有權限；戰時，各戰區可能接管其指定的JLSC。
en: During peacetime, the JLSF has authority over the JLSCs’ operations and activities; during wartime, theater commands possibly would assume control of their designated JLSC.

zh: 儘管解放軍已改善部分作戰缺陷，但整體而言，該部隊很可能仍在設法克服聯合作戰、指揮與管制，以及戰術與小單位領導方面的挑戰。
en: Although the PLA has improved some combat deficiencies, the force, as a whole, probably continues to work through challenges with joint operations, command and control, and tactical and small-unit leadership.

zh: 在這次訪問期間，台灣國防部報告有27架解放軍飛機進入台灣防空識別區，其中22架越過台灣海峽中線。
en: During the visit, Taiwan’s defense ministry reported that 27 PLA aircraft entered Taiwan’s air defense identification zone, including 22 that crossed the median of the Taiwan Strait.

zh: 公安部領導中華人民共和國的民用國家警察，擔任維護公共秩序的前線力量。
en: The MPS leads the PRC’s civilian national police, which serves as the front force for public order.

zh: 作為2018年安全架構重組的一部分，中央軍事委員會集中了對武警的控制。
en: As part of a security structures reorganization in 2018, the CMC centralized control of the PAP.

zh: 同一項改革也使中國海警隸屬於武警。
en: The same reform also subordinated the CCG to the PAP.

zh: 2020年《國防法》承認這項角色，除了對外防衛任務之外，還賦予解放軍「鞏固中共的領導與社會主義制度」的任務。
en: The 2020 National Defense Law recognizes this role in assigning the PLA the mission to “consolidate the leadership of the Communist Party of China and the socialist system” in addition to external defense tasks.

zh: 基幹民兵在必要時可招收女性公民，且在特殊情況下可放寬年齡限制。
en: The primary militia may recruit female citizens when necessary and the age limits can be waived under special circumstance.

zh: 2020年7月1日，中華人民共和國修訂法律、法規與政策，使預備役部隊歸中共中央委員會與中央軍事委員會指揮。
en: On July 1st , 2020, the PRC amended laws, regulations, and policies to bring the Reserve Force under the command of the Central Committee of the CCP and the CMC.

zh: 儘管最初成立是為了支援地面部隊，但近年來的改革設法減少解放軍陸軍的預備役，並增加解放軍海軍、解放軍空軍與解放軍火箭軍的預備役。
en: Although originally founded to support the ground forces, reforms in recent years seek to reduce PLAA reserves and increase those for the PLAN, PLAAF, and the PLARF.

zh: 然而，中華人民共和國的著作顯示，截至2018年，預備役部隊仍以地面部隊為主，只有不到10%的預備役人員在解放軍海軍、解放軍空軍、解放軍火箭軍或解放軍戰略支援部隊擔任專門技術職能。
en: However, PRC writings suggest that, as of 2018, the Reserve Force was still predominately ground force-centric, with less than 10 percent of reservists serving specialized technical functions in the PLAN, PLAAF, PLARF, or PLA SSF.

zh: 武警分為三個主要部分：內衛部隊、機動部隊與中國海警。
en: The PAP is organized into three main parts: the Internal Security Corps, the Mobile Corps, and the CCG.

zh: 習近平與中共領導層責成武警把自身整合進解放軍的聯合作戰體系。
en: Xi and the CCP leadership tasked the PAP with integrating themselves into the PLA’s joint operation system.

zh: 該法律引起其他區域國家的關切，這些國家可能將該法律視為使用武力的隱含威脅，特別是在該區域領土爭端持續之際。
en: The law was met with concern by other regional countries that may perceive the law as an implicit threat to use force, especially as territorial disputes in the region continue.

zh: 海上民兵船舶與解放軍海軍（PLAN）及中國海警（CCG）共同訓練並協助其執行任務，例如維護海洋主張、監視與偵察、漁業保護、後勤支援，以及搜索與救援。
en: CMM vessels train with and assist the People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) and the China Coast Guard (CCG) in tasks such as safeguarding maritime claims, surveillance and reconnaissance, fisheries protection, logistics support, and search and rescue.

zh: 習近平在訪問期間鼓勵潭門支持南海的「島礁開發」。
en: During the visit, Xi encouraged Tanmen to support “island and reef development” in the SCS.

zh: 2020年12月，解放軍海軍陸戰隊特種作戰部隊與機械化步兵單位參加了合成兵種奪島演習，演習中特種作戰部隊使用掃雷線狀裝藥破除障礙，並由狙擊小組擔任監視掩護。
en: In December 2020, PLANMC SOF participated in a combined arms island seizure exercise with mechanized infantry units where the SOF used mine-clearing line charges to destroy obstacles with sniper teams in overwatch.

zh: 2011年成立的解放軍空軍空降兵軍，受訓執行高空高開傘與高空低開傘的空降任務，以奪取關鍵目標、戰鬥搜索與救援，以及在撤離期間協調火力支援。
en: The PLAAF Airborne Corps, created in 2011, train to conduct high-altitude, high-opening and high-altitude, low-opening airborne missions for critical target seizure, combat search and rescue, and fire support coordination during extraction.

zh: 這些以及後續的改革，也影響了解放軍火箭軍偵察團、解放軍空軍空降兵軍特種作戰部隊旅，以及武警特種作戰部隊單位。
en: These and later reforms also impacted the PLARF Reconnaissance Regiment, the PLAAF Airborne Corps SOF BDE, and the PAP SOF units.

zh: 2002年，解放軍開始參與多國訓練演習，自那時起，中華人民共和國的特種作戰部隊人員與單位，包括武警特種作戰部隊，已參加多項外國活動，主要聚焦於反恐。
en: In 2002, the PLA began participating in multinational training exercises and since then, PRC’s SOF personnel and units, to include PAP SOF, have taken part in several foreign events, primarily focused on counterterrorism.

zh: 解放軍特種作戰部隊沒有執行任務的內部支援體系，依賴戰區來滿足其後勤需求，而武警則擁有獨立於解放軍之外的內部後勤體系，以滿足其作戰期間的持續支援需求。
en: PLA SOF do not have an internal support system to conduct missions and relies on the theater command to meet their logistical needs whereas the PAP has an internal logistic system separate from the PLA to meet their sustainment needs during operations.

zh: 解放軍維持一項強健且技術先進的地下設施（UGF）計畫，以隱蔽並保護其軍事力量的所有面向，包括指揮與管制、大規模毀滅性武器、後勤，以及現代化的飛彈、地面、空中與海軍部隊。
en: The PLA maintains a robust and technologically advanced underground facility (UGF) program to conceal and protect all aspects of its military forces, including C2, weapons of mass destruction, logistics, and modernized missile, ground, air, and naval forces.

zh: 解放軍擁有越來越多先進的遠程地對空飛彈，包括其國產CSA-9（紅旗-9）及後繼的紅旗-9B、俄製SA-10（S-300PMU），以及SA-20（S-300PMU1／PMU2），這些飛彈都具備宣稱的能力，可防禦飛機與低空飛行的巡弋飛彈。
en: The PLA has increasing numbers of advanced long-range SAMs, including its indigenous CSA-9 (HQ-9) and its follow-on HQ-9B, Russian SA-10 (S-300PMU), and SA-20 (S-300PMU1/PMU2), all of which have the advertised capability to protect against both aircraft and low-flying cruise missiles.

zh: 據中華人民共和國媒體報導，這個於2020年部署的系統，可能旨在取代部分較舊的短程彈道飛彈單位；而據一位位於中華人民共和國的軍事專家指出，它旨在打擊西太平洋的外國軍事基地與艦隊。
en: The system, fielded in 2020, is possibly intended to replace some older SRBM units, according to PRC media, and is intended to strike foreign military bases and fleets in the Western Pacific, according to a PRC-based military expert.

zh: 2022年初，南部戰區海軍進行了一次聯合遠海訓練，海軍、空軍與火箭軍人員在其中擔任聯合作戰指揮體系的職務。
en: In early 2022, the Southern Theater Command Navy conducted a joint distant sea training, where personnel from the Navy, Air Force, and Rocket Force served in the joint operations command system.

zh: 2022年，解放軍海軍下水了其第三艘航空母艦福建艦，配備電磁彈射器，能夠起飛各種固定翼飛機。
en: In 2022, the PLAN launched its third aircraft carrier, Fujian, equipped with electromagnetic catapults, capable of launching various fixed-wing aircraft.

zh: 排水量13,000噸、配備遠程反艦飛彈與地對空飛彈的RENHAI飛彈巡洋艦，很可能配備計畫中的直-20直升機海軍衍生型。
en: The RENHAI CG, with 13,000 tons displacement and long-range ASCMs and SAMs, will likely be equipped with a planned naval variant of the Z-20 helicopter.

zh: 解放軍海軍目前操作八艘YUCHAO級兩棲突擊艦，也就是船塢登陸艦（LPD），並於2021年4月服役三艘YUSHEN級直升機突擊艦（LHD）中的第一艘。
en: The PLAN currently operates eight YUCHAO-class amphibious assault ships (LPD) and commissioned its first of three YUSHEN-class helicopter assault ships (LHD) in April 2021.

zh: 除了發展定向能武器與衛星干擾器之外，解放軍擁有可作戰使用的地基反衛星（ASAT）飛彈，用於攻擊低地球軌道衛星。
en: In addition to the development of directed-energy weapons and satellite jammers, the PLA has an operational ground-based anti-satellite (ASAT) missile intended to target low-Earth orbit satellites.

zh: 解放軍著作判斷其他國家在近期衝突中有效運用了網路空間戰與其他資訊作戰，並主張攻擊指揮與管制及後勤網路，以影響對手在衝突初期做出決策與採取行動的能力。
en: PLA writings judge other countries have effectively used cyberspace warfare and other IO in recent conflicts and argue for attacks against C2 and logistics networks to affect an adversary’s ability to make decisions and take actions in the early stages of conflict.

zh: 戰略支援部隊很可能透過在其組織內結合國家級的網路空間偵察、攻擊與防禦能力，以及其他戰略資訊作戰能力，並整合進戰區的規劃與作戰，來創造綜效。
en: The SSF likely is generating synergies by combining national-level cyberspace reconnaissance, attack, and defense capabilities in its organization, alongside other strategic IO capabilities, and integrating into theater command planning and operations.

zh: 解放軍正在研究人工智慧的各種應用，包括對飛彈導引、目標偵測與識別，以及自主系統的支援。
en: The PLA is researching various applications for AI including support for missile guidance, target detection and identification, and autonomous systems.

zh: 解放軍也認為無人系統是關鍵的智慧化技術，並正為無人空中、水面與水下載具追求更高的自主性，以實現有人無人協同、群集攻擊、最佳化後勤支援與分散式情報、監視與偵察等能力。
en: The PLA also considers unmanned systems to be critical intelligentized technology, and is pursuing greater autonomy for unmanned aerial, surface, and underwater vehicles to enable manned and unmanned teaming, swarm attacks, optimized logistic support, and distributed ISR, among other capabilities.

zh: 由解放軍管理的太空計畫，同時支援民用與軍事利益，包括強化其科學與技術部門、擴大國際關係，並使軍隊現代化。
en: The space program, managed by the PLA, supports both civilian and military interests, including strengthening its science and technology sector, growing international relationships, and modernizing the military.

zh: 中華人民共和國擁有可作戰使用的地基反衛星（ASAT）飛彈，用於攻擊低地球軌道衛星，而中共很可能打算追求更多能夠摧毀高達地球同步軌道之衛星的反衛星武器。
en: The PRC has an operational ground-based anti-satellite (ASAT) missile intended to target low-Earth orbit satellites, and China probably intends to pursue additional ASAT weapons capable of destroying satellites up to geosynchronous Earth orbit.

zh: 解放軍擁有並操作約佔全球一半的情報、監視與偵察系統，其中大多數可支援對全球美國與盟軍部隊的監控、追蹤與瞄準，特別是在整個印太地區。
en: The PLA owns and operates about half of the world’s ISR systems, most of which could support monitoring, tracking, and targeting of U.S. and allied forces worldwide, especially throughout the Indo-Pacific region.

zh: 中華人民共和國天基情報、監視與偵察能力的近期改進，著重發展、採購並運用越來越有能力的衛星，這些衛星配備數位相機技術，以及可提供全天候24小時涵蓋的天基雷達。
en: Recent improvements to the PRC’s space-based ISR capabilities emphasize the development, procurement, and use of increasingly capable satellites with digital camera technology as well as space-based radar for all-weather, 24-hour coverage.

zh: 繼1999年開始的無人任務之後，中國在2003年成功把載人的神舟5號太空船送入軌道，成為第三個獨立實現載人航天的國家。
en: Following uncrewed missions that began in 1999, China became the third country to achieve independent human spaceflight when it successfully orbited the crewed Shenzhou-5 spacecraft in 2003.

zh: 2022年，中國成功把夢天號實驗艙送入軌道，完成了由三個艙段組成的中國太空站。
en: In 2022, China successfully launched the Mengtian Chinese Space Station laboratory module into orbit, completing the three-module Chinese space station.

zh: 這輛火星車為中國提供了關於火星表面與地下的寶貴科學資料。
en: This rover has provided China with valuable scientific data of the Martian surface and underground.

zh: 中華人民共和國已發展快速反應太空發射載具，以提高其作為商業小型衛星發射服務供應商的吸引力，並快速重建低地球軌道太空能力，這些能力可在衝突期間支援中華人民共和國的軍事作戰，或在災難發生時支援民間應變。
en: The PRC has developed quick-response SLVs to increase its attractiveness as a commercial small satellite launch provider and to rapidly reconstitute LEO space capabilities, which could support PRC military operations during a conflict or civilian response to disasters.

zh: 096型彈道飛彈核潛艦可能旨在部署配備分導式多彈頭的潛射彈道飛彈，並很可能在2020年代初期開始建造。
en: The Type 096 SSBN is probably intended to field MIRVed SLBMs and will likely begin construction in the early 2020s.

zh: 與其他轟-6轟炸機相比，轟-6N增加了空中加油探管，以及其凹入式機身改裝，這些改裝可使其外部攜帶具備核能力的空射彈道飛彈。
en: The H-6N, compared to other H-6 bombers, adds an air-to-air refueling probe, as well as its recessed fuselage modifications that would allow for external carriage of a nuclear-capable ALBM.

zh: 解放軍著作顯示，此過程涉及多個有人操作的指揮與管制機構，並由天基與地基感測器預警，而且這種態勢大致類似美國與俄羅斯的預警發射態勢。
en: PLA writings suggest multiple manned C2 organs are involved in this process, warned by space and ground based sensors, and that this posture is broadly similar to the U.S. and Russian LOW posture.

zh: 中華人民共和國境內的實體與個人，持續向受關注國家提供適用於大規模毀滅性武器與飛彈計畫的技術、零組件與原料。
en: Entities and individuals in the PRC continue to supply countries of concern with technologies, components, and raw materials applicable to weapons of mass destruction and missile programs.

zh: 這些演習包括對台灣本島上空發射彈道飛彈、十餘次海軍巡邏，以及數百架次進入台灣所宣稱的防空識別區（ADIZ）的飛行。
en: The exercises included firing ballistic missiles over Taiwan’s main island, over a dozen naval patrols, and hundreds of flights into Taiwan’s claimed air defense identification zone (ADIZ).

zh: 在突發事件期間，東部戰區很可能也對戰區內的部分戰略支援部隊單位行使指揮權，並從戰略支援部隊接受戰略情報支援，以改善戰場覺知並促進戰區內的聯合作戰。
en: During a contingency, the Eastern Theater Command likely also exercises command over some SSF units in theater and receives strategic intelligence support from the SSF to improve battlefield awareness and facilitate joint operations within the theater.

zh: 東部戰區也很可能在中國海警與海上民兵船艦執行與日本就釣魚台列嶼持續爭端相關行動時，指揮所有這些船艦。
en: The Eastern Theater Command also likely commands all CCG and maritime militia ships while they are conducting operations related to the ongoing dispute with Japan over the Senkaku Islands.

zh: 南部戰區涵蓋東南亞大陸與海洋地區，包括南海。
en: The Southern Theater Command covers mainland and maritime Southeast Asia, including the SCS.

zh: 這個地理區域意味著，南部戰區負責確保南海安全、在任何對台灣的行動中支援東部戰區，並確保對中共全球野心至關重要的南海海上交通線（SLOC）的安全。
en: This geographic area implies that the Southern Theater Command is responsible for securing the SCS, supporting the Eastern Theater Command in any operation against Taiwan, and assuring the security of sea lines of communication (SLOCs) vital to China’s global ambitions in the SCS.

zh: 南部戰區在解放軍與東南亞國家的雙邊與多邊演習中也扮演重要角色，例如在2022年參與與泰國的人道援助與災害救援演習。
en: The Southern Theater Command also plays a significant role in the PLA’s bilateral and multilateral exercises with countries in Southeast Asia, such as participating in humanitarian assistance and disaster relief exercise with Thailand in 2022.

zh: 解放軍從俄羅斯購買的24架蘇愷-35全部配屬給南部戰區空軍，並已在南海與西太平洋巡邏飛行。
en: All of the PLA’s 24 Su-35s purchased from Russia are assigned to the Southern Theater Command Air Force and have flown patrols in the SCS and into the Western Pacific.

zh: 南部戰區也是第一個接收解放軍海軍轟-6J海上打擊轟炸機的戰區。
en: The Southern Theater Command was also the first command to receive the PLAN’s H-6J maritime strike bombers.

zh: 2019年12月，中華人民共和國把其第一艘國產航空母艦山東艦，在南部戰區的榆林海軍基地服役。
en: In December 2019, the PRC commissioned its first-domestically produced aircraft carrier, Shandong into service at Yulin Naval Base in the Southern Theater Command.

zh: 中華人民共和國在南沙群島的前哨據點，有能力支援軍事作戰，包括先進武器系統，並已支援非作戰飛機。
en: The PRC’s outposts on the Spratly Islands are capable of supporting military operations, including advanced weapon systems, and have supported non-combat aircraft.

zh: 西部戰區是中華人民共和國境內地理上最大的戰區，負責因應與印度的衝突，以及中華人民共和國所稱中國西部的「恐怖主義威脅」。
en: The Western Theater Command is geographically the largest theater command within the PRC and is responsible for responding to conflict with India and what the PRC refers to as “terrorist threats” in western China.

zh: 位於西部戰區內的解放軍單位，包括第76與第77集團軍，以及隸屬於新疆與西藏軍區的地面部隊；三個解放軍空軍基地、一個運輸師、一個飛行學院，以及一個解放軍火箭軍基地。
en: PLA units located within the Western Theater Command include 76th and 77th Group Armies and ground forces subordinate to Xinjiang and Xizang Military Districts; three PLAAF bases, one transportation division, one flying academy, and one PLARF base.

zh: 自2020年5月初以來，印中邊界持續的緊張情勢，一直主導著西部戰區的注意力。
en: Since early May 2020, sustained tensions along the India-China border have dominated the Western Theater Command’s attention.

zh: 印度與中華人民共和國對實際控制線沿線邊界劃分的看法不同，加上雙方近期的基礎設施建設，導致多次衝突、持續對峙，以及沿共同邊界的軍事集結。
en: Differing perceptions between India and the PRC regarding border demarcations along the LAC, combined with recent infrastructure construction on both sides, led to multiple clashes, an ongoing standoff, and military buildups along the shared border.

zh: 為回應2020年6月中華人民共和國與印度巡邏隊在加勒萬河谷發生的小規模衝突，這是兩國45年來最激烈的衝突，西部戰區實施了沿實際控制線的解放軍部隊大規模動員與部署。
en: In response to a skirmish in June 2020 between PRC and Indian patrols in Galwan Valley, the most violent clash between the two countries in 45 years, the Western Theater Command implemented a large-scale mobilization and deployment of PLA forces along the LAC.

zh: 自2020年5月起，中華人民共和國與印度部隊在沿實際控制線的多個地點對峙，並以石塊、警棍與纏繞鐵絲網的棍棒發生衝突。
en: Beginning in May 2020, PRC and Indian forces faced off in clashes with rocks, batons, and clubs wrapped in barbed wire at multiple locations along the LAC.

zh: 在2020年衝突之後，解放軍一直維持持續的兵力存在，並持續在實際控制線沿線建設基礎設施。
en: Following the 2020 clash, the PLA has maintained continuous force presence and continued infrastructure build up along the LAC.

zh: 中共也從其他戰區，在東段部署多達三個輕型至中型合成旅，並在實際控制線中段另外部署三個合成旅。
en: China also deployed as many as three light-to-medium CABs in the eastern sector from other theater commands and an additional three CABs in the central sector of the LAC.

zh: 這比2021年的972次侵入增加了79%。
en: This is a 79 percent increase from 972 incursions in 2021.

zh: 自2022年9月台灣國防部開始公布防空識別區內的無人飛行載具行動資訊以來，無人飛行載具約占所追蹤飛機的10%。
en: Since September 2022, when the Taiwan MND began releasing information on UAV operations in the ADIZ, UAVs have made up around 10 percent of aircraft tracked.

zh: 2022年，中華人民共和國與台灣之間的緊張情勢升高，因為中華人民共和國加強了針對台灣的政治與軍事壓力。
en: Tensions between the PRC and Taiwan increased in 2022, as the PRC intensified political and military pressure aimed at Taiwan.

zh: 東部戰區進行了突擊軍事演練，其中包括解放軍航空兵派出250多架戰鬥機進入台灣自行宣告的防空識別區，以及13艘解放軍海軍艦艇在台灣周邊活動。
en: The Eastern Theater Command conducted snap military drills that included PLA aviation flying more than 250 fighter aircraft into Taiwan’s self-declared ADIZ and 13 PLA Navy vessels operating around Taiwan.

zh: 一些公開估計顯示，中共運用其具備雙重能力的民用船隊，所能提供的排水噸位，可能大於美國海軍所有兩棲突擊艦的總和。
en: Some public estimates suggest that China’s use of its dual-capable civilian fleet could provide it greater displacement tonnage than the sum of all of the U.S. Navy’s amphibious assault ships.

zh: 解放軍也在2022年9月進行了為期五天的裝卸演習，使用六艘滾裝客貨輪與三艘貨運艦，模擬在入侵台灣中一個重型合成旅的移動。
en: The PLA also conducted a five-day loading/unloading exercise in September 2022 using six ROROs and three cargo ships to simulate the movement of a heavy combined arms brigade in a Taiwan invasion.

zh: 該演習包含10艘民用船舶，包括滾裝客貨輪型的渡輪與運車船，與解放軍海軍兩棲艦艇一同作業，其中至少有一艘071型船塢登陸艦。
en: The exercise featured 10 civilian ships – including RORO ferries and RORO vehicle carriers – operating alongside PLAN amphibious ships, including at least one Type-071 LPD.

zh: 中華人民共和國發展支援飛機，為解放軍空軍提供改進的情報、監視與偵察能力，以支援解放軍作戰。
en: The PRC’s development of support aircraft provides the PLAAF with improved ISR capability to support PLA operations.

zh: 台灣防空識別區的侵入行動，涉及更多飛機，且比2021年更頻繁，顯示解放軍空軍持續對台灣施壓的能力有所提升。
en: Taiwan ADIZ incursions involved greater numbers of aircraft and were more frequent than in 2021, demonstrating the PLAAF’s improved ability to sustain pressure on Taiwan.

zh: 解放軍著作顯示，戰略支援部隊將在台灣突發事件期間，負責運用電子戰與網路空間作戰，因為該部隊的任務之一是奪取並維持資訊主導權。
en: PLA writings suggest that the SSF would be responsible for the use of EW and cyberspace operations during a Taiwan contingency, as one of the missions of the force is to seize and maintain information dominance.

zh: 繼美國眾議院議長於2022年8月的國會議員訪團之後，台灣國防部宣稱中共對台灣發動了廣泛的網路攻擊。
en: Following the U.S. Speaker of the House’s CODEL in August 2022, Taiwan’s MND claimed that China launched widespread cyber-attacks against Taiwan.

zh: 台灣正採取措施彌補與解放軍之間日益擴大的差距，包括建立戰爭儲備物資、擴大國防工業基礎、改善聯合作戰與危機應變能力，並強化其軍官與士官團。
en: Taiwan is taking steps to compensate for the growing disparity with the PLA, including building its war reserve stocks, growing its defense-industrial base, improving joint operations and crisis response capabilities, and strengthening its officer and noncommissioned officer corps.

zh: 2022年10月，台灣提出2023年約190億美元的國防總支出，較2022年增加13.9%，約占台灣國內生產毛額的2.4%。
en: In October 2022, Taiwan proposed total defense spending of about $19 billion for 2023, a 13.9 percent increase from 2022, which will represent about 2.4 percent of Taiwan’s GDP.

zh: 台灣追加國防支出中，超過一半將用於飛彈輕型護衛艦與反艦武器，例如雄風飛彈系統。
en: Over half of Taiwan’s supplemental defense spending will fund missile corvettes and anti-ship weapons, such as the Hsiung Feng missile system.

zh: 戰略支援部隊也有少數幾艘遠望號太空支援船，用於追蹤衛星與洲際彈道飛彈的發射。
en: The SSF also has a handful of Yuan-wang space support ships to track satellite and ICBM launches.

zh: 中國營運的70所軍事院校中，近半數招收外國學員，但只有少數提供高階教育。
en: Nearly half of the 70 military academies operated in China admit foreign students but only a few offers senior-level education.

zh: 例如，由於中文課程與外語課程相互分開，外國學員與東道國學員的接觸及互動機會有限。
en: For example, foreign student and host nation student contacts and opportunities for interaction are limited due to the separation between Chinese and foreign language courses.

zh: 認知域作戰融合了中國先前的輿論與心理戰等概念，以及現代網際網路技術與通信平台，旨在透過影響目標的認知，並導致目標的決策與行為改變，來達成戰略性國家安全目標。
en: CDO blends previous Chinese concepts such as public opinion and psychological warfare with modern internet technologies and communication platforms, and is designed to achieve strategic national security goals by affecting a target’s cognition and resulting in a change in the target’s decision making and behavior.

zh: 中華人民共和國公布的軍事預算，並不包含支出細項的詳細資訊，包括研發與外國武器採購。
en: The PRC’s published military budget does not include details of expenditure breakouts, including R&D and foreign weapons procurement.

zh: 2022年，中共實際與軍事相關的支出，可能遠高於其官方公布的國防預算。
en: In 2022, China’s actual military-related spending could be significantly higher than its officially announced defense budget.

zh: 中共擁有世界領先的極音速武庫，並在過去20年間，大幅推進其常規與核武極音速飛彈技術的發展。
en: China has the world’s leading hypersonic arsenal and has dramatically advanced its development of both conventional and nuclear-armed hypersonic missile technologies during the past 20 years.

zh: 值得注意的是，中共於2018年開始測試無人59式戰車，作為其軍事現代化計畫的一部分。
en: Notably, China began testing unmanned Type-59 tanks in 2018 as part of its military modernization program.

zh: 2022年11月，中共公開了其VT-5輕型戰車的無人型號，這是15式輕型戰車的出口衍生型。
en: In November 2022, China unveiled an unmanned model of its VT-5 light tank, which is an export variant of the Type-15 light tank.

zh: 俄羅斯對烏克蘭的戰爭很可能會妨礙中共從兩國取得軍事裝備與維修服務的能力。
en: Russia’s war on Ukraine probably will impede China’s ability to acquire military equipment and maintenance services from either country.

zh: 他們在6月於新加坡香格里拉對話場邊會晤一次，並在11月於柬埔寨東南亞國家協會國防部長擴大會議（ADMM+）場邊會晤一次。
en: They met once in June on the sidelines of the Shangri La dialogue in Singapore, and once in November on the sidelines of the ASEAN Defense Ministerial Meeting + (ADMM+) in Cambodia.

zh: 參謀長聯席會議主席（CJCS）於7月，與時任中華人民共和國聯合參謀部主席（JSD），進行了一次國防電話熱線，討論作戰議題。
en: The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (CJCS) held one DTL with then-PRC Chairman of the Joint Staff Department (JSD) in July to discuss operational issues.

zh: 7月，解放軍取消了美國印太司令部司令與解放軍南部戰區（STC）司令員之間，一次有關作戰議題的國防電話熱線通話。
en: In July, the PLA cancelled a planned DTL call about operational issues between INDOPACOM Commander and the PLA Southern Theater Command (STC) commander.

zh: 8月，解放軍拒絕了參謀長聯席會議主席向聯合參謀部主席提出的國防電話熱線通話請求。
en: In August, the PLA refused a CJCS DTL call request to the Chairman of the JSD.

zh: 8月，解放軍拒絕了美國國防部長向中華人民共和國國防部長提出的國防電話熱線通話請求。
en: In August, the PLA refused a Secretary of Defense DTL call request to the PRC Minister of National Defense.

zh: 信心建立措施交流，著重運用降低風險的機制、簡報重要政策文件、減少誤解或誤判、戰俘與任務中失蹤人員查核，以及溝通以促進國際規則與規範。
en: Confidence Building Measure engagements focus on employing mechanisms for risk reduction, briefing significant policy documents, reducing misunderstanding or misperceptions, POW/MIA accounting, and communication to promote international rules and norms.

zh: 2022年，中共持續在實際控制線沿線發展軍事基礎設施。
en: In 2022, China continued to develop military infrastructure along the LAC.

zh: 2022年全年，解放軍也使其派入台灣防空識別區的飛機類型多樣化。
en: Throughout 2022, the PLA also diversified the type of aircraft it sent into Taiwan’s ADIZ.

zh: 解放軍海軍越來越多地在其本國海域以外活動，前往包括中東、歐洲、非洲、南亞、東南亞、大洋洲與拉丁美洲在內的地方。
en: Increasingly, the PLAN is operating outside of its home waters to places including the Middle East, Europe, Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, Oceania, and Latin America.

zh: 自2019年以來，中華人民共和國未依據2014年美國國防部與中華人民共和國國防部之間關於《重大軍事活動通報信心建立措施機制》的諒解備忘錄，向美國國防部提供或要求有關安全相關政策發展的簡報。
en: Since 2019, the PRC has not offered or requested briefings to DoD on security related policy developments under the 2014 MOU between the U.S. Department of Defense and the PRC Ministry of National Defense on Notification of Major Military Activities Confidence Building Measures Mechanism.

zh: 2022年，國防部戰俘與任務中失蹤人員查核署（DPAA）與解放軍之間，沒有任何交流或接觸。
en: There were no exchanges or contacts in 2022 between the Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency (DPAA) and the PLA.

zh: 美國作為五個核武國家對話的主席，於6月13日至14日在開羅舉辦了工作層級專家會議，與會者包括美國國防部與中華人民共和國國防部的官員。
en: The United States, as the chair of the dialogue among the five Nuclear Weapons States, organized a working-level experts meeting on June 13-14 in Cairo, which included officials from the U.S. Department of Defense and PRC Ministry of National Defense.

zh: 中華人民共和國忽視了美國印太司令部司令向解放軍南部戰區（STC）、北部戰區（NTC）與東部戰區（ETC）司令員提出的國防電話熱線通話請求。
en: The PRC ignored INDOPACOM Commander DTL call requests to the PLA STC, Northern Theater Command (NTC), and Eastern Theater Command (ETC) commanders.

zh: 中華人民共和國認為華盛頓與北大西洋公約組織應為引發衝突負責，加上對俄羅斯安全關切的同情，推動了中華人民共和國對這場衝突的回應。
en: The PRC’s perception that Washington and NATO are responsible for starting the conflict, along with its sympathy for Russia’s security concerns, has driven the PRC’s response to the conflict.

zh: 中華人民共和國也持續與俄羅斯在聯合國、金磚國家與東南亞國家協會等多邊論壇中合作，並與俄羅斯領導人舉行例行雙邊會晤，藉此使俄羅斯在世界舞台上的角色合法化。
