en: The PRC has also legitimized Russia’s role on the world stage by continuing to work with Russia in various multilateral fora such as the UN, BRICS, and ASEAN as well as by conducting routine bilateral meetings with Russian leaders.

zh: 網路戰能力的發展與解放軍著作一致，這些著作把資訊作戰（包含網路、電子戰、太空與心理戰）視為在衝突初期取得資訊優勢不可或缺的一環，也是對抗更強對手的有效手段。
en: The development of cyber warfare capabilities is consistent with PLA writings, which identify IO—comprising cyber, EW, space, and psychological warfare—as integral to achieving information superiority early in a conflict as an effective means to counter a stronger foe.

zh: 截至2020年，解放軍軍官與文職人員很可能約有450,000人（23%），士官約850,000人（42%），義務役新兵約700,000人（35%）。
en: As of 2020, PLA officers and civilian personnel probably numbered approximately 450,000 personnel (23 percent), NCOs roughly 850,000 (42 percent), and conscripted recruits about 700,000 (35 percent).

zh: 延續至少自2016年以來實施的做法，更新後的國家徵兵法聚焦於鼓勵大專學生，包括近期畢業生與目前的高年級學生，自願入伍。
en: Continuing practices implemented since at least 2016, the updated national conscription law focuses on encouraging college students, both recent graduates and current senior students, to voluntarily enlist.

zh: 大專學生獲得服役的誘因，尚未畢業者可在服役期滿後返回學校完成學業。
en: College students are offered incentives to serve, and those who have not yet graduated may return to school to finish their education after their time in service.

zh: 為追求習近平在2049年前建成「世界一流」軍隊的願景，解放軍正聚焦於其士官的人事改革，士官被期望成為解放軍在未來戰爭中的「骨幹」。
en: In pursuit of Xi’s vision of achieving a “world-class” military by 2049, the PLA is focusing on the personnel reform of its NCOs, which are expected to be the PLA’s “backbone” in future wars.

zh: 認識到小型軍事單位在區域戰爭中扮演越來越重要的角色，解放軍正設法強化士官的戰略與領導能力，並透過學術與技術訓練提升其專業技能。
en: Recognizing that small military units have played an increasingly important role in regional wars, the PLA is seeking to strengthen NCOs’ strategic and leadership capabilities, as well as improve their professional skills through academic and technical training.

zh: 2022年3月，解放軍實施了旨在提高「戰鬥力」的新法規，例如允許中級與高級士官延長服役時間，使軍中有更多專業士官。
en: In March 2022, PLA implemented new regulations aimed at increasing “combat effectiveness,” such as allowing intermediate and senior sergeants to stay in service longer to have more professional NCOs in the military.

zh: 這些法規旨在提升士官的專業性與穩定性，同時讓義務役人員在中華人民共和國軍事人才的培養中，發揮更基礎的作用。
en: The regulations aimed at enhancing professionalism and stability among NCOs, while allowing conscripts to play a more fundamental role in the development of the PRC’s military talent.

zh: 這些法規也旨在透過推進士官與義務役人員的招募、訓練、軍階晉升、福利與退伍制度，改善解放軍人員的管理，並在建設高品質軍隊中發揮關鍵作用。
en: They also intended to improve the management of PLA personnel by progressing the recruitment, training, rank promotion, benefits and demobilization system for NCOs and conscripts, and to play a key role in building a high-quality military.

zh: 這一結論已轉化為北京堅定捍衛中俄戰略合作、持續支持俄羅斯參與外交論壇，並反對國際經濟制裁。
en: This conclusion has translated into Beijing remaining steadfast in its defense of Sino-Russian strategic cooperation, continuing to support Russia’s involvement in diplomatic forums, and opposing international economic sanctions.

zh: 中華人民共和國也呼應俄羅斯對這場戰爭的說法，聲稱美國與北大西洋公約組織應為引發並延長戰爭負責。
en: The PRC has also echoed Russian messaging on the war, claiming that the United States and NATO are responsible for causing and prolonging the war.

zh: 北京認為，中國必須建設一支能夠「打仗並打贏」、「堅決捍衛」國家主權、安全與發展利益的「世界一流」軍隊。
en: Beijing views as an imperative that China field a “world-class” military that can “fight and win” and “resolutely safeguard” the country’s sovereignty, security, and development interests.

zh: 秉持黨廣泛的國家安全概念，中央國家安全委員會的職權涵蓋對內與對外的國家安全事務。
en: Embracing the Party’s expansive concept of national security, the CNSC’s purview covers internal and external national security matters.

zh: 隨著中央國家安全委員會的成立與黨採納國家安全戰略，全國人民代表大會於2015年通過了《國家安全法》。
en: With the establishment of the CNSC and the Party’s adoption of the national security strategy, in 2015 the NPC passed the National Security Law.

zh: 中共對於美國造成、其認為被誇大的中國威脅形象感到不滿。
en: The CCP is frustrated by what it perceives to be an exaggerated threat picture of China caused by the United States.

zh: 這些管制包括嚴格的旅行限制、大規模強制檢測制度，以及廣泛的隔離要求。
en: These controls include strict travel restrictions, mass mandatory testing regimes, and extensive quarantine requirements.

zh: 2021年，中華人民共和國持續沿實際控制線集結兵力並建設軍事基礎設施。
en: In 2021, the PRC continued to amass forces and build military infrastructure along the LAC.

zh: 即使在COVID-19之前，中國的經濟成長就已因人口挑戰、國家主導的基礎設施投資報酬遞減，以及都市化放緩而減緩。
en: Even before COVID-19, China’s economic growth had slowed because of demographic challenges, declining returns from state-led infrastructure investment, and slowing urbanization.

zh: 2019年3月，中華人民共和國全國人民代表大會通過了新的《外商投資法》，其宣稱的目標是改善外國投資者的商業環境，並使外國企業與中國民營企業及國有企業（SOE）之間的競爭環境公平。
en: In March 2019, the PRC’s NPC passed a new Foreign Investment law with the stated objective of improving the business environment for foreign investors and leveling the playing field between foreign businesses and Chinese private firms and State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs).

zh: 黨的領導人把軍民融合視為其推動中華人民共和國成為「偉大的現代社會主義國家」之戰略的關鍵要素，包括成為科學與技術（S&T）的世界領導者，以及發展「世界一流」軍隊。
en: The Party’s leaders view MCF as a critical element of their strategy for the PRC to become a “great modern socialist country” which includes becoming a world leader in science and technology (S&T) and developing a “world-class” military.

zh: 2020年在中共第19屆中央委員會第5次全體會議期間，中華人民共和國領導人重申軍民融合的高層級優先地位，呼籲透過整合新技術與作戰概念、增加科學與技術研究、改善軍民融合與人事改革，來加速軍事現代化。
en: In 2020 during the 5th Plenum of the 19th CCP Central Committee, PRC leaders reiterated the high-level priority of MCF by calling for accelerated military modernization through integration of new technologies and operational concepts, increased science and technology research, improved MCF, and personnel reforms.

zh: 軍民融合發展戰略的整體管理與執行，涉及黨國體制中最有權力的機關：政治局、國務院（特別是國家發展和改革委員會），以及中央軍事委員會。
en: The overall management and implementation of the MCF Development Strategy involves the most powerful organs in the party-state: the Politburo, the State Council (notably the National Development and Reform Commission), and the CMC.

zh: 中共把動員視為在需要的時候，於需要的期間，精確運用所需之工具、能力或資源的能力。
en: China views mobilization as the ability to use precisely the instrument, capability, or resource needed, when needed, for the duration needed.

zh: 習近平在2017年秋季的第19次黨代表大會上，續任其黨內職務，並於2018年春季在全國人民代表大會（NPC）上續任國家主席。
en: Xi was reappointed to his Party positions at the fall 2017 19th Party Congress and was reappointed President in spring 2018 at the National People's Congress (NPC).

zh: 習近平在2022年第20次黨代表大會上，獲連任第三任期的黨內職務，預計將在2023年全國人民代表大會上續任國家主席。
en: For a third term, Xi was reappointed to his Party positions in 2022 at the 20th Party Congress and is expected to be reappointed President at the 2023 NPC.

zh: 中華人民共和國官方媒體報導，國防預算較前一年的增加，重點放在以擬真模擬與虛擬實境的運用，使解放軍訓練現代化、加速後勤能力的改進、投資國防科學與技術，以及強化軍隊的戰略能力。
en: PRC state media reported that the defense budget increase over the prior year focused on modernizing the PLA’s training with realistic simulation and the use of virtual reality, accelerating improvements in logistics capabilities, investing in defense science and technology, and enhancing the military’s strategic capacities.

zh: 儘管解放軍陸軍有成為高度現代化地面部隊的雄心，仍廣泛運用現代與過時戰車及裝甲戰鬥車輛的混合。
en: Despite the PLAA's ambitions to become a highly modernized ground force they still widely employ a mix of modern and obsolete tanks and armored fighting vehicles.

zh: 2021年全年，解放軍陸軍持續測試並部署新系統，重點放在情境覺知與有人無人協同（MUM-T）的發展，並隨著垂直起降（VTOL）與固定翼無人飛行載具系統（UAS）的擴散。
en: Throughout 2021, the PLAA continued to test and field new systems with a large emphasis on the development of situational awareness and manned unmanned teaming (MUM-T) with the proliferation of vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) and fixed-wing uncrewed aerial systems (UAS).

zh: 這是透過使解放軍陸軍輕量化的努力達成的，重點放在中型與輕型、高機動性的平台，以及部署新型遠程多管火箭發射器系統。
en: This was accomplished through an effort to lighten PLAA with a focus on medium and light, high mobility platforms, and the fielding of new long-range multiple rocket launcher systems.

zh: 2021年解放軍陸軍航空兵聯合訓練的重點，包括陸軍航空直升機對解放軍空軍地對空飛彈旅進行對抗訓練，以及陸軍航空直升機與解放軍海軍登陸艦協同。
en: Highlights from PLAA Aviation joint training in 2021 included the army aviation helicopters conducting confrontational training against PLAAF surface-to-air missile brigades, and army aviation helicopters coordinating with PLA Navy landing ships.

zh: 解放軍陸軍單位強調貼近實戰的訓練、對抗兵力（OPFOR）編隊的專業化，並進行了多次實兵對抗的「對抗演練」。除了常規地面部隊訓練之外，解放軍陸軍單位在2021年進行了廣泛的專業演習。
en: PLAA units stressed realistic training, professionalization of opposing force (OPFOR) formations, and conducted numerous force-on-force “confrontation drills.” In addition to conventional ground force training, PLAA units conducted extensive specialty exercises in 2021.

zh: 解放軍海軍是世界上最大的海軍，戰鬥兵力約有340個平台，包括主要水面戰鬥艦、潛艦、遠洋兩棲艦艇、水雷戰艦艇、航空母艦與艦隊輔助艦艇。
en: The PLAN is the largest navy in the world with a battle force of approximately 340 platforms, including major surface combatants, submarines, ocean-going amphibious ships, mine warfare ships, aircraft carriers, and fleet auxiliaries.

zh: 配備CSS-N-14（巨浪-2）潛射彈道飛彈（SLBM）（7,200公里）的解放軍海軍六艘現役JIN級彈道飛彈核潛艦，代表中華人民共和國第一個可信的海基核嚇阻力量。
en: Equipped with the CSS-N-14 (JL-2) submarine-launched ballistic missile (SLBM) (7,200KM), the PLAN’s six operational JIN class SSBNs represent the PRC’s first credible sea-based nuclear deterrent.

zh: 到2020年代中期，中共很可能建造SHANG級（093B型）核動力飛彈潛艦（SSGN）。
en: By the mid-2020s, China will likely build the SHANG class (Type 093B) guided-missile nuclear-powered attack submarine (SSGN).

zh: 藉由優先採購具反潛作戰能力的水面作戰艦艇、聲學監視船，以及具反潛作戰能力的固定翼與旋翼飛機，解放軍海軍正大幅改善其反潛作戰能力。
en: By prioritizing the acquisition of ASW capable surface combatants, acoustic surveillance ships, and fixed and rotary wing ASW capable aircraft, the PLAN is significantly improving its ASW capabilities.

zh: 然而，解放軍海軍仍需要數年的訓練與系統整合，才能發展出強健的攻勢深海反潛作戰能力。
en: However, it will still require several years of training and systems integration for the PLAN to develop a robust offensive deep water ASW capability.

zh: 2021年底，解放軍海軍正在建造一艘航空母艦、一批新的飛彈驅逐艦（DDG），以及一批新的飛彈護衛艦（FFG）。
en: At the close of 2021, the PLAN was building an aircraft carrier, a new batch of guided-missile destroyers (DDG), and a new batch of guided missile frigates (FFG).

zh: 到2020年底，中華人民共和國已下水25艘LUYANG III級飛彈驅逐艦，其中包括12艘加長型LUYANG III MOD飛彈驅逐艦，到2021年底已有19艘新艦體服役。
en: By late 2020, the PRC had launched 25 LUYANG III class DDGs—including 12 lengthened LUYANG III MOD DDGs with 19 of the new hulls commissioning by the end of 2021.

zh: RENHAI有112個垂直發射系統發射單元，能攜帶大量武器，包括反艦飛彈、地對空飛彈（SAM）、魚雷與反潛武器，並在這些武器投入作戰後，很可能還有對地攻擊巡弋飛彈與反艦彈道飛彈（ASBM）。
en: The RENHAI has 112 VLS cells and can carry a large load out of weapons including ASCMs, surface-to-air missiles (SAMs), torpedoes, and anti-submarine weapons along with likely LACMs and anti-ship ballistic missiles (ASBM) when those become operational.

zh: 解放軍海軍的護衛艦與護衛艇，以及現代化改裝的較舊戰鬥艦，攜帶鷹擊-83／鷹擊-83J反艦飛彈衍生型（97海浬，180公里），而較新的水面戰鬥艦，例如LUYANG II級飛彈驅逐艦，則配備鷹擊-62（215海浬，400公里）。
en: The PLAN’s frigates and corvettes, as well as modernized older combatants, carry variants of the YJ-83/YJ-83J ASCM (97NM, 180KM), while newer surface combatants such as the LUYANG II class DDGs are fitted with the YJ-62 (215NM, 400KM).

zh: 未來幾年，解放軍海軍很可能在其較新的巡洋艦與驅逐艦，以及發展中的SHANG級093B型核動力飛彈潛艦上，部署對地攻擊巡弋飛彈。
en: In the coming years, the PLAN will probably field LACMs on its newer cruisers and destroyers and developmental SHANG class Type 093B SSGN.

zh: 這款飛機的原型模型已存在多年，外觀與E-2C／D鷹眼式預警機相似，而空警-600的原型機目前正在進行飛行測試。
en: A mockup of the aircraft, which appears externally similar to the E-2C/D Hawkeye, has existed for many years, and a prototype of the KJ-600 is currently in flight testing.

zh: 解放軍海軍陸戰隊仍在完成中央軍事委員會於2016年解放軍改革下所提出的擴編要求的過程中。
en: The PLANMC is still in the process of completing expansion requirements set forth by the CMC under PLA reform in 2016.

zh: 作為解放軍海軍的陸上作戰兵種，解放軍海軍陸戰隊在2021年全年持續演進，並依習近平的指示，正在接收成為解放軍首要遠征部隊所需的裝備與訓練。
en: Serving as the PLAN land combat arm, the PLANMC continued to evolve throughout 2021 and is receiving equipment and training necessary to become the PLA’s preeminent expeditionary force, as directed by Xi Jinping.

zh: 解放軍海軍陸戰隊的全部六個機動旅，都已達成初始作戰能力（IOC）；其中三個旅被評估為具備完全任務能力。
en: All six PLANMC maneuver brigades have achieved initial operating capability (IOC); three of the brigades are assessed to be fully mission capable.

zh: 另外兩個解放軍海軍陸戰隊旅，即航空旅與特種作戰旅，分別處於初始作戰能力與完全作戰能力（FOC）。
en: Two other PLANMC brigades – the aviation brigade and the special operations brigade, are IOC and Full Operational Capability (FOC), respectively.

zh: 解放軍海軍陸戰隊已開始在解放軍海軍第一艘直升機型兩棲突擊艦（LHA）上受訓，很可能是該艦取得作戰地位的初始資格認證的一部分。
en: The PLANMC has begun to train on the PLAN’s first amphibious helicopter assault ship (LHA), likely as part of the vessel’s initial qualifications for operational status.

zh: 解放軍海軍兩棲突擊艦將能夠把解放軍海軍陸戰隊的地面與空中部隊，包括兩棲與非兩棲作戰單位，投送到整個東亞、印度洋與西太平洋。
en: PLAN LHAs will be capable of delivering PLANMC ground and air forces, to include amphibious and non-amphibious combat units – throughout East Asia, the Indian Ocean, and the western Pacific Ocean.

zh: 相反地，解放軍海軍陸戰隊持續在北部、東部與南部戰區進行兩棲與遠征訓練，包括在南海的西沙群島與南沙群島進行訓練活動。
en: To the contrary, the PLANMC continues to conduct amphibious and expeditionary training in the Northern, Eastern, and Southern Theater Commands, to include training events in the Paracel Islands and the Spratly Islands in the South China Sea.

zh: 它也擴大了解放軍整合防空系統（IADS）網路的範圍。
en: It also extends the range of the PLA’s integrated air defense system (IADS) network.

zh: 此外，中國已生產至少一架配備空中加油探管的空警-500，這將提升該飛機提供持續的空中預警與管制機涵蓋能力。
en: Furthermore, China has produced at least one KJ-500 with an aerial refueling probe, which will improve the aircraft’s ability to provide persistent AEW&C coverage.

zh: 在這些概念中，中華人民共和國的開發者顯示出對超越情報、監視與偵察及電子戰，進一步擴展到空對空與空對地作戰的興趣，大量研發顯示出為作戰應用而生產群集能力的努力。
en: In these concepts, PRC developers are demonstrating an interest in additional growth beyond ISR and EW into both air-to-air and air-to-ground combat, with a substantial amount of development displaying efforts to produce swarming capability for operational applications.

zh: 為改善其戰略遠程防空，中華人民共和國已從俄羅斯取得SA-21（S-400）地對空飛彈系統。
en: To improve its strategic long-range air defenses, the PRC has acquired the SA-21 (S-400) SAM system from Russia.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍部署多種常規機動的地面發射短程、中程與中遠程彈道飛彈，以及地面發射巡弋飛彈。
en: The PLARF fields a variety of conventional mobile ground-launched short-, medium-, and intermediate-range ballistic missiles and ground-launched cruise missiles.

zh: 解放軍火箭軍正在發展洲際彈道飛彈（ICBM），這些飛彈將以更具存活力的投射系統，大幅改善其具備核能力的飛彈部隊，並將需要增加核彈頭的生產，部分原因是引進分導式多彈頭（MIRV）能力。
en: The PLARF is developing intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs) that will significantly improve its nuclear-capable missile forces with more survivable delivery systems, and will require increased nuclear warhead production, partially due to the introduction of multiple independently targetable reentry vehicle (MIRV) capabilities.

zh: 中華人民共和國官方軍事著作指出，這個射程等級涵蓋5,000至8,000公里，這意味著東風-27可能是新的中遠程彈道飛彈或洲際彈道飛彈。
en: Official PRC military writings indicates this range-class spans 5,000-8,000km, which means the DF-27 could be a new IRBM or ICBM.

zh: 此外，2021年7月27日，中共進行了首次以洲際彈道飛彈搭載極音速滑翔載具的部分軌道發射。
en: Additionally, on 27 July 2021, China conducted the first fractional orbital launch of an ICBM with an HGV.

zh: 該極音速滑翔載具繞行地球飛行，並在中國境內落地。
en: The HGV flew around the world and impacted inside China.

zh: 根據美國高階軍事官員的說法，該極音速滑翔載具沒有擊中其目標，但相當接近。
en: According to senior U.S. military officials, the HGV did not strike its target, but came close.

zh: 作為戰略性組織，戰略支援部隊直接隸屬於中央軍事委員會，但其部分下屬單位在戰時可能向各戰區報告。
en: As a strategic organization, the SSF is directly subordinate to the CMC, but some of its subordinate units may report to the theater commands in wartime.

zh: 戰略支援部隊網路系統部負責資訊戰，其任務組合包括網路空間作戰、技術偵察、電子戰（EW）與心理戰。
en: The SSF Network Systems Department is responsible for information warfare with a mission set that includes cyberspace warfare, technical reconnaissance, electronic warfare (EW), and psychological warfare.

zh: 網路系統部營運五個與戰區對應的技術偵察基地、數個信號情報局，以及數個研究所。
en: The Network Systems Department operates five theater–aligned technical reconnaissance bases, a number of signals intelligence bureaus, and several research institutes.

zh: 太空系統部營運至少八個基地，包括核心任務為發射、追蹤、研發與操作對中國天基指管通資情監偵架構至關重要的衛星的基地。
en: The Space System Department operates at least eight bases, including those whose core missions are the launch, tracking, R&D, and operation of the satellites vital to China’s overhead C4ISR architecture.

zh: 2021年全年，源自中華人民共和國的入侵持續以世界各地的電腦系統為目標，包括美國政府所擁有的系統。
en: PRC-based intrusions continued to target computer systems around the world, including those owned by the U.S. Government, throughout 2021.

zh: 中國的太空計畫由軍事、政治、國防工業與商業部門的組織組成。
en: China’s space program comprises organizations in the military, political, defense-industrial, and commercial sectors.

zh: 雖然國有企業是中國主要的民用與軍用太空承包商，但中國正更加強調使其太空產業分散化與多元化，以增加競爭。
en: Although state-owned enterprises are China’s primary civilian and military space contractors, China is placing greater emphasis on decentralizing and diversifying its space industry to increase competition.

zh: 作為該計畫的一部分，中國向伊朗、巴基斯坦與秘魯提供了能夠追蹤低地球軌道與地球靜止軌道物體的15公分望遠鏡。
en: As part of the project, China provided to Iran, Pakistan, and Peru 15-cm telescopes that are able to track objects in LEO and GEO.

zh: 中國與三十多個國家及四個國際組織，簽有一百多項與太空相關的合作協議。
en: China had more than a hundred cooperative space-related agreements with more than three dozen countries and four international organizations.

zh: 中國的商業太空部門，包括遙感探測、發射與通信服務，具有部分國有的企業，例如Zhuhai Orbita、Expace、Galactic Energy與OK-Space。
en: China’s commercial space sector features partially state-owned enterprises such as Zhuhai Orbita, Expace, Galactic Energy, and OK-Space for remote sensing, launch, and communication services.

zh: 北京也完成了巴基斯坦遙感衛星（PRSS-1）、委內瑞拉遙感衛星（VRSS-2）、蘇丹遙感衛星（SRSS-1）與阿爾及利亞通信衛星（Alcomsat-1）的在軌交付。
en: Beijing also completed the in-orbit delivery of the Pakistan Remote-Sensing Satellite (PRSS-1), Venezuelan Remote-Sensing Satellite (VRSS-2), Sudan Remote-Sensing Satellite (SRSS-1), and the Algerian Communications Satellite (Alcomsat-1).

zh: 聯勤保障部隊持續在與民間部門合作、提供後勤支援以因應持續的COVID-19疫情中，扮演領導角色。
en: The JLSF continues to play a lead role working with the civilian sector to provide logistic support in response to the continuing COVID-19 outbreak.

zh: 據報導，2021年武警執行了許多緊急救援與災害應變行動，以因應嚴重洪災與颱風，並進行反恐與對抗兵力的訓練與演習。
en: In 2021, the PAP reportedly executed numerous emergency rescue and disaster response operations in response to heavy flooding and typhoons, as well as conducting counterterrorism and opposing force training and exercises.

zh: 部分船艦是前解放軍海軍的艦艇，例如輕型護衛艦，已移交給中國海警並為中國海警的行動而改裝。
en: Some of the vessels are former PLAN vessels, such as corvettes, transferred to the CCG and modified for CCG operations.

zh: 與中國海警和解放軍海軍一樣，西沙群島與南沙群島的新設施，增強了海上民兵在南海維持行動的能力。
en: As with the CCG and PLAN, new facilities in the Paracel and Spratly Islands enhance the PAFMM’s ability to sustain operations in the South China Sea.

zh: 解放軍近期的結構改革，可能進一步改變解放軍組織與指揮資訊作戰的方式，特別是隨著戰略支援部隊持續發展其能力，並進一步整合進與其他解放軍部隊的聯合規劃、演習與作戰。
en: The PLA’s recent structural reforms may further change how the PLA organizes and commands IO, particularly as the SSF continues to develop its capabilities and further integrate into joint planning, exercises, and operations with other PLA forces.

zh: 中國也打算向全球用戶提供衛星通信支援，並計畫在低地球軌道開發至少七個新的衛星通信星座。
en: China also intends to provide SATCOM support to users worldwide and plans to develop at least seven new SATCOM constellations in LEO.

zh: 除了陸基發射之外，中國在2020年展示了從海基平台發射長征十一號（LM-11）的能力。
en: In addition to land-based launches, in 2020 China demonstrated the ability to launch a Long March-11 (LM-11) from a sea-based platform.

zh: 該物體沒有釋放出任何新衛星，其發射剖面與傳統太空發射載具、彈道飛彈，或用於科學研究的探空火箭發射不一致，顯示可能存在對遠距離（而不僅是低地球軌道）衛星使用反衛星技術的基本能力。
en: No new satellites were released from the object, and the launch profile was inconsistent with traditional SLVs, ballistic missiles, or sounding rocket launches for scientific research, suggesting a basic capability could exist to use ASAT technology against satellites at great distances and not just LEO.

zh: 中國已發射多顆衛星，進行太空維修技術的科學實驗，並正在研究太空碎片清理；最近一次發射是2021年10月送入地球靜止軌道的實踐21號。
en: China has launched multiple satellites to conduct scientific experiments on space maintenance technologies and is conducting research on space debris cleanup; the most recent launch was the Shijian-21 launched into GEO in October 2021.

zh: 這項計畫與中國液態推進劑發射井部隊的擴張，顯示中華人民共和國打算轉向預警發射（LOW）態勢，以提高其核力量的平時戰備。
en: This project and the expansion of China’s liquid-propellant silo force suggests that the PRC intends to increase the peacetime readiness of its nuclear force by moving to a launch-on-warning (LOW) posture.

zh: 這種態勢與中華人民共和國的積極防禦概念、不首先使用核武政策，以及打擊後回應作法相容。
en: Such a posture is compatible with the PRC’s active defense concept, NFU policy, and post-strike response approach.

zh: 中華人民共和國的陸基核力量，主要由不同部署方式的洲際彈道飛彈組成，並由數種戰區射程的公路機動中程彈道飛彈與中遠程彈道飛彈補充。
en: The PRC’s land-based nuclear forces primarily consist of ICBMs with different basing modes complimented by several theater-range road-mobile MRBMs and IRBMs.

zh: 這個戰略武庫由公路機動、固態燃料的CSS-5 Mod 2與Mod 6（東風-21）中程彈道飛彈，以及能夠打擊印太地區目標的東風-26中遠程彈道飛彈補充。
en: This strategic arsenal is complemented by road-mobile, solid-fueled CSS-5 Mod 2 and Mod 6 (DF-21) MRBMs and DF-26 IRBMs capable of ranging targets in the Indo-Pacific region.

zh: 從過去的發展趨勢判斷，中華人民共和國次世代096型彈道飛彈核潛艦，很可能旨在部署配備分導式多彈頭的潛射彈道飛彈。
en: The PRC’s next-generation Type 096 SSBN is probably intended to field MIRVed SLBMs judging from past developmental trends.

zh: 096型彈道飛彈核潛艦很可能在2020年代初期開始建造。
en: The 096 SSBNs will likely begin construction in the early-2020s.

zh: 部署更新、能力更強且射程更遠的潛射彈道飛彈，例如巨浪-3，使解放軍海軍能夠從近海水域瞄準美國本土，並使解放軍海軍能夠考慮堡壘作戰，以強化其海基嚇阻力量的存活力。
en: The fielding of newer, more capable, and longer ranged SLBMs such as the JL-3 gives the PLAN the ability to target the continental United States from littoral waters allowing the PLAN to consider bastion operations to enhance the survivability of its sea-based deterrent.

zh: 此外，根據一家西方智庫的說法，中國正在建造多座新的後處理廠，可用於提取這種鈽。
en: In addition, China is constructing multiple new reprocessing plants that could extract this plutonium, according to a Western think tank.

zh: 中共考慮取得預警發射態勢，甚至可追溯到1970年代與1980年代，當時中華人民共和國曾考慮使用現有的陸基彈道飛彈預警雷達，來支援其發射井基CSS-4洲際彈道飛彈的預警發射態勢，但這套預警系統顯然並不可靠。
en: China’s considerations to attain a LOW posture date back to even the 1970s and 1980s, when the PRC considered using existing land-based ballistic missile early warning radar to support a LOW posture for its silo-based CSS-4 ICBMs, but apparently this early warning system was unreliable.

zh: 北京也已申報兩處歷史性的化學戰生產設施，並很可能有能力生產芥子氣、光氣與路易氏劑。
en: Beijing also has declared two historical chemical warfare production facilities and was probably capable of producing mustard gas, phosgene, and lewisite.

zh: 其中許多演習聚焦於作戰擬真，並包括夜間任務、惡劣天候條件下的訓練，以及同步的多域作戰。
en: Many of these exercises focused on combat realism and featured night missions, training in adverse weather conditions, and simultaneous multi-domain operations.

zh: 2021年全年，解放軍增加了在台灣海峽及其周邊的挑釁行動，包括多次飛入台灣自行宣告的防空識別區，以及多次奪島演習。
en: Throughout 2021, the PLA increased provocative actions in and around the Taiwan Strait, to include repeated flights into Taiwan’s self-declared Air Defense Identification Zone and numerous island seizure exercises.

zh: 南部戰區在解放軍與東南亞國家的雙邊與多邊演習中也扮演重要角色，在2021年參與了與巴基斯坦的聯合海軍演習、與柬埔寨的反恐演習，以及在泰國由美國共同主導的多邊演習。
en: The Southern Theater Command also plays a significant role in the PLA’s bilateral and multilateral exercises with countries in Southeast Asia, participating in a joint naval exercise with Pakistan, a counterterrorism exercise with Cambodia, and a U.S. co-led multilateral exercise in Thailand, in 2021.

zh: 中國與東南亞國家協會成員國原本設法在2021年前完成行為準則談判；然而，COVID-19疫情延緩了其進展。
en: China and ASEAN member states had sought to complete CoC negotiations by 2021; however, the COVID-19 pandemic has delayed its progress.

zh: 考量到分歧的複雜性與東南亞國家協會以共識為基礎的程序，2022年簽署行為準則的可能性極低。
en: Given the complexity of the disagreement and ASEAN’s consensus-based process, it is extremely unlikely that there will be a CoC signed in 2022.

zh: 負責內部安全行動的武警單位，也很可能受西部戰區控制。
en: PAP units responsible for internal security operations are also likely under the control of the Western Theater Command.

zh: 談判在2021年全年陷入停滯，第13輪軍事指揮官談判於10月破裂。
en: Negotiations stalled throughout 2021, with the 13th round of military commander negotiations breaking down in October.

zh: 北海艦隊主要負責保護通往中國北部的海上通道，但在北部戰區以外發生突發事件時，可提供關鍵任務資產，以支援其他艦隊。
en: The North Sea Fleet would be responsible primarily for protecting the sea approaches to northern China, but it could provide mission-critical assets to support other fleets during contingencies located beyond the Northern Theater.

zh: 中共領導人可在危機發生時，命令北部戰區執行一系列行動。
en: China’s leaders could order the Northern Theater Command to engage in a range of operations in the event of a crisis.

zh: 這些行動可能包括確保中國與北韓邊界的安全以控制難民流動，或軍事介入北韓以確保大規模毀滅性武器的安全，或維持北韓作為緩衝國的地位。
en: These could include securing the China-North Korea border to control the flow of refugees, or a military intervention into North Korea to secure weapons of mass destruction or preserve a North Korean buffer state.

zh: 這場演說發表於北京國台辦警告，若台灣朝正式獨立邁進，中共將採取「斷然措施」的一週之後。
en: This speech came a week after Beijing’s Taiwan Affairs Office warned that China would take "drastic measures" if Taiwan makes moves towards formal independence.

zh: 然而，國台辦發布的中華人民共和國2022年台灣白皮書，重申中華人民共和國偏好在「一國兩制」框架下和平統一，同時仍拒絕放棄必要時以武力迫使統一。
en: However, the PRC’s 2022 Taiwan White Paper published by the Taiwan Affairs Office restated the PRC’s preference for peaceful reunification under the “one country, two systems” framework, while maintaining a refusal to renounce the use of force to compel unification, if needed.

zh: 值得注意的是，在這些行動中，先進的解放軍空軍殲-16戰鬥機的比例在2021年全年增加，且特殊任務飛機幾乎每天都在台灣防空識別區內活動。
en: Notably, the ratio of advanced PLAAF J-16 fighters in these operations increased throughout 2021 and special mission aircraft operating inside the Taiwan ADIZ on a near daily basis.

zh: 解放軍也測試了可能在兩棲突擊中發揮關鍵作用的新平台，例如05式兩棲裝甲車（AAV），並於2021年首次大量使用。
en: The PLA also tested new platforms that could potentially play a key role in an amphibious assault, such as the Type 05 amphibious assault vehicle (AAV), which it used in large numbers for the first time in 2021.

zh: 為回應美國眾議院議長8月初的國會議員訪團，根據台灣國防部的資料，解放軍空軍在2022年8月出動超過250架次戰鬥機，越過台灣海峽中線。
en: In reaction to the U.S. Speaker of the House’s Congressional Delegation in early August, the PLAAF flew more than 250 fighter aircraft sorties across the Taiwan Strait median line in August 2022, according to Taiwan MND data.

zh: 2021年，解放軍在台灣附近進行了聯合兩棲突擊演習，並完成了第三艘兩棲突擊艦的建造。
en: In 2021, the PLA conducted joint amphibious assault exercises near Taiwan and completed construction of its third LHA.

zh: 2021年，解放軍首次亮相YUSHEN級兩棲突擊艦（075型）海南艦，旨在提升部隊的作戰能力與艦艇機動。
en: In 2021, the PLA debuted the YUSHEN class amphibious assault ship (Type 075) Hainan LHA, designed to improve forces' operational capabilities and vessel maneuver.

zh: 更多YUSHEN級艦體目前正在建造中。
en: Additional YUSHEN class hulls are currently under construction.

zh: 解放軍似乎也計畫建造新一級的兩棲突擊艦，即076型。
en: It appears that the PLA is also planning to build a new class of amphibious assault ship—the Type 076.

zh: 這些兩棲裝甲車在裝甲、存活力與速度方面，較上一代63A式有所提升，並為解放軍提供能力更強的兩棲突擊平台。
en: These AAVs represent an upgrade in armor, survivability, and speed from the last-generation Type 63A, and provide the PLA with a more capable amphibious assault platform.

zh: 近年來，中華人民共和國的兩棲艦隊聚焦於取得少量遠洋船塢登陸艦（LPD）與兩棲突擊艦（LHA）。
en: The PRC’s amphibious fleet has in recent years focused on acquiring a modest number of ocean-going amphibious transport docks (LPDs) and amphibious assault ships (LHAs) ships.

zh: 2021年，常規飛彈的部署出現加速。
en: 2021 saw an acceleration of the positioning of conventional missiles.

zh: 這種演變中的作法，與黨的觀點相呼應，即21世紀的最初幾十年，是專注於建設中華人民共和國綜合國力的「戰略機遇期」。
en: This evolving approach parallels the Party’s view that the initial decades of the 21st century represent a “period of strategic opportunity” to focus on building the PRC’s comprehensive national power.

zh: 作為這項COVID援助的一部分，中國也在2021年全年向50多個國家捐贈個人防護裝備，並在過去十年間九度派遣其海軍醫療艦，為40多個國家與地區提供醫療服務。
en: As part of this COVID assistance, China has also donated personal protective equipment to more than 50 countries throughout 2021 and has deployed its naval hospital ship nine times over the past ten years to provide medical services for more than 40 countries and regions.

zh: 此外，中共於2022年2月與伊朗及俄羅斯合作舉行聯合海軍演習。
en: Additionally, China partnered with Iran and Russia for joint naval drills in February of 2022.

zh: 在國際上，北京旨在營造有利於其戰略目標的資訊環境。
en: Internationally, Beijing aims to create an information environment favorable to its strategic objectives.

zh: 中華人民共和國透過世界貿易組織、東南亞國家協會，以及巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國與南非（BRICS）機制等組織，把中國描繪成負責任的全球行為者，藉此推動戰略訊息傳達。
en: The PRC promotes strategic messaging by portraying China as a responsible global actor through organizations such as the World Trade Organization, Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and the Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa (BRICS) mechanism.

zh: 中共一貫把美國與更廣泛的西方社群描繪為對其利益與安全的威脅。
en: The CCP has consistently framed the United States and the broader Western community as a threat to its interests and security.

zh: 中國對石油與天然氣運輸網路的投資，可協助其供應多元化，並減少對麻六甲海峽等戰略咽喉要道的依賴。
en: China’s investments in transport networks for oil and gas could help diversify its supply and reduce dependency on strategic chokepoints such as the Strait of Malacca.

zh: 自2013年取得北極理事會觀察員地位以來，中國已增加在北極地區的活動與參與。
en: China has increased activities and engagement in the Arctic region since gaining observer status in the Arctic Council in 2013.

zh: 此外，俄羅斯專家指出，俄羅斯私下反對中國的「極地絲綢之路」概念，稱其破壞由俄羅斯主導的北方海航道。
en: Additionally, Russian experts have noted private Russian objections to China’s “Polar Silk Road” concept, saying it undermines a Russian-led Northern Sea Route.

zh: 2020年，中國部署了其首款配備極音速滑翔載具的飛彈，並推進其超燃衝壓發動機的發展，該發動機可應用於極音速巡弋飛彈。
en: In 2020, China fielded its first missile with a hypersonic glide vehicle and advanced its scramjet engine development, which has applications in hypersonic cruise missiles.

zh: COMAC生產大型客機，並致力於在全球商用客機市場競爭。
en: COMAC produces large passenger aircraft and aims to compete in the global commercial airliner market.

zh: 中國數十年來改善國內航空發動機生產的努力，已開始產生成果，殲-10與殲-20戰鬥機到2021年底已改用國產WS-10發動機。
en: China’s decades-long efforts to improve domestic aircraft engine production are starting to produce results with the J-10 and J-20 fighters switching to domestically produced WS-10 engines by the end of 2021.

zh: 中國也維持高水準的研發經費，並對從事前沿技術的國內企業提供大量補貼，並已發展出專注的努力，以改善其國內教育、吸引海外中國人才與吸引外國人才。
en: China also sustains high levels of R&D funding and offers significant subsidies to domestic companies working on frontier technologies, and has developed a focused effort to improve their domestic education, attract overseas Chinese talent, and attract foreign talent.

zh: 去年，中國設計並製造了一台量子電腦，能針對特定問題勝過傳統高效能電腦。
en: Last year, China designed and fabricated a quantum computer capable of outperforming a classical high-performance computer for a specific problem.

zh: 2020年與2021年，中國科學家與工程師進行了額外測試，利用其實踐20號衛星，展示了從地球靜止軌道（GEO）進行量子通信的可行性。
en: In 2020 and 2021, Chinese scientists and engineers performed additional testing demonstrating the feasibility of quantum communications from geosynchronous Earth orbit (GEO) using their Shijian-20 satellite.

zh: 中國是世界第五大武器供應國，向沙烏地阿拉伯、塞爾維亞、阿拉伯聯合大公國、印尼、哈薩克、伊拉克與巴基斯坦等客戶，銷售幾乎所有類別的常規軍事裝備，包括無人飛行載具系統、潛艦、海軍水面艦艇、地對空飛彈系統與戰鬥機。
en: China is the fifth-largest arms supplier in the world, and sells nearly every category of conventional military equipment including UASs, submarines, naval surface vessels, surface to air missile systems and fighter aircraft to customers like Saudi Arabia, Serbia, the UAE, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Iraq, and Pakistan.

zh: 中華人民共和國取得敏感、軍民兩用或軍用級裝備的努力，包括抗輻射積體電路、單晶微波積體電路、加速度計、陀螺儀、海軍與海洋技術、複合泡沫材料營業祕密、太空通信、軍事通信干擾設備、動態隨機存取記憶體、航空技術，以及反潛作戰。
en: The PRC’s efforts to acquire sensitive, dual-use, or military-grade equipment included radiation hardened integrated circuits, monolithic microwave integrated circuits, accelerometers, gyroscopes, naval and marine technologies, syntactic foam trade secrets, space communications, military communication jamming equipment, dynamic random access memory, aviation technologies, and ASW.

zh: 解放軍也運用其首屈一指的科學與技術大學，即國防科技大學（NUDT），向外國人才提供該校的客座教授職位。
en: The PLA also has used its premier science and technology university, the National University of Defense Technology (NUDT), to offer foreign talent guest professorships at NUDT.

zh: 美國負責中國事務的國防部副助理部長，也於2021年8月19日與解放軍國際軍事合作辦公室（OIMC）副主任，進行了一次國防電話熱線通話。
en: The Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for China also conducted one DTL call with the Deputy Director of the PLA’s Office International Military Cooperation (OIMC) on August 19, 2021.

zh: 以少量武器維持這種態勢，常使中共領導人對確保報復的能力缺乏信心，認為他們不是缺少足夠的武器，就是缺少足夠具存活力的武庫。
en: Maintaining this posture with a small number of weapons has often led to China’s leaders lacking confidence in their ability to assure retaliation, perceiving that they either lacked enough weapons or lacked a sufficiently survivable arsenal.

zh: 先進的太空監視資產、常規快速打擊武器，以及可能以網路空間攻擊破壞核指揮與管制，也加深了中華人民共和國對維持相互核脆弱性的疑慮。
en: Advanced space surveillance assets, conventional prompt-strike weapons, and the possibility of cyberspace-attacks to undermine nuclear command and control also contribute to PRC’s concerns about maintaining mutual nuclear vulnerability.

zh: 此外，解放軍可能對對手的指揮與管制（C2）系統進行動能打擊或網路空間攻擊，以切斷對手的資訊流。
en: Additionally, the PLA could conduct kinetic strikes or cyberspace-attacks on adversary command and control (C2) systems in order to cut off an adversary’s information flow.

zh: 另一位解放軍研究人員建議，解放軍應運用人工智慧來運行其在社群媒體上的機器人網路，該網路能夠創造內容，並協調在社群媒體上發文的最佳時機。
en: Another PLA researcher suggested that the PLA should use AI to run its bot network on social media, which would be able to create content, and coordinate the optimal time to post on social media.

zh: 中共設法運用其與其他戰略夥伴國家的關係，強化其體系偏好，並維持有利於北京的穩定。
en: China seeks to leverage its relationship with other strategic partnership countries to reinforce its systemic preferences and maintain stability in Beijing’s favor.

zh: 解放軍在可能支援政治目標，或能洞悉外國有關反恐、機動作戰與後勤的戰術、技術與程序（TTP）時，參與聯合演習。
en: The PLA participates in combined exercises when doing so is likely to support political objectives or yield insights into foreign tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) concerning counterterrorism, mobility operations, and logistics.

zh: 空射巡弋飛彈延伸了轟炸機打擊目標的防區外射程。
en: An ALCM extends the standoff range from which a bomber can strike a target.

zh: 轟炸機在演習期間向一艘標靶艦發射了一枚空射巡弋飛彈。
en: The bomber launched an air-launched cruise missile at a target ship during the exercise.

zh: 菲律賓漁業與水產資源局的船隻，在漁船返港時出現在該礁附近。
en: BFAR vessels were present near the shoal when the fishing boats returned to port.

zh: 菲律賓漁業與水產資源局報告，漁民被阻擋進入其傳統漁場。
en: The Philippine Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources reported that fishermen were blocked from their traditional fishing grounds.

zh: 大型相位陣列雷達網路支援沿北部邊境的彈道飛彈預警。
en: The LPAR network supports ballistic missile early warning along the northern border.

zh: 大型相位陣列雷達能夠同時追蹤多個目標，而無需移動天線。
en: Large phased-array radars can track many targets at once without moving the antenna.

zh: 國家中山科學研究院研發了台灣目前部署的雄風反艦飛彈系列。
en: The NCSIST developed the Hsiung Feng anti-ship missile family that Taiwan fields today.

zh: 國家中山科學研究院為台灣軍隊設計並製造飛彈與雷達。
en: The NCSIST designs and builds missiles and radars for Taiwan’s armed forces.

zh: 擴散式低地球軌道星座因數百顆小型衛星共用同一個軌道殼層，而能提供持續涵蓋。
en: A PLEO constellation provides continuous coverage because hundreds of small satellites share the same orbital shell.

zh: 擴散式低地球軌道衛星更難被摧毀，因為損失一顆衛星幾乎不會削弱整個網路。
en: Proliferated Low Earth Orbit satellites are harder to destroy because the loss of one satellite barely degrades the network.

zh: 垂直起降火箭能夠返回發射場，並以自身發動機著陸。
en: VTVL rockets can return to the launch site and land on their own engines.

zh: 垂直起降助推器在試飛後降落在著陸台上。
en: The Vertical Takeoff, Vertical Landing booster touched down on the landing pad after the test flight.

zh: 中國人民政治協商會議的年度會議，與全國人民代表大會同時舉行。
en: The CPPCC holds its annual session at the same time as the National People’s Congress.

zh: 資訊通信電子部隊負責通信與電子任務。
en: The Information Communication and Electronic Force is responsible for communications and electronic missions.

zh: 中國北方工業公司向許多國家出口裝甲車輛、砲兵系統與輕兵器。
en: NORINCO exports armored vehicles, artillery systems, and small arms to many countries.

zh: 大韓民國與美國每年在朝鮮半島舉行聯合演習。
en: The ROK and the United States conduct combined exercises on the Korean Peninsula each year.

zh: 中芯國際是中華人民共和國最大的晶片代工製造商。
en: SMIC is the largest contract chip manufacturer in the PRC.

zh: 現役陸軍的戰備水準高於後備部隊。
en: The Active Army maintains a higher level of readiness than the reserve forces.

zh: 數個現役陸軍旅奉命在月底前部署。
en: Several Active Army brigades were ordered to deploy before the end of the month.

zh: 絕氣推進使傳統潛艦能夠連續潛航數週。
en: Air independent propulsion allows a conventional submarine to remain submerged for weeks.

zh: 造船廠正在為下一級潛艦測試新的絕氣推進系統。
en: The shipyard is testing a new air independent propulsion system for its next class of submarines.

zh: 海峽上空繁忙的空中交通迫使航空公司更改數個航班的航線。
en: Heavy air traffic over the strait forced the airline to reroute several flights.

zh: 管制員協調演習區周邊的空中交通。
en: Controllers coordinated air traffic around the military exercise area.

zh: 這具空中載具由數百公里外的地面站控制。
en: The air vehicle is controlled from a ground station several hundred kilometers away.

zh: 每具空中載具都攜帶感測器組件與資料鏈路。
en: Each air vehicle carries a sensor package and a data link.

zh: 總統在年度演說中呼籲強化全民防衛戰略。
en: The president called for a stronger all-out defense strategy in his annual address.

zh: 民防演練是全民防衛整備的重要部分。
en: Civil defense drills are an important part of all-out defense preparations.

zh: 驅逐艦在實彈演習中向一艘標靶駁船發射了一枚攻船巡弋飛彈。
en: The destroyer launched an anti-ship cruise missile at a target barge during the live-fire exercise.

zh: 攻船巡弋飛彈在海面低空飛行，以避免被艦艇雷達偵測。
en: An anti-ship cruise missile flies low over the sea to avoid detection by ship radars.

zh: 國防實驗室把部分預算從基礎研究轉移到應用研究。
en: The defense laboratory shifted part of its budget from basic research to applied research.

zh: 電池技術的應用研究可以延長小型無人機的續航力。
en: Applied research on battery technology could extend the endurance of small drones.

zh: 進場系統在低能見度下引導飛機安全飛向跑道。
en: The approach system guides aircraft safely to the runway in low visibility.

zh: 工程師去年冬天升級了北部機場的進場系統。
en: Engineers upgraded the approach system at the northern airfield last winter.

zh: 軍備管制談判在中斷兩年後恢復。
en: Arms control negotiations resumed after a two-year pause.

zh: 分析人士懷疑，新的軍備管制協議能否被有效查核。
en: Analysts doubt that the new arms control agreement can be effectively verified.

zh: 陸軍地面部隊與陸戰隊在海岸舉行聯合演習。
en: Army ground forces conducted a combined exercise with the marines on the coast.

zh: 報告描述陸軍地面部隊在長期戰役中如何獲得持續支援。
en: The report describes how Army ground forces would be sustained during a long campaign.

zh: 護衛艦拖曳陣列聲納，以便在遠距離偵測潛艦。
en: The frigate towed an array sonar to detect submarines at long range.

zh: 陣列聲納比艦殼聲納更能精確判定目標方位。
en: An array sonar can determine the bearing of a target more precisely than a hull-mounted sonar.

zh: 航艦甲板上的制動裝置在數秒內讓飛機停了下來。
en: The arresting device on the carrier deck stopped the aircraft within seconds.

zh: 維修人員在每次飛行作業前檢查制動裝置。
en: Maintenance crews inspect the arresting device before every flight operation.

zh: 指揮官透過歷史與實務訓練研習戰爭藝術。
en: Commanders study the art of war through history and practical training.

zh: 教授主張，戰爭藝術的變化比軍事科技緩慢。
en: The professor argues that the art of war changes more slowly than military technology.

zh: 確定性之破壞的準則建立在遭受第一擊後仍能報復的能力上。
en: The doctrine of assured destruction rests on the ability to retaliate after a first strike.

zh: 批評者認為，確定性之破壞已不再反映現代嚇阻的實況。
en: Critics say assured destruction no longer reflects the realities of modern deterrence.

zh: 規模較小的海軍希望藉由水雷與飛彈取得不對稱優勢。
en: The smaller navy hopes to gain an asymmetric advantage with mines and missiles.

zh: 網路能力可以讓較弱的國家取得不對稱優勢。
en: Cyber capabilities can give a weaker state an asymmetric advantage.

zh: 一具自主式水下載具繪製了港口入口附近的海床地圖。
en: An autonomous underwater vehicle mapped the seabed near the harbor entrance.

zh: 這具自主式水下載具完成測量任務後返回支援艦。
en: The AUV returned to the support ship after completing its survey mission.

zh: 彈道飛彈預警系統在數秒內偵測到發射。
en: The ballistic missile early warning system detected the launch within seconds.

zh: 北部的雷達構成彈道飛彈預警系統的一部分。
en: Radars in the north form part of the ballistic missile early warning system.

zh: 戰鬥支隊增派了一個驅逐艦中隊。
en: The battle group was reinforced with an additional destroyer squadron.

zh: 戰鬥支隊通常在單一戰術指揮官的指揮下作戰。
en: A battle group usually operates under a single tactical commander.

zh: 視距外空對空飛彈可以攻擊飛行員看不見的目標。
en: A beyond visual range air-to-air missile can engage targets that the pilot cannot see.

zh: 這架戰鬥機的內部彈艙攜帶四枚視距外空對空飛彈。
en: The fighter carries four beyond visual range air-to-air missiles in its internal bay.

zh: 檢查人員搜查該設施，尋找生產生物武器的證據。
en: Inspectors searched the facility for evidence of biological weapons production.

zh: 條約禁止發展與儲存生物武器。
en: The treaty bans the development and stockpiling of biological weapons.

zh: 多數國家已加入生物武器公約。
en: Most countries have joined the Biological Weapons Convention.

zh: 生物武器公約沒有正式的查核機制，這限制了它的公信力。
en: The BWC has no formal inspection mechanism, which limits its credibility.

zh: 最高作戰指導構想說明聯合部隊預期在未來十年如何作戰。
en: The Capstone Concept explains how the joint force expects to fight in the next decade.

zh: 各軍種依據最高作戰指導構想編寫了自己的準則。
en: Each service wrote its own doctrine to follow the Capstone Concept.

zh: 載具火箭在星期二把一顆通信衛星送入軌道。
en: The carrier rocket lifted a communications satellite into orbit on Tuesday.

zh: 工程師在把載具火箭移往發射台之前進行了檢查。
en: Engineers inspected the carrier rocket before moving it to the launch pad.

zh: 部隊受訓在遭化學及生物戰劑污染的環境中作業。
en: Troops trained to operate in an environment contaminated by chemical and biological agents.

zh: 邊界的感測器可以偵測空氣中的化學及生物戰劑。
en: Sensors at the border can detect chemical and biological agents in the air.

zh: 化學武器公約要求締約國銷毀其庫存。
en: The Chemical Weapons Convention requires member states to destroy their stockpiles.

zh: 該組織的檢查人員查證各國是否遵守化學武器公約。
en: Inspectors from the organization verify compliance with the Chemical Weapons Convention.

zh: 民事單位協助地方官員在洪水過後恢復供水。
en: A civil affairs unit helped local officials restore water service after the flood.

zh: 每個旅都由一個民事單位提供支援。
en: Each brigade is supported by a civil affairs unit.

zh: 各國同意就爭議海域協商行為準則。
en: The countries agreed to negotiate a code of conduct for the disputed waters.

zh: 行為準則規範了海軍艦艇在海上相遇時應有的行為。
en: The code of conduct sets rules for how naval vessels should behave when they meet at sea.

zh: 這個中隊在經過六個月訓練後執行了首次戰鬥任務。
en: The squadron flew its first combat mission after six months of training.

zh: 每次戰鬥任務都從詳細的情報簡報開始。
en: Each combat mission begins with a detailed intelligence briefing.

zh: 兩國政府簽署了打擊恐怖主義與共享情報的協議。
en: The two governments signed an agreement on combatting terrorism and sharing intelligence.

zh: 打擊恐怖主義需要軍方與警方合作。
en: Combatting terrorism requires cooperation between the military and the police.

zh: 聯合兵種中心為旅長研擬訓練課程。
en: The combined arms center develops training programs for brigade commanders.

zh: 來自數個兵科的軍官參加了聯合兵種中心的課程。
en: Officers from several branches attended a course at the combined arms center.

zh: 指揮大樓的屋頂上安裝了一座通信終端站。
en: A communications terminal was installed on the roof of the command building.

zh: 通信終端站把基地連接到衛星網路。
en: The communications terminal links the base to the satellite network.

zh: 試飛員昨天首次駕駛複合飛機飛行。
en: The test pilot flew the composite aircraft for the first time yesterday.

zh: 工程師仍在評估這款複合飛機，之後才會決定追加訂購。
en: Engineers are still evaluating the composite aircraft before ordering more.

zh: 一個工程大隊在兩週內重建了這座橋。
en: A construction battalion rebuilt the bridge within two weeks.

zh: 工程大隊隸屬於海軍基地。
en: The construction battalion is attached to the naval base.

zh: 危機處理訓練讓官員準備好在通信中斷時做出回應。
en: Crisis management training prepares officials to respond when communications fail.

zh: 該部成立了一個負責危機處理的新辦公室。
en: The ministry created a new office for crisis management.

zh: 縱深防禦透過在多個層次設置障礙來減緩攻擊者。
en: Defense in depth slows an attacker by placing obstacles across several layers.

zh: 該計畫依賴縱深防禦，而不是單一的堅固防線。
en: The plan relies on defense in depth rather than a single strong line.

zh: 只有獲授權人員可以存取儲存在這個網路上的國防資料。
en: Only authorized personnel may access defense information stored on this network.

zh: 這次洩漏暴露了數項即將推動計畫的國防資料。
en: The leak exposed defense information about several upcoming programs.

zh: 阻斷服務攻擊使該部網站離線數小時。
en: A denial of service attack knocked the ministry website offline for several hours.

zh: 防禦人員過濾流量以阻止阻斷服務攻擊。
en: Defenders filtered the traffic to stop the denial of service attack.

zh: 驅逐艦分遣隊於黎明離港，前往海峽巡邏。
en: The destroyer flotilla departed port at dawn for a patrol of the strait.

zh: 驅逐艦分遣隊通常包括由一名指揮官指揮的數艘艦艇。
en: A destroyer flotilla usually includes several ships under one commander.

zh: 這個中隊仍然由聯隊長直接指揮。
en: The squadron remained under the direct control of the wing commander.

zh: 預備單位在戰時歸戰區司令直接指揮。
en: Reserve units pass under the direct control of the theater commander in wartime.

zh: 導能武器可以在不使用任何彈藥的情況下使小型無人機失效。
en: A directed energy weapon can disable a small drone without using any ammunition.

zh: 數個國家正在發展用於艦艇防禦的導能武器。
en: Several countries are developing a directed energy weapon for ship defense.

zh: 預警衛星偵測到飛彈發射的熱訊號。
en: An early-warning satellite detected the heat from the missile launch.

zh: 該國發射了一顆新的預警衛星，以改善對該區域的涵蓋。
en: The country launched a new early-warning satellite to improve its coverage of the region.

zh: 規劃人員討論是否應攻擊煉油廠這類經濟目標物。
en: Planners discussed whether an economic target such as a refinery should be attacked.

zh: 打擊經濟目標物可以在不與其陸軍交戰的情況下對政府施壓。
en: Striking an economic target can pressure a government without engaging its army.

zh: 該部增加了對初級軍官教育及訓練的經費。
en: The ministry increased spending on education and training for junior officers.

zh: 專業的教育及訓練貫穿軍官的整個職涯。
en: Professional education and training continue throughout an officer's career.

zh: 艦艇在近岸必須於擁擠的電磁環境中作業。
en: Ships must operate in a crowded electromagnetic environment near the coast.

zh: 這次測試量測雷達在敵對電磁環境中的性能。
en: The test measured how the radar performs in a hostile electromagnetic environment.

zh: 外交、資訊、軍事力量與經濟是傳統上的國力要素。
en: Diplomacy, information, military force, and economy are the classic elements of national power.

zh: 學生比較了各國如何結合國力要素。
en: Students compared how each country combines the elements of national power.

zh: 這艘護衛艦受命執行油輪船團的掩護任務。
en: The frigate was assigned an escort mission for a convoy of tankers.

zh: 戰鬥機執行掩護任務，以保護運輸機。
en: Fighters flew an escort mission to protect the transport aircraft.

zh: 歐洲太空總署上週發射了一顆新的地球觀測衛星。
en: The European Space Agency launched a new earth observation satellite last week.

zh: 歐洲太空總署的工程師參訪了該測試設施。
en: Engineers from the European Space Agency visited the test facility.

zh: 一個遠征打擊支隊為因應危機而部署到地中海東部。
en: An expeditionary strike group deployed to the eastern Mediterranean in response to the crisis.

zh: 遠征打擊支隊包括一艘兩棲突擊艦與數艘護航艦。
en: The expeditionary strike group includes an amphibious assault ship and several escorts.

zh: 爆炸反應裝甲保護戰車免受成型裝藥彈頭攻擊。
en: Explosive reactive armor protects the tank against shaped-charge warheads.

zh: 升級後的車輛在車體上加裝了爆炸反應裝甲。
en: The upgraded vehicle is fitted with explosive reactive armor on its hull.

zh: 飛行員改變飛行路徑以避開風暴。
en: The pilot changed the flight path to avoid the storm.

zh: 雷達追蹤了這架不明飛機的飛行路徑。
en: Radar tracked the flight path of the unidentified aircraft.

zh: 部隊發展計畫必須每四年檢討一次。
en: Force development plans must be reviewed every four years.

zh: 這位將軍負責部隊發展與現代化計畫。
en: The general is responsible for force development and modernization programs.

zh: 可靠的通信是小型單位的戰力加乘因子。
en: Reliable communications act as a force multiplier for small units.

zh: 空中預警機是戰鬥機機隊的戰力加乘因子。
en: Airborne early warning aircraft are a force multiplier for the fighter fleet.

zh: 各旅與真實的對抗單位進行了兵力對抗演習。
en: The brigades conducted a force on force exercise with live opposing units.

zh: 兵力對抗訓練能揭露操演無法揭露的弱點。
en: Force on force training reveals weaknesses that drills cannot.

zh: 每個兵力單位在部署資料庫中都有各自的代碼。
en: Each Force Unit has a separate code in the deployment database.

zh: 規劃人員指派一個新的兵力單位到司令部。
en: Planners assigned a new Force Unit to the headquarters.

zh: 燃料補給短缺迫使車隊在邊界附近停止前進。
en: A shortage of fuel supply forced the convoy to halt near the border.

zh: 工程師修復管線，以恢復對機場的燃料補給。
en: Engineers repaired the pipeline to restore the fuel supply to the airfield.

zh: 通用機槍為步槍班提供壓制火力。
en: A general purpose machine-gun provides suppressive fire for the rifle squad.

zh: 通用機槍可以架設在三腳架上，也可以裝在輕型車輛上。
en: The GPMG can be mounted on a tripod or on a light vehicle.

zh: 一套地面雷射武器對小型無人飛行載具進行了測試。
en: A ground-based laser weapon was tested against small unmanned aircraft.

zh: 陸軍計畫部署地面雷射武器用於防空。
en: The army plans to field a ground-based laser weapon for air defense.

zh: 導引火箭擊中目標的精準度遠高於無導引火箭。
en: A guided rocket can hit targets with far greater precision than an unguided rocket.

zh: 該旅領到了第一個導引火箭發射器連。
en: The brigade received its first battery of guided rocket launchers.

zh: 導引武器利用衛星訊號修正航向。
en: A guided weapon corrects its course using signals from satellites.

zh: 訓練強調每件導引武器的安全操作。
en: Training emphasized the safe handling of each guided weapon.

zh: 一架巨型空運機把工程裝備運往災區。
en: A heavy transport aircraft delivered the engineering equipment to the disaster area.

zh: 空軍想採購更多巨型空運機，以支援遠距離部署。
en: The air force wants to buy more heavy transport aircraft to support long-range deployments.

zh: 這個小組採用高跳高拉技術，不被發現地越過邊界。
en: The team used a high altitude high opening technique to cross the border unseen.

zh: 在高跳高拉的跳傘中，降落傘在離機後不久就會打開。
en: In a high altitude high opening jump, the parachute opens soon after exit.

zh: 模擬器提供高逼真度的座艙模型。
en: The simulator provides a high fidelity model of the cockpit.

zh: 高逼真度訓練裝置降低了飛行教學的成本。
en: High fidelity training devices reduce the cost of flight instruction.

zh: 特種部隊在夜間突襲中俘獲了一名高值目標。
en: Special forces captured a high value target during the night raid.

zh: 高值目標清單由情報參謀每日更新。
en: The HVT list is updated daily by the intelligence staff.

zh: 工業動員規劃會找出可轉為軍事生產的工廠。
en: Industrial mobilization planning identifies factories that could be converted to military production.

zh: 緩慢的工業動員會在長期戰爭中削弱陸軍。
en: A slow industrial mobilization would weaken the army in a long war.

zh: 該部在遭入侵後隔離了內部資訊網路。
en: The ministry isolated its internal information network after the intrusion.

zh: 資訊網路把感測器、指揮所與武器連結起來。
en: An information network links sensors, command posts, and weapons.

zh: 陸軍聘用了具備優秀資訊科技技能的工程師。
en: The army hired engineers with strong information technology skills.

zh: 資訊科技如今幾乎影響後勤的每個環節。
en: Information technology now touches almost every part of logistics.

zh: 戰役最初階段的傷亡很輕微。
en: Casualties were light during the initial stage of the campaign.

zh: 這項計畫仍處於最初階段，需要更多經費。
en: The project is still in its initial stage and needs more funding.

zh: 聯合混編司令部把來自數個軍種的參謀軍官編在同一位指揮官之下。
en: An integrated command combines staff officers from several services under one commander.

zh: 盟國成立聯合混編司令部，以協調空中與海上作戰。
en: The allies established an integrated command to coordinate air and maritime operations.

zh: 國際原子能總署上個月檢查了該反應爐。
en: The International Atomic Energy Agency inspected the reactor last month.

zh: 國際原子能總署的檢查人員被拒絕進入其中一處場址。
en: IAEA inspectors were denied access to one of the sites.

zh: 每位初級軍官都必須完成基礎領導課程。
en: Every junior officer must complete the basic leadership course.

zh: 將軍與初級軍官會面，聽取他們的意見。
en: The general met with junior officers to hear their concerns.

zh: 動能攔截飛彈計畫在預算刪減後被取消。
en: The Kinetic Energy Interceptor program was cancelled after budget cuts.

zh: 動能攔截飛彈透過直接撞擊來摧毀彈頭。
en: A Kinetic Energy Interceptor destroys a warhead by hitting it directly.

zh: 動能擊殺載具以碰撞而非爆炸的方式摧毀目標。
en: A kinetic-kill vehicle destroys its target by collision rather than by explosion.

zh: 設計人員改進了動能擊殺載具的導引。
en: Designers improved the guidance of the kinetic-kill vehicle.

zh: 在士兵使用衛星接收機之前，先以地圖與指北針教授陸上方位判定。
en: Land navigation is taught with maps and compasses before soldiers use satellite receivers.

zh: 這門課程在崎嶇地形上測驗陸上方位判定技能。
en: The course tests land navigation skills over rough terrain.

zh: 空軍選定一款輕型作戰飛機來取代老舊的教練機。
en: The air force selected a light combat aircraft to replace its aging trainers.

zh: 輕型作戰飛機的營運成本低於重型戰鬥機。
en: A light combat aircraft is cheaper to operate than a heavy fighter.

zh: 視距通信受到地球曲率的限制。
en: Line-of-sight communication is limited by the curvature of the earth.

zh: 中繼塔把視距通信延伸到整個山谷。
en: The relay tower extends line-of-sight communication across the valley.

zh: 這節火箭燃燒儲存在低溫槽中的液體推進劑。
en: The rocket stage burns liquid propellant stored in cryogenic tanks.

zh: 安全處理液體推進劑需要特殊的防護裝備與訓練。
en: Handling liquid propellant safely requires special protective equipment and training.

zh: 將軍警告，局部戰爭可能擴大為區域衝突。
en: The general warned that a local war could expand into a regional conflict.

zh: 局部戰爭的作戰準則不同於世界大戰的作戰準則。
en: Doctrine for a local war differs from doctrine for a world war.

zh: 這枚長程飛彈可以攻擊兩千多公里外的目標。
en: The long range missile can reach targets more than two thousand kilometers away.

zh: 對為長程飛彈提供零件的公司實施了制裁。
en: Sanctions were imposed on the firm that supplied parts for the long range missile.

zh: 山上的遠程雷達可以偵測到遠在海岸線之外的飛機。
en: A long range radar on the mountain detects aircraft far beyond the coastline.

zh: 操作人員在保養期間把遠程雷達切換為待機。
en: Operators switched the long range radar to standby during maintenance.

zh: 可操縱重返大氣層載具可以改變航向以規避飛彈防禦。
en: A maneuverable reentry vehicle can change course to evade missile defenses.

zh: 可操縱重返大氣層載具的試驗在太平洋上空進行。
en: Testing of the maneuverable reentry vehicle took place over the Pacific Ocean.

zh: 驅逐艦使用中距離雷達追蹤接近艦隊的飛機。
en: The destroyer uses a medium range radar to track aircraft approaching the fleet.

zh: 中距離雷達填補了遠程與短程涵蓋之間的空隙。
en: A medium range radar fills the gap between long range and short range coverage.

zh: 兩個部會簽署了聯合訓練的瞭解備忘錄。
en: Both ministries signed a memorandum of understanding on joint training.

zh: 瞭解備忘錄並不產生任何法律義務。
en: The memorandum of understanding does not create any legal obligation.

zh: 政府派遣軍事顧問協助訓練當地陸軍。
en: The government sent military advisors to help train the local army.

zh: 停火生效後，軍事顧問已撤離。
en: Military advisors were withdrawn after the ceasefire took effect.

zh: 條約規定，若夥伴遭到攻擊，較大的國家有義務提供軍事援助。
en: The treaty obliges the larger state to give military assistance if its partner is attacked.

zh: 國會辯論在選舉後是否繼續軍事援助。
en: Congress debated whether to continue military assistance after the election.

zh: 軍事武官向大使簡報駐在國陸軍的訓練計畫。
en: The military attaché briefed the ambassador on the host army's training plans.

zh: 一名新的軍事武官上週抵達大使館。
en: A new military attaché arrived at the embassy last week.

zh: 每次大型演習後都會修訂軍事準則，以納入經驗教訓。
en: Military doctrine is revised after each large exercise to capture lessons learned.

zh: 學院教授軍事準則如何因應新科技而發展。
en: The academy teaches how military doctrine develops in response to new technology.

zh: 衛星影像顯示，海岸附近的軍事設施有新的建設。
en: Satellite images showed new construction at the military installation near the coast.

zh: 進出軍事設施僅限獲授權人員。
en: Access to the military installation is restricted to authorized personnel.

zh: 總統要求將領為這場危機準備軍事選擇方案。
en: The president asked the generals to prepare military options for the crisis.

zh: 外交人員表示，所有軍事選擇方案仍在檢討中。
en: Diplomats said that all military options remain under review.

zh: 這所大學為未來軍官開設軍事科學學位。
en: The university offers a degree in military science for future officers.

zh: 軍事科學的進展改變了各國陸軍規劃戰役的方式。
en: Advances in military science changed how armies planned their campaigns.

zh: 地震發生後，民政當局請求軍事支援。
en: Civil authorities requested military support after the earthquake.

zh: 軍事支援的範圍在兩國的協議中有明確規定。
en: The scope of military support is defined in the agreement between the two states.

zh: 新兵的軍事訓練為期十二週。
en: Military training for new recruits lasts twelve weeks.

zh: 在國外接受的軍事訓練使這些軍官熟悉盟軍的程序。
en: Military training abroad gave the officers experience with allied procedures.

zh: 多目標重返大氣層載具讓一枚飛彈攜帶數個彈頭。
en: A multiple reentry vehicle carries several warheads on one missile.

zh: 軍備談判人員就多目標重返大氣層載具的限制展開爭論。
en: Arms negotiators argued about limits on the multiple reentry vehicle.

zh: 美國國防授權法為下一個會計年度訂定支出上限。
en: The National Defense Authorization Act sets spending limits for the coming fiscal year.

zh: 國會在數月辯論後通過了美國國防授權法。
en: Congress passed the National Defense Authorization Act after months of debate.

zh: 該戰略把每項軍事任務與一個國家目標連結起來。
en: The strategy links each military task to a national objective.

zh: 領導人對如何追求這項國家目標意見不一。
en: Leaders disagreed on how to pursue the national objective.

zh: 部長表示，該條約保護兩國的國家安全利益。
en: The minister said the treaty protects the national security interests of both countries.

zh: 官員權衡國家安全利益與經濟成本。
en: Officials weighed national security interests against economic costs.

zh: 因為颱風，海峽內的海軍作業暫停。
en: Naval operations in the strait were suspended because of the typhoon.

zh: 參謀軍官在艦隊司令部規劃海軍作業。
en: Staff officers plan naval operations at the fleet headquarters.

zh: 感測器以近似實際時間把資料傳送到指揮中心。
en: The sensors send data to the command center in near real time.

zh: 分析人員需要近似實際時間的影像來追蹤移動目標。
en: Analysts need near real time imagery to track moving targets.

zh: 戰鬥蔓延到首都時，非戰鬥人員撤離行動隨即展開。
en: A noncombatant evacuation operation began when fighting reached the capital.

zh: 陸戰隊在非戰鬥人員撤離行動期間守住機場。
en: Marines secured the airport during the noncombatant evacuation operation.

zh: 報告探討核子能量如何用來驅動潛艦。
en: The report examines how nuclear energy is used to power submarines.

zh: 核子能量研究須接受國際查核。
en: Nuclear energy research is subject to international inspection.

zh: 規劃人員研究了有限核子互擊的後果。
en: Planners studied the consequences of a limited nuclear exchange.

zh: 專家警告，核子互擊將損害全球氣候。
en: Experts warned that a nuclear exchange would harm the global climate.

zh: 海軍去年春天讓一艘核動力攻擊潛艦服役。
en: The navy commissioned a nuclear powered attack submarine last spring.

zh: 核動力攻擊潛艦可以連續潛航數月。
en: A nuclear powered attack submarine can stay submerged for months.

zh: 每座反應爐每年都要進行核子安全檢查。
en: Nuclear safety inspections are carried out at every reactor every year.

zh: 這起事故引發了對港口核子安全的新疑慮。
en: The accident raised new concerns about nuclear safety at the port.

zh: 攻勢空軍部隊在開戰的最初數小時攻擊了雷達站。
en: Offensive air units struck the radar sites during the first hours of the war.

zh: 該計畫強調以攻勢空軍作戰來奪取主動。
en: The plan emphasizes offensive air operations to gain the initiative.

zh: 國防部長辦公室星期二公布了這份報告。
en: The Office of the Secretary of Defense released the report on Tuesday.

zh: 國防部長辦公室的人員參訪了訓練基地。
en: Staff from the Office of the Secretary of Defense visited the training base.

zh: 近海防衛是沿岸巡邏艦隊的主要任務。
en: Offshore defense is the main mission of the coastal patrol fleet.

zh: 規劃人員正依據新的飛彈威脅重新思考近海防衛。
en: Planners are rethinking offshore defense in light of new missile threats.

zh: 指揮官在收到最新情報後宣布了他的作戰決心。
en: The commander announced his operational decision after receiving the latest intelligence.

zh: 每項作戰決心都必須記錄在單位日誌中。
en: Every operational decision must be recorded in the unit log.

zh: 作戰教則說明各單位如何在戰役中協同。
en: Operational doctrine describes how units cooperate during a campaign.

zh: 軍官在演習前檢閱了作戰教則。
en: Officers reviewed the operational doctrine before the exercise.

zh: 參謀每小時更新一次作戰圖像。
en: The staff updates the operational picture every hour.

zh: 共享的作戰圖像有助於盟軍單位避免混淆。
en: A shared operational picture helps allied units avoid confusion.

zh: 該國維持約兩千名士兵的海外駐軍。
en: The country maintains an overseas presence of about two thousand troops.

zh: 預算刪減可能減少海軍的海外駐軍。
en: Budget cuts may reduce the overseas presence of the navy.

zh: 一艘巡邏戰鬥艇護送漁船返港。
en: A patrol combatant escorted the fishing boats back to port.

zh: 海軍向造船廠訂購了六艘新的巡邏戰鬥艇。
en: The navy ordered six new patrol combatants from the shipyard.

zh: 聯合國展開和平維持行動以監督停火。
en: The United Nations launched a peacekeeping operation to monitor the ceasefire.

zh: 安全理事會把和平維持行動再延長一年。
en: The PKO was extended for another year by the Security Council.

zh: 精準導引彈藥使飛機能以較少的架次擊中小型目標。
en: Precision guided munitions allow aircraft to hit small targets with fewer sorties.

zh: 經過數週的打擊，精準導引彈藥的庫存已所剩不多。
en: Stocks of precision guided munitions ran low after weeks of strikes.

zh: 這枚飛彈在最後階段使用雷達歸向追蹤目標。
en: The missile uses radar homing to follow the target during the final phase.

zh: 雷達歸向可被干擾或誘餌擊敗。
en: Radar homing can be defeated by jamming or decoys.

zh: 靶場監視飛機在飛彈發射前清空了試驗區域。
en: Range surveillance aircraft cleared the test area before the missile launch.

zh: 靶場監視確保沒有民用船舶進入危險區域。
en: Range surveillance ensures that no civilian vessels enter the danger zone.

zh: 聯盟成立了一支能在數日內部署的快速反應部隊。
en: The alliance created a rapid reaction force that can deploy within days.

zh: 快速反應部隊在北部訓練場進行了首次不預先通知的演練。
en: The RRF conducted its first no-notice drill in the northern training area.

zh: 砲兵連以偵察射擊找出敵方的砲兵陣地。
en: The battery used reconnaissance fire to reveal the enemy's gun positions.

zh: 偵察射擊具有風險，因為可能暴露射擊單位。
en: Reconnaissance fire is risky because it can expose the firing unit.

zh: 偵察衛星每隔九十分鐘飛越這座港口。
en: A reconnaissance satellite passed over the port every ninety minutes.

zh: 該國計畫明年發射第二顆偵察衛星。
en: The country plans to launch a second reconnaissance satellite next year.

zh: 每位預備軍官每年都必須參加兩週的訓練。
en: Each reserve officer must attend two weeks of training every year.

zh: 該部徵召預備軍官，以填補醫療兵科的缺額。
en: The ministry recruited reserve officers to fill shortages in the medical corps.

zh: 對任務與使命的檢討使各軍種共用更多裝備。
en: A review of roles and missions led the services to share more equipment.

zh: 國防白皮書釐清了後備部隊的任務與使命。
en: The defense white paper clarifies the roles and missions of the reserve.

zh: 可信的還手打擊能力可以嚇阻對手先發動攻擊。
en: A credible second strike capability deters an adversary from attacking first.

zh: 在海上的核潛艦提供可存活的還手打擊兵力。
en: Nuclear submarines at sea provide a survivable second strike force.

zh: 半主動雷達歸向仰賴發射機照射目標。
en: Semi-active radar homing depends on the launch aircraft to illuminate the target.

zh: 當戰鬥機轉向離開時，這枚半主動雷達歸向飛彈失去了鎖定。
en: The SARH missile lost its lock when the fighter turned away.

zh: 一名資深上校受命領導調查工作。
en: A senior colonel was appointed to lead the investigation.

zh: 這位資深上校指揮學院的訓練團。
en: The senior colonel commands the training regiment at the academy.

zh: 在場的資深軍官在指揮官受傷後接掌指揮。
en: The senior officer present assumed command after the commander was wounded.

zh: 資深軍官齊聚司令部，檢討撤離計畫。
en: Senior officers gathered at headquarters to review the evacuation plan.

zh: 一艘艦岸連接艇把車輛從運輸艦運到海灘。
en: A ship-to-shore connector moved the vehicles from the transport ship to the beach.

zh: 新型艦岸連接艇可以載運一輛重型戰車穿越碎浪。
en: The new ship-to-shore connector can carry a heavy tank across the surf.

zh: 海關人員檢查了抵達海軍港口的每個船運貨櫃。
en: Customs officers inspected every shipping container arriving at the naval port.

zh: 一個船運貨櫃被改裝成機動指揮所。
en: A shipping container was converted into a mobile command post.

zh: 一枚短程飛彈就足以威脅海峽對岸的目標。
en: A short range missile is enough to threaten targets across the strait.

zh: 陸軍把每枚短程飛彈儲存在密閉的掩體中。
en: The army stores each short range missile in a sealed shelter.

zh: 短程雷達涵蓋機場的進場航道。
en: A short range radar covers the approaches to the airfield.

zh: 涵蓋範圍的空隙可以用裝在卡車上的短程雷達來填補。
en: Gaps in coverage can be filled with a short range radar mounted on a truck.

zh: 固體推進劑使飛彈更容易儲存、發射更迅速。
en: Solid propellant makes a missile easier to store and quicker to launch.

zh: 工廠在嚴格管制下把固體推進劑澆鑄進發動機殼體。
en: The factory casts solid propellant into the motor casing under strict controls.

zh: 太空飛行體監視與辨識有助於操作人員避免在軌道上發生碰撞。
en: Space object surveillance and identification helps operators avoid collisions in orbit.

zh: 太空飛行體監視與辨識網路追蹤數千個環繞地球的物體。
en: The SOSI network tracks thousands of objects circling the earth.

zh: 太空載臺可以長年搭載多種感測器。
en: A space platform can host several sensors for years.

zh: 該機構正在設計供科學實驗使用的可重複使用太空載臺。
en: The agency is designing a reusable space platform for scientific experiments.

zh: 這所大學成立了太空科學與工程研究所。
en: The university founded an institute for space science and engineering.

zh: 太空科學的進展提高了軌道預測的準確度。
en: Advances in space science improved the accuracy of orbit predictions.

zh: 太空狀況覺知仰賴由雷達與望遠鏡組成的全球網路。
en: Space Situational Awareness depends on a worldwide network of radars and telescopes.

zh: 條約夥伴同意分享資料，以提升太空狀況覺知。
en: The treaty partners agreed to share data to improve space situational awareness.

zh: 一些分析人員擔心，太空戰爭可能癱瘓民用通信。
en: Some analysts fear that space warfare could cripple civilian communications.

zh: 軍事領導人如今研究太空戰爭的方式，就像研究空中戰爭一樣。
en: Military leaders now study space warfare in the same way they study air warfare.

zh: 成立了一個特殊單位，負責整個地區的爆裂物處理。
en: A specialized unit was formed to handle bomb disposal for the entire region.

zh: 每個特殊單位都直接向師長報告。
en: Each specialized unit reports directly to the division commander.

zh: 衛星在兩次引擎點火後進入穩定軌道。
en: The satellite reached a stable orbit after two engine burns.

zh: 穩定軌道對於持續涵蓋目標區域至關重要。
en: A stable orbit is essential for continuous coverage of the target area.

zh: 接獲警告後，艦隊進入較高的戰備狀態。
en: The fleet was placed in a higher state of readiness after the warning.

zh: 指揮官每天早上回報其單位的戰備狀態。
en: Commanders report the state of readiness of their units every morning.

zh: 戰略空軍部隊操作遠程轟炸機與加油機。
en: The strategic air force operates long-range bombers and tanker aircraft.

zh: 一位新指揮官今年春天接掌戰略空軍部隊。
en: A new commander took over the strategic air force this spring.

zh: 戰略轟炸機可以攜帶重型酬載飛越數千公里。
en: A strategic bomber can carry heavy payloads across several thousand kilometers.

zh: 空軍正在除役其最老舊的戰略轟炸機機隊。
en: The air force is retiring its oldest strategic bomber fleet.

zh: 理事會為聯盟的長期規劃提供戰略指導。
en: The council provides strategic direction for the alliance's long-term planning.

zh: 缺乏明確的戰略指導，各軍種各自推動不同的計畫。
en: Without clear strategic direction, the services pursued separate programs.

zh: 一個潛艦分遣隊從基地出航，執行為期三週的巡邏。
en: A submarine flotilla sailed from the base for a three-week patrol.

zh: 潛艦分遣隊由一艘支援艦與一艘救難艦提供支援。
en: The submarine flotilla is supported by a tender and a rescue vessel.

zh: 卡車把彈藥從補給地區運往前線。
en: Trucks moved ammunition from the supply area to the front line.

zh: 補給地區往遠離海岸的地方遷移，以避免空襲。
en: The supply area was moved farther from the coast to avoid air attack.

zh: 支援中心向附近單位提供維修與補給服務。
en: The support center provides maintenance and supply services to nearby units.

zh: 一座新的支援中心明年將在港口附近啟用。
en: A new support center will open near the harbor next year.

zh: 合成孔徑雷達可以在雲層與黑暗中對地面成像。
en: Synthetic aperture radar can image the ground through clouds and darkness.

zh: 這顆衛星攜帶合成孔徑雷達，用於全天候觀測。
en: The satellite carries a synthetic aperture radar for all-weather observation.

zh: 戰術轟炸機的設計是用來攻擊靠近前線的目標。
en: A tactical bomber is designed to strike targets close to the front line.

zh: 這個中隊駕駛戰術轟炸機在敵方雷達下方低空飛行。
en: The squadron flew its tactical bombers at low altitude beneath enemy radar.

zh: 臺灣關係法規範雙方之間的非官方關係。
en: The Taiwan Relations Act governs the unofficial relationship between the two sides.

zh: 國會議員在致行政部門的信中引用了臺灣關係法。
en: Lawmakers cited the Taiwan Relations Act in their letter to the administration.

zh: 探測器在前往月球的途中進入轉換軌道。
en: The probe entered a transfer orbit on its way to the moon.

zh: 工程師計算脫離轉換軌道所需的點火。
en: Engineers calculated the burn needed to leave the transfer orbit.

zh: 聯合國安全理事會投票決定把制裁再延長一年。
en: The UN Security Council voted to extend the sanctions for another year.

zh: 五個常任理事國在聯合國安全理事會擁有否決權。
en: Five permanent members hold a veto in the UN Security Council.

zh: 部隊參謀連夜擬定了行動命令。
en: The unit staff prepared the movement orders overnight.

zh: 部隊參謀成員參加了關於新通信系統的簡報。
en: Members of the unit staff attended a briefing on the new communications system.

zh: 在野黨組成聯合陣線反對這項提案。
en: The opposition parties formed a united front against the proposal.

zh: 歷史學者把聯合陣線描述為建立聯盟的政治策略。
en: Historians describe the united front as a political strategy for building alliances.

zh: 一套無人飛行載具系統整夜監視海岸線。
en: An unmanned aerial system monitored the coastline throughout the night.

zh: 陸軍購買了一套無人飛行載具系統來檢查邊界圍籬。
en: The army bought an unmanned aerial system to inspect the border fence.

zh: 海軍中將在海軍基地的典禮上接掌艦隊。
en: The vice admiral took command of the fleet in a ceremony at the naval base.

zh: 一位海軍中將代表海軍出席國防會議。
en: A vice admiral represented the navy at the defense conference.

zh: 高空長續航力飛機可以在天候層之上盤旋超過一天。
en: A High Altitude Long Endurance aircraft can loiter above the weather for more than a day.

zh: 這項計畫旨在部署一款用於海上監視的高空長續航力平台。
en: The program aims to field a High Altitude Long Endurance platform for maritime surveillance.

zh: 這個小組為從運輸機進行高跳低拉跳傘而接受訓練。
en: The team trained for a high altitude low opening jump from a transport aircraft.

zh: 在高跳低拉的跳傘中，降落傘在接近地面時才打開。
en: In a high altitude low opening jump, the parachute opens close to the ground.

zh: 靶場人員在試射前清空了撞擊地帶的船隻。
en: Range officers cleared the impact zone of vessels before the test firing.

zh: 殘骸落在南方海域預定的撞擊地帶內。
en: The debris fell inside the planned impact zone in the southern ocean.

zh: 當多個機關共用同一幅作戰圖像時，資訊管理至關重要。
en: Information management is critical when many agencies share one operational picture.

zh: 司令部聘用專家，以改善各參謀處之間的資訊管理。
en: The headquarters hired specialists to improve information management across the staff sections.

zh: 滾裝客貨輪讓卡車可以經由船尾跳板駛上駛下。
en: A Ro-Ro vessel lets trucks drive on and off through a stern ramp.

zh: 在危機中，民用滾裝客貨輪可以載運車輛與部隊橫越海峽。
en: Civilian Ro-Ro ships could carry vehicles and troops across the strait in a crisis.

zh: 滾裝客貨輪不需要起重機，可以經由跳板直接裝載車輛。
en: A roll on roll off ship loads vehicles directly over a ramp without cranes.

zh: 規劃人員清點航運公司能夠提供多少艘滾裝客貨輪。
en: Planners counted how many roll on roll off ships the shipping companies could provide.

zh: 灰色地帶行動低於公開武裝衝突的門檻。
en: Gray zone activities fall below the threshold of open armed conflict.

zh: 分析人員討論如何在不引發升級的情況下嚇阻灰色地帶脅迫。
en: Analysts debate how to deter gray zone coercion without triggering escalation.

zh: 巡邏艦艇在爭議島嶼周邊進行灰色地帶襲擾。
en: Patrol vessels carried out gray zone harassment around the disputed islands.

zh: 反覆的灰色地帶襲擾會消耗目標的耐心與資源。
en: Repeated gray zone harassment wears down the target's patience and resources.

zh: 第一營將於黎明時在港口登船。
en: The first battalion will embark at the port at dawn.

zh: 人員將在車輛裝載完成後登船。
en: Personnel will embark after the vehicles have been loaded.

zh: 已登船的部隊在艦艇仍停泊港內時容易遭受攻擊。
en: Embarked troops are vulnerable to attack while the ships are still in port.
